ἀφίημι.definition: let fall from one's grasp, Il.12.221; opp. Plu.2.508d; E.Hec.797

ἀφικάνω.definition: Ep. = only pres. and impf., arrive at, mostly c. acc., Od.14.159, al.; . . Il.6.388: c. gen., A.R.1.177

ἀφικνέομαι.definition: Ion. Hdt.2.28, al.: impf; or to try every means, S.OT265, E.Hipp.284; Hdt.8.110; Id.2.28, 77; Gal.2.230

ἀφιλία.definition: want of friends, Arist.EN1115a11, Rh.1386a9, Phld.Oec.p.67J., Plu.Sol.7

ἀφίστημι.definition: cause to revolt, of allies, Id.8.19, Ar.Eq.238, Th.1.81; Hdt.1.76,154, etc.; And.3.22

ἄφολκος.definition: not having weight, too light by a drachm, Str.15.3.22

ἀφοπλίζω.definition: disarm, D.S.11.35, APl.4.171 , Luc.DDeor.19.1:—Pass., D.S.14.64:—Med., put off one's armour, Il.23.26:—Pass. , to be discharged from service, Hsch

ἀφοράω.definition: of Places, look towards, App.Praef.3,cf. Philostr.Im.Prooem; to view from a place, Hdt.4.22; Timocl.21.6

ἀφορίζω.definition: mark off by boundaries; border on, Pl.Criti.110e

ἀφόρισμα.definition: that which is set apart: the wave- offering, LXXEx.29.24, al

ἀφορμάω.definition: intr. in Act. in same sense as Pass., E.Rh.98; Id.Tr.939, cf. Th.4.78; Aeschin.2.40; Plb.1.39.1; of lightning, to break forth, S.OC1470 : c. acc. cogn., . . Id.Aj.290

ἀφοσιόω.definition: Ion. purify from guilt or; dedicate, devote, Clearch.6

ἀφραδέω.definition: only in pres., to be senseless, behave thoughtlessly, . . Il.9.32; Od.7.294

ἀφραίνω.definition: to be foolish, Il.2.258,7.109, Od.20360, Phoc.5.—Poet. and Hp.Gland.12; later as a philosophic term, Chrysipp.Stoic.3.166, Plu.2.1037d, S.E.M.11.94, Plot.5.8.3

ἀφρέω.definition: foam, Hp.Morb.Sacr.7, etc; c. acc., befoam, cover with foam, Il.11.282

ἀφριάω.definition: poet. for Opp.H.1.772, Porph. ap. Eus.PE3.11

ἀφρονέω.definition: to be silly, act foolishly; trans., make foolish or vain, f.l. in Aq.2 Ki.15.31

ἀφυβρίζω.definition: work off youthful passion, sow one's wild; of wine, to be done fermenting, Alex.45.4

ἀφύσσω.definition: Ep. impf. Call.Cer.70: fut. Dor; sound, probe, Opp.H.2.597

ἀφύω.definition: to become white or bleached, Hp.Int.40

ἄφωνος.definition: voiceless, dumb, Thgn.669; with a poor voice, D.T.631.21

ἀχάριστος.definition: ungracious, unpleasant; of persons, ungracious, unfavourable, Thgn.841 , Phld.Ir.p.60 W

ἀχεύω.definition: and Ep. Verbs used in pres. part; in causal sense, vex, annoy, redupl. aor. 2 : hence redupl. pres. fut. aor. 1 c. acc. pers., Il.16.822, cf. Od.16.427; ib.432; by his death, Il.23.223; Od.15.357; h.Merc.286

ἄχθομαι.definition: Pass.: fut. Med. Ar.Nu.865,1441, Av.84, Pl.R.603e, Hp.Ma.292e; Pass., And.3.21, Pl.Grg.506c, v.l. in X.Cyr.8.4.10, Aeschin.3.242: pf. Lyc.827: aor. Hdt.2.103, A.Pr.392, Th.6.15, Isoc.12.17:-to be loaded, Od.15.457: c.…

ἀχλυόω.definition: darken, make dim, Aret.CD1.3:—Pass., become gloomy, grow dark, Thphr.Vent.35; become dim, Syn.Alch.p.58B

ἀχλύω.definition: aor. 1 to be or grow dark; trans., darken, Q.S.1.598, Nonn.D.4.368, Pancrat.Oxy.1085.12

ἀχύρωσις.definition: mixing of chaff with mud or straw, compared with the swallow's nest-building, Arist.HA612b22

ἀχωρέω.definition: or suffer from in part. or prob. cj. for in Paul.Aeg.3.3

ἀχώριστος.definition: not parted, undivided; without a place assigned one, X.Lac.9.5

ἀψευδέω.definition: not to lie, to speak truth; observe faithfully, IG5.343.38,57

ἀψευδής.definition: without deceit, truthful, esp. of oracles; of things, uncorrupt, pure from all deceit, Pi.P.1.86

ἁψίκορος.definition: quickly sated: hence, fickle; Act., quickly sating, Plu.2.20b; ib.7b

ἀψίνθιον.definition: wormwood, Artemisia Absinthium; = Artemisia monosperma, Aq.Pr.5.4

ἀψυχία.definition: Ion. swooning, syncope, Id.VM10; want of spirit, faintheartedness, A.Th.259,383, E.Alc.642, etc

ἄω.definition: = , blow, only in impf; = sleep, only in aor., Od.19.342; 3.151; ib.490; contr., 16.367

ἀωροβόρος.definition: devouring those who die untimely, PMag.Par.1.2867

ἀωτέω.definition: sleep, Ep. Verb, only pres., Il.10.159; Od.10.548: abs., Simon.37.5:—in Hsch., , but expld. by AB476, cf. Suid. ; perh. to be read in B.8.13 for

ἀβοηθί.definition: Adv. without assistance, prob. in Euph.54.2

ἀγαμένως.definition: Adv. part. pres. of with admiration or respect, Arist.Rh.1408a18; Pl.Phd.89a

ἁγιώδως.definition: Adv. in sacred manner: Sup. dub. in Ph.1.675

ἀγορῆθεν.definition: Adv.from the assembly or market, Il.2.264, al

ἄγχι.definition: Poet. Adv. of place, near, Il.5.185, Od.3.449; of Time, Sapph.Supp.19.7

ἀγχόθεν.definition: Adv. from near at hand, Hdt.4.31, Luc.Syr.D.28

ἁδόθεν.definition: Adv. from the nether world, Hermesian.7.3

ἀδυσκόλως.definition: Adv. without complaint, prob. in Vit.Philonid.p.13 C

ἀεί.definition: Adv. ever, always, Hom., etc.; with other; Ep., Ion., Poet., and Early Att. ; found in Att. Inscrr. to 361 B.C

ἀερόθεν.definition: Adv. out of the air, from on high, Eust.1239.10

αἰνόθεν.definition: Adv. from only in the phrase horror of horrors, Il.7.97

ἀκᾶ.definition: Dor. Adv. = softly, gently, Pi.P.4.156; cf

ἀκήν.definition: acc. form as Adv., softly, silently, Hom. mostly in phrase Il.3.95, al.; also 4.429

ἀκλητί.definition: Adv. uncalled, unbidden, Com. ap. Zen.2.46 [where

ἀκμήν.definition: acc. of used as Adv., as yet, still; = Cratin.in Cod.Vat.Gr.122: perh., = much, OGI201.13

ἀκμητεί.definition: and Adv. without toil, easily, J.BJ1.16.2, Lib.Or.59.71

ἀκρόθεν.definition: Adv. from the end or top, Arist.Phgn.811a29, Nic.Th.337

ἀκρόθι.definition: Adv. at the end, c. gen., Arat.308

ἀκρονυχί.definition: Adv. with tip of nail, for AP12.126

ἀλλά.definition: Conj., orig. neut. pl. of otherwise: used; in simple oppositions, but

ἄλλοθι.definition: Adv. elsewhere, in another place, esp. in a; in other ways, from other causes, Th.1.16 ; in no other way, Pl.Prt.324e, Smp.184e, etc

ἄλλως.definition: Dor. A.D.Adv.175.13, Adv. of; at all events, any how, . . alone, Id.8.30; . . A.Ch.680

ἅμα.definition: Dor. q.v.: : A. Adv. at once, at the same time, mostly of Time, freq. added to . . Il.8.64; 1.417; 24.773; S.Ph.772, cf. 119; Ant.281:-with only, Il.3.109; with . . Hes.Th.677. 2. . . . . , partly . . partly . . , Pl.…

ἀμάτα.definition: Adv., = SIG421 A5,26 : but perh. cf

ἀμαχητί.definition: Adv. of sq., without battle, without stroke of sword, Il.21.437, Hdt.1.174

ἀμβλήδην.definition: Adv., poet. for :—with sudden bursts, Il.22.476

ἀμβολαδίς.definition: Adv., poet. for either in turns, or with uplifted arms, Call.Dian.61

ἁμῆ.definition: Adv., in a certain way, Hp. ap. Gal.19.78: elsewh. in the phrase somehow or other, Ar.Ach.608, Pl.Prt.331d, R.474c, etc

ἀμοιβαδίς.definition: Adv., by turns, alternately; in turn, again, Epigr.Gr.998.9

ἁμοῦ.definition: Adv. of , somewhere, somewhere or other , Lys.24.20; no-where else at all, IG2.11

ἀμφί.definition: Prep. with gen., dat., acc.: (cf. Skt. abhitas; causal, about, for the sake of, fight for the possession of a spring, Il.16.285; Pi.P.9.105, A.Ag.62; E.Andr.123: like in entreaties, . . for Phoebus' sake, A.R.2.216

ἀμφιπλίξ.definition: Adv. astride: hence, gripping with coils, of serpents, S.Fr.596

ἀμφοτέρῃ.definition: Adv. in both ways, by both branches, of a river, 1.75: Argive Mnemos.47.160

ἀμφουδίς.definition: Adv., only Od.17.237 lifting by the middle

ἁμῶς.definition: or Adv. from obsol. = only in form in some way or other, Ar.Th.429, Lys.13.7, Pl.Prt.323c, Epicur.Fr.607, etc

ἀνά.definition: Aeol., Thess., Arc., Cypr. Prep; of Place, up, from bottom to top, up along, Od.22.176; up to, ib.239; Il.13.547; Hdt.2.96; up-stream, GDI5016.11 ; Ar.Ach.796 ; simply, along, Tab.Heracl.2.32

ἀνάκαρ.definition: Adv., up to or towards the head, upwards, Hp. ap. Gal.19.79

ἀναφανδά.definition: Adv. visibly, openly, before the eyes of all, opp. Od.3.221, 11.455: as neut. Adj., A.R.4.84

ἄνδιχα.definition: Adv., asunder, in twain; as Prep., c. gen., apart from, A.R.1.908, 2.927; AP5.4 :—hence to be divided in opinion, of judges, IG9.333

ἀνέδην.definition: Adv., let loose, freely, without; licentiously, violently, Plb.15.20.3

ἀνειμένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass. of at ease; without accent, opp. Anon.in SE8.23

ἀνέκαθεν.definition: of Time, from the first, being Pylians by origin, Id.5.65, cf. 7.221; more often with the Art., 2.43, cf. 6.128; 5.55, cf. 1.170, 6.35; of ancestral renown, 6.125; OGI566

ἀνεῳγότως.definition: Adv. pf. part. of , openly, Gloss

ἀνηρτημένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass. of disconnectedly, incoherently, Herm.in Phdr.p.177A

ἀνιδιτί.definition: Adv., without sweat or toil, Pl.Lg.718e

ἀνισάκις.definition: Adv. an unequal number of times, Theo Sm.p.26H., al., Nicom.Ar.2.17

ἄντα.definition: Ep. Adv. over against, face to face, in Hom; as Prep. with gen., like over against, Il.2.626; . . before her cheeks, Od.1.334; 4.115; also of persons, before thee, to thy face, ib.160, cf. 22.232; so in Il.21.331, wit…

ἄντην.definition: Ep. Adv., against, over against; as Prep. c. gen., only in late Ep., as Nic.Th.474, Opp.C.3.210

ἀντί.definition: Prep. governing gen.:—orig. sense, over against; of Place, opposite, over against, formerly quoted from several places of Hom., as Il.21.481 8.233; so 15.415, cf. Od.4.115, Hes.Op.727; but is so used in X.An.4.7.6, IG…

ἀντιπέραν.definition: Ion. Adv. = v.l; Adj., Asia and the opposite coast, Mosch.2.9

ἅπαξ.definition: Adv. once, once only, once for all, first; c. gen., Hdt.2.59, 4.105; also Id.2.132

ἀπαυτίκα.definition: Adv. strengthd. for on the spot, dub. l. in D.C.40.15

ἀπειραχῶς.definition: Adv. in an infinite number of ways, Plu.2.732f, Procl.in Prm.p.581 S

ἀπειροβίως.definition: Adv. without experience of life, Hierocl.p.55 A

ἀπέκ.definition: Prep. with gen., away out of, v.l. in h.Ap.110

ἀπονητί.definition: Adv. of without fatigue, Hdt.3.146, E.Fr.lyr.3, Luc.Rh.Pr.8, al

ἀπονόσφι.definition: before a vowel Ep. Adv. far; c. gen., following its case, far away from, Il.1.541; Od.5.113; ib.12.33

ἀποπρό.definition: Adv. afar off, Il.16.669; as Prep. c. gen., away from, ib.7.334, cf. E.HF1081, Or.142, etc

ἀπρίξ.definition: Adv. fast, tight, S.Aj.310; Subst., a kind of , EM132.53

ἆρα.definition: interrog. Particle, implying anxiety or; alone, it simply marks the question, the nature of which is determined by the context: e.g. in D.35.44 a negative answer is implied in the question . . ; but an affirmative in …

ἄρδην.definition: Adv. contr. for lifted up on

ἁρμοῖ.definition: Adv. just, lately, A.Pr.615, Theoc.4.51; just, a little, ib.4, Steril.213

ἀρχῆθεν.definition: Dor. Adv. from the beginning, from; with neg., . . not at all, Hdt.5.18; cf. I.1 c

ἀστακτί.definition: Adv. of sq., not in drops, i.e. in floods, S. , Pl.Phd.117c

ἄστυδε.definition: Adv. into, to, or towards the city, Il.18.255, Od.17.5, and in late Prose, as Alciphr.1.1

ἄτερ.definition: Ep., Ion., Trag. Prep. with gen., without; aloof, apart from, Il.1.498; Hes.Op.91:—freq. in Trag., mostly after its case, A.Supp.377, etc.; but before it in Id.Pr.456, Supp.703 , Ch.338 , S.Ph.703 , El.866:—also in la…

αὖ.definition: Adv. of repeated action, again, anew, afresh, once; generally, again, i.e. further, moreover, ib.2.493, etc.; Pl.Tht.192b

αὖθι.definition: Adv. shortd. for of Place, on the spot; of Time, forthwith, straightway, Il.5.296, 6.281, etc.— Ep. word, borrowed by S.Fr.522; cf

αὐτοδάξ.definition: Adv. with the very teeth, women angered even to biting, Ar.Lys.687; your ferocious temper, Id.Pax607

αὐτόθι.definition: Adv. = on the spot; later of Time, on the spot, Luc.Cal.24

αὐτολεξεί.definition: Adv. with the very words, in express words, Ph.2.597

αὐτομηνί.definition: Adv. in the very month, Attic. ap. Eus.PE15.4

αὐτονυχί.definition: or Adv., that very; with the nail, EM173.57

αὐτοποδί.definition: Adv. on one's own feet, on foot, D.C.50.5

αὐτοψεί.definition: or Adv. of with one's own eyes, Jul.Ep.204, PSI3.238.11

ἄφαρ.definition: poet. Adv. straightway, forthwith, in Hom; in Thgn.716 as if Adj., swift, fleet

ἄψ.definition: Adv. of Place, backwards, back; of actions, again, in return, Il.22.277; 16.54; 6.427; 9.120; 17.543; 5.505; prob. in Epich.99; = Theoc.25.65: pleon., yet again, Il.8.335, 15.364; 18.280

ἀρετή.definition: ἡ ἀρετή, ἀρετῆς · virtù · valore · eccellenza

ἀρχή.definition: ἡ ἀρχή, ἀρχῆς · inizio · principio · potere · comando

ἁμαρτοεπής.definition: erring in words, speaking at random, Il.13.824; wine that makes men talk at random, Poet. ap. Clem.Al.Paed.2.2.28

ἀχλαινία.definition: want of a cloak or mantle, E.Hel.1282

ἀποφυτεύω.definition: strike slips or cuttings, Arist.GA761b28, al., Thphr.HP7.2.1

ἀναπήδησις.definition: palpitation of the heart, opp. Arist.Resp.480a13

ἀπαυγασμός.definition: efflux of light, radiance, effulgence, Plu.2.83d,934d

ἄσχαστος.definition: unshakable, firm, IG7.3073.163; without a gap, Eutoc.in Archim.3p.94H

ἀστερόφοιτος.definition: traversing the stars, esp. of; traversed by stars, ib.32.10, al

ἄνιππος.definition: without horse, not serving on horseback; of countries, unsuited for horses, Hdt.2.108, cf.Aen.Tact.8.4, D.H.2.13

αἰσχυνομένη.definition: sensitive plant, Mimosa asperata, Apollod. ap. Plin.HN24.167

ἀρτιθαλής.definition: just budding or blooming, AP5.197 ; Epigr.Gr.348 ; of persons, Nonn.D.3.312,al

αὐλών.definition: strait, A.Pr.731; sea- straits, channels, S.Tr.100; pipe, conduit, Pl.Ti.79a; metaph. of windpipe or duct, Arist.PA664a27, Gal.UP4.14

ἀσωτία.definition: prodigality, wastefulness, Pl.R.560e; profligacy, Ep.Eph.5.18, al.: pl., Hdn.2.5.1

ἀρακόχερσος.definition: dry and fit for sowing aracus , CPHerm.120riii 5

ἀνορροπύγιος.definition: without rump, Arist.HA525b31; without help from the tail or rump, of insects, ib.532a24

ἀναγγέλλω.definition: carry back tidings of, report; proclaim, OGI6 , SIG412.13 :—Pass., of rewards, Aen.Tact.10.15

ἀταμίευτος.definition: that cannot be stored, Ph.2.113; that; not needing to be husbanded, Max.Tyr.3.9, al

ἀστρατεία.definition: exemption from service, Ar.Pax526; she that stops an invasion, of Artemis, Paus.3.25.3

ἀναπατέω.definition: go up, go back, AB397; of horses, jib, shy, Hippiatr.26

ἀνθυποφέρω.definition: reply, rejoin, opp; use a word or phrase in reply to a question, in Pass., A.D.Pron.24.17, Synt.73.6

ἀστροθεσία.definition: group of stars, constellation, Ath.11.490f; arrangement of planets, Vett.Val.157.24

ἀνοφρυάζομαι.definition: arch one's eyebrows: metaph., to be supercilious, Com.Adesp.842

ἀπορρυΐσκω.definition: run off, of whey in making cheese, Eust.1625. 65

ἀντιχράω.definition: to be sufficient, only in aor. 1, Hdt.7.127, cf. 187

ἀστυπολία.definition: residence in a city, Hierocl.p.62 A

ἀκρόλινος.definition: at the edge of the net, Opp.C.4.383

ἀρτιφυής.definition: just born, Epigr.Gr. 334.11; of number, even, Hp.Septim.9

αὐτοάνθρωπος.definition: the ideal man, the Form of man; a very man, of a statue, Luc.Philops.18

ἀποσκύλλω.definition: pull, tear off, aor. Med. Nic.Th.690

ἀμηχανής.definition: poet. for h.Merc.447, in gen. pl

ἀντίκοιλον.definition: hollow of the instep, dub. l. in Polem.Phgn.85

ἀποδεής.definition: empty, Arist.Fr.224, Plu.2.967a; not fully manned, Id.Ant.62: metaph. of persons, Id.2.473e

ἄρρωστος.definition: weak, sickly, Arist.HA634b14; in moral sense, weak, feeble, X.Ap.30, cf. Oec.4.2

αὐξοσέληνον.definition: increase of the moon, the waxing moon, AP5.270

ἀνάλωσις.definition: outlay, expenditure, Thgn.903; wasting, consumption, Hp.Epid.6.3.1

αἶρα.definition: hammer, smith's work, Call.Fr.129; darnel, Lolium temulentum, Thphr.HP1.5.2: in pl., Ar.Fr.412, Pherecr.188, Arist.Somn.Vig.456b30, Herod.6.100, etc

ἀποδιαλύω.definition: dissipate, Antyll. ap; confute utterly, Phld.Herc. 19.16

ἀνθοβολέω.definition: bestrew with flowers, AP5.146; put forth flowers, Gp.10.2.10

ἀρρώστημα.definition: illness, sickness, Hp.Flat.9; moral infirmity, Plu.Nic.28

ἀνάτριπτος.definition: rubbed up: cloths with rough, raised pile, like plush or velvet, Dsc.3.33

ἄντανδρος.definition: instead of a man, as a substitute, Luc.DMort.16.2, etc

αὔανσις.definition: drying up, Arist.Mete.379a5, GA785a26; equivalent to in plant-life, Id.Resp.478b28

ἀνθράκωσις.definition: malignant ulcer, commonly in the; carbuncle, Gal.14.777

ἀντιπροσάγω.definition: adduce on the other side, Phld.Rh.1.377S

ἀποσφίγγω.definition: squeeze tight, compress, bind up, cj. Littré in Hp.Art.69; Luc.Luct.19; a close-packed style, Id.Rh.Pr.9

ἀσφόδελος.definition: asphodel, Asphodelus ramosus, Hes.Op.41; oxyt., as Adj., the asphodel mead which the shades of heroes haunted, Od.11.539, 24.13: generally, flowery mead, h.Merc.221, 344

ἀριθμητέος.definition: to be reckoned, counted; one must reckon, count, Thphr.Ign.3, Porph.Abst.2.38

ἀδιέξοδος.definition: that cannot be gone through; having no outlet, of places, App.Mith.100, Plu.2.957d

ἀμφίπληκτος.definition: Dor. beaten on both; Act., dashing on both sides, S.Ph.688

ἀποβιόω.definition: cease to live, Philostr.VA8.28; Hld.4.7, cf. Ant.Diog.10

ἄπτωτος.definition: = never thrown, of a wrestler; metaph., faultless, Longin.33.4, cf.Ph.1.678

ἀνεφάλλομαι.definition: leap up at, used only in part. v

ἀγχίθυρος.definition: next door, Thgn.302; near the door, of a statue, Epigr.Gr.906

ἀνθυλακτέω.definition: bark or bay in answer, Ael.NA4.19

ἀρέομαι.definition: Ion. for , v.l. in Hdt; fut. of , prob. l. in

ἀετίτης.definition: li/qos, eagle-stone, said to be found in the eagle's nest, Ael.NA1.35, Philostr.VA2.14, Dsc.5.160

ἀειθαλής.definition: evergreen, AP7.195 , 12.256 ; Chor.p.87 B.: metaph., ever-blooming, Orph.H.60.5; Men.Rh.p.404 S.; Dsc.4.88

ἄδειπνος.definition: without the evening meal, supperless, Hp.Aph.5.41, X.An.4.5.21, etc

ἀσκέρα.definition: winter shoe with fur lining, Hippon.19, Lyc.855, 1322, Herod.2.32:—Dim. metapl. pl. Hippon.18

ἀντιπυργόω.definition: build a tower over against, c. acc. cogn., reared up this rival city, i. e. the Areopagus as a rival to the Acropolis, A.Eu.688

αὐτότοκος.definition: young and all, A.Ag.137 : but; parox. Act., self-producing, Nonn.D.8.81, etc

ἀκατάστατος.definition: unstable, unsettled; not making any deposit, Hp.Prorrh.1.32

ἀμφελίσσω.definition: poet. and Ion. for wrap, fold about, Id.Andr.425; enwrap, Aret.CA2.4:—Med., close their jaws upon the children, Pi.N.1.43

ἀποτρίτωσις.definition: boiling down to a third part, Orib.Fr.51, cf. Aët.3.77

ἀβλαβία.definition: poet. for II, h.Merc.393; personified, SIG1014.67 ; sg. in later Prose, Phld.Piet.28

ἀναίρω.definition: raise, lift up, Aen.Tact.23.4:—Med., E.El.102:—Pass., of Ganymede, AP12.67

ἀμφάκανθος.definition: surrounded with prickles, of the hedgehog, Ion Trag.38

ἀντονομάζω.definition: name instead, call by a new name, c; plea of avoidance and confession, Arg.Lycurg., cf. Hermog.Stat.4

ἀντίφημι.definition: say 'no', contradict, abs., Pl.Grg.501c, Arist.APr.65b1; contradict a thing, Id.Insomn.462a7; ib.460b19

ἀεροφόβος.definition: afraid of the air, Cael.Aur. CP3.12.108

ἀπομολυβόω.definition: turn into lead, Lyd.Mens.4.107:—also written detach by melting off the lead, Gloss

ἀναρχαΐζω.definition: bring back to old ways, AP7.707

ἄτοπος.definition: out of place, out of the way: hence; unwonted, extraordinary, of symptoms, Hp.Aph.4.52: Comp., ibid.; E.IT842 , cf. Arist.EN1149a15; Ar.Av.276; Id.Ec.956

ἀγγεῖον.definition: Ion. vessel for holding liquid; receptacle, reservoir, X.Oec.9.2, Pl.Lg.845e; bed of the sea, Pl.Criti.111a

ἀμίλτωτος.definition: not painted red, PMag.Par.1.2372, PMag.Berol.1.377, etc

ἀποπτυστήρ.definition: one that spits out: a horse that will not bear the bit, Opp.H.2.11

ἀγαλματίας.definition: like a statue, beautiful as one, Philostr.VS2.25.6

ἀνερείδω.definition: prop up, rest a thing on, dub. in Aristaenet.1.22

ἀστροδίαιτος.definition: living under the stars, i.e. in the open air, Orph.H.11.5 codd

ἀφθορία.definition: incorruption, prob. l. for in Ep.Tit.2.7, cf. Them.in Ph.82.22

ἄπεργος.definition: idle, f.l. for Artem.1.42; obsolete, Phld. Rh.1.354 S

ἀγώνισις.definition: a contending for a prize, Th.5.50

ἀϊδής.definition: unseen, Hes.Sc.477; Act., blind, IG4.951.125 , dub. in Thgn.1310

ἀνομολόγητος.definition: agreed on again, under a renewed; inconsistent, Ptol.Tetr.47

ἀφέλκω.definition: Ion. fut. E.Hec.142; draw off liquor, Archil.4; A.Eu.184

αὐθέκαστος.definition: one who calls things by their right; of style, inartificial, plain, D.H.Comp.22

ἀντέγκειμαι.definition: Pass., to be urgent on the other side; to be inserted in place of another letter , Eust.1863.56

ἀλοιμός.definition: polishing or plastering, of wall- decoration, S.Fr.69, cf. IG22.463.85

ἀρτιχάρακτος.definition: newly graven, Epigr; newly ploughed, Nonn.D.2.65

ἀνδρογυνία.definition: Pythag., = i.e. odd and even , Theol.Ar.32

ἀντεπελαύνω.definition: rush to meet, attack one, App.Pun.26

ἀνέλαιος.definition: without oil, Thphr.CP2.3.8; without olives, Str.17.1.35

ἀστυπολέω.definition: go up and down in a city, live in it, frequent the streets, Theopomp. Hist.114a, Max.Tyr.8.1 and 9

ἀγαθοδότης.definition: the giver of good, Diotog. ap. Stob.4.7.62. Adv. Eustr.in EN387.11

ἄμβλωσις.definition: abortion, Lys.Fr.8; abortion of buds in vines and trees, Thphr.CP5.9.13

ἀφόμοιος.definition: unlike, Dsc.5.102:—but; likened, made like, in Subst. copy, LXXSi.Prol.21

ἀπόσχισις.definition: division, branching, of a vein, Arist.HA514a13, Aret.CA2.2

ἀπάτημα.definition: deceit, stratagem, Aen.Tact.23.6; beguilement, Gorg.Hel.10 ; AP7.195

ἀναφυσιάω.definition: fetch a deep-drawn breath. blow, of a dolphin, Hes.Sc.211; A.R.2.431

ἀργυροθώραξ.definition: with a silver breastplate, Iamb.post Polem.p.49 Hinck

ἀϊδρείη.definition: Ep. and Ion. want of knowledge, ignorance, Od.12.41, Hdt.6.69; also in pl., Od.10.231, 11.272

ἀνεπίστητος.definition: not the object of knowledge, Eustr.in APo45.9

ἀναρροιζέω.definition: rush up, rush back, Plu.2.979e; hurtle in air, of arrows, Nonn.D.29.289

ἀναρρέω.definition: flow, stream back, Pl.Ti.78d; of blood, IG12.115 ; of smoke, Philostr.Im.2.27

ἀνώλεθρος.definition: indestructible, Parm.8.3; Act., not deadly, harmless, Paus.10.17.12; of symptoms, not fatal, Aret.SD1.5

ἀρρητόρευτος.definition: not taught rhetoric, Tz.H.11.217; unworthy of an orator, Sopat.Rh.inRh.8.58 W

ἀνάποσις.definition: swallowing up, of rivers, Olymp.in Mete.218.12, al

ἀποπνεύματος.definition: away from the wind, sheltered, Thphr.Vent.30

ἀθλοφόρος.definition: Ep. and Lyr. bearing away; prize-giving, IG7.530.3

αἰδόφρων.definition: gen. onos, regardful of mind, compassionate, S.OC237 ; respectful, E.Alc.659

ἀγρονόμος.definition: haunting the country; Subst. a magistrate in charge of the country districts, Pl.Lg.760b, al., cf. Arist.Pol.1321b30

ἀρτυσία.definition: art of seasoning, cj. Mein. in Alex.36.9

ἀπορρύπτω.definition: cleanse thoroughly, Asp.in EN25.1; wash away, prob. cj. in AP9.815

ἀνακτητέος.definition: able to be recovered; one must recover, recruit, Antyll. ap. Orib.7.12.5

ἀνακύκλησις.definition: a coming round again, circuit; in Metric, recurrence of form, strophic arrangement, Heph.17.4, Poëm.3.2

αἰγίπλαγκτος.definition: wandered over by goats:—pr.n., a mountain near Megara, A.Ag.303

ἀντέγκλημα.definition: counter-claim or -charge, Hermog.Stat.2, cf. II: pl., Corn.Rh.p.387H

ἄφθορος.definition: uncorrupt, of young persons, Artem.5.95; pure, unadulterated, BGU1107.7 , al

ἀναρτέομαι.definition: Ion. Verb, used only in pf. Pass. , to be ready, prepared to do, c. inf., Hdt.1.90; 6.88

ἀσυνθετέω.definition: break covenant, be faithless, LXXPs.72.15, al.; opp. Chrysipp.Stoic.2.63

ἀμφικίων.definition: gen. with pillars all round, S.Ant.285

ἁλιανθής.definition: prop. sea-blooming, hence = bright purple, AP5.227 , 7.705 , cj.in Orph.A.586

ἀκατάβολος.definition: unpaid, outstanding, of arrears of taxation, IG5.1433

ἀμφίδρομος.definition: running both ways; pr. n. divinity connected with A.Fr.222

ἀθλοθέτης.definition: one who awards the prize, the judge or steward in the games, Pl.Lg.764d, Arist.EN1095b1, IG1.188, etc

ἀπάλαιστος.definition: not to be thrown in wrestling, unconquerable, Pi.N.4.94

ἁλιοτρεφής.definition: feeding in the sea, sea-reared, Od.4.442

ἀϋτή.definition: cry, shout, esp. battle-shout, war-cry, Il.2.153; 6.328; Pi.N.9.35: generally, A.Ch.564; of the blast of the trumpet, Id.Pers.395; of the creaking of the axle, Parm.1.6. .868 .)

ἀναβράσσω.definition: throw up, Arist.Mete.368b29; esp. of the sea, spray dashed up, A.R.2.566, cf. LXXWi.10.19

ἀνάστημα.definition: height, Thphr.HP9.9.5; protuberance, prominence, Simp.in Cael.480.15

ἀντισηκόω.definition: counterbalance, compensate for, c. dat. rei, A.Pers.437: c. gen., some god ruins thee, making compensation for, balancing, thy former happiness, E.Hec.57, cf. D.S.31.12: c. acc., I will compensate the favour by honour…

ἀποκολλάω.definition: unglue, dissolve, Gal.18.481 : metaph., Eun.Hist.p.264D.; strip off, Eust.854.33

ἀρισταρχέω.definition: rule in the best way, Arist.Pol.1273b5 codd

ἀτμιδόομαι.definition: Pass., to be turned into vapour, Arist.Mete.346b25

ἀντίπεμψις.definition: sending back of sound, echo, Arr.An.6.3.3

ἀείκλαυτος.definition: filled with perpetual lamentation, prob. in Hymn. ap. Hippol.Haer.4.36

ἀνέμπληστος.definition: of which one cannot have one's fill, v.l. in Them.Or.2.40b

ἀναπτερυγίζω.definition: raise the wings and fly away, Ael.NA4.30: metaph., Phld.Vit.p.21J

ἀποπατέω.definition: fut. Ar.Pl.1184, but; pass with the excrement, void, Ar.Ec.351

ἀναθάλλω.definition: aor. Ael.VH5.4, NA2.25: aor. 2; trans., make to flourish, revive, LXXSi.11.22, 50.10, Ep.Phil.l. c

ἀττάραγος.definition: crumb, morsel of bread, Ath.14.646c: metaph., the least crumb, bit, Call.Epigr.47.9

ἀποβλητέος.definition: to be thrown away, rejected; one must reject, A.D.Conj.226.10

ἀπροϊδής.definition: unforeseen, Nic.Th.2,18; Act., unforeseeing, prob. in Nonn.D.9.102, 48.757

ἀποτροπία.definition: Ep. poet. for foreg. I, A.R.4.1504

ἀτίετος.definition: unhonoured, A.Eu.385, 839 (both; Act., not honouring or regarding, E.Ion701

ἀσθένημα.definition: weakness, ailment, Arist.GA726a15, Gp.1.12.27; weakness of conscience, Ep.Rom.15.1

ἀστυτίς.definition: lettuce, used as an anti- aphrodisiac, Lycus ap.Ath.2.69e, Gp.12.13.2

ἀγρειοσύνη.definition: clownishness: or a rude, vagrant life, AP6.51

ἀκρόδετος.definition: bound at end or top, AP6.5

ἀρτιασμός.definition: game of odd and even, Arist.Rh.1407b3

ἀγριόφωνος.definition: with rough voice or tongue, like Od.8.294; App.Anth.3.74.22

ἀποσυσσιτέω.definition: absent oneself from the public table , Pl.Lg.762c

ἀναρροχθέω.definition: retire with a roar, of waves, Orph.A.706

ἀκοσμία.definition: disorder, Pl.Grg.508a, Ael.Tact.41.2; absence of chaos, Dam.Pr.205

ἀπομονόομαι.definition: Pass., to be excluded, from; to be left alone, Plu.Phil.18

ἀπερίστατος.definition: not stood around: and so; unguarded, Plb.6.44.8

ἀργυρόω.definition: to cover with silver, Dialex.2.13; metaph. of persons, rewarded with silver wine-cups, Pi.N.10.43; also songs with silvered brow, i.e. mercenary, Id.I.2.8

ἀνταυλέω.definition: play on the flute against, Agath.4.23

ἀκηρυκτεί.definition: and Adv. without flag of truce, Th.2.1; D.C.50.7

ἀπόπλυμα.definition: water in which anything has been diluted or dissolved, mead, lime-water, D.S.5.26,28; Sor.1.59

ἀκαταλληλία.definition: failure to conform with rules; Gramm., false concord, A.D.Synt.167.1

ἀνεπίκριτος.definition: not decided, indeterminate; indistinct, indeterminate, Plot.3.6.4

ἀμμόνιτρον.definition: potash mixed with sand, fused together to produce glass, Plin.HN36.194

ἄγορος.definition: = used only by E. in lyr., generally in pl., as IT1096, El.723, Andr.1037; sg. only HF412

ἀπαρτάω.definition: hang up: strangle, E.Andr.412; swing; metaph., make dependent upon, Luc.Tim.36:—Med., make dependent on oneself, Plu.CG8

ἁλίπλοος.definition: contr. covered with; later Act., sailing on the sea, Arion l.17, cf. Apollod.Hist.209: as Subst., seaman, fisher, A.R.3.1329, Call.Del.15

ἁλιερκής.definition: sea-fenced, sea-girt, of Aegina, Pi.O.8.25; of the Isthmus, Id.I.1.9; Id.P.1.18

ἀφυσγετός.definition: as Adj., filthy, Nic.Al.342; abundant, ib.584

ἀπάρχης.definition: title of official in Lesbos, IG12.68.5, 69b6

ἄδετος.definition: unbound, loose, Hp.Art.44; not; free, D.24.169,Aristaenet.1.20

ἀρισθάρματος.definition: best in the chariot-race, the prize of the best chariot, Pi.P.5.30

ἀντίον.definition: a part of the loom, Ar.Th.822, cf; generally, loom, LXX2 Ki.21.19, al

ἀθρυψία.definition: a simple way of life, Plu.2.609c

ἀντανακράζω.definition: cry out in turn or reply, App.Mith.26

ἁμαξόβιος.definition: living in wagons, as nomad tribes do, Porph.Abst.3.15

ἀπανατέλλω.definition: poet, make to rise, raise up from, v.l. in Opp.C.2.97,563

ἀντεμπείρω.definition: in Pass., resist and become fixed, of barbs, Paul.Aeg.6.88

ἀμυδρότης.definition: dimness, Ph.2.432;faintness, of the pulse, Gal.9.15; indistinctness, opp. Plot.1.4.3

ἀκράτεια.definition: want of power, debility; incontinence, want of self-control, opp. Pl.R.461b, Lg.734b, etc.; ib.886a, etc., cf. Ph.2.406

ἀναζυμόω.definition: raise as by leaven, loosen, Thphr.CP3.23.4, cf. Gal.11.435:—Pass., ferment, D.S.1.7

ἀνθυπερηφανέω.definition: to be haughty in return, August. ap. Suet.Vit. Horat

ἀθεεί.definition: Adv., without the aid of God, mostly with neg., Od.18.353, Philostr.VS1.21.2, D.C.59.12, Plot.4.3.16, Nonn.D.7.178, etc

ἀπείρητος.definition: Dor. and Att. also; Act., without making trial of, without making an attempt upon, c. gen., . . of a lion, Il.12.304: abs., making no attempt or venture, Pi.I.4.30

ἀλήμων.definition: wanderer, rover, Od.19.74; of planets, AP9.25 : abs., Od.17.376.—Ep. word

ἀκατάπαυστος.definition: not to be set at rest, incessant; not to be checked, irresistible, PMag.Par.1.2364

ἀποχραίνω.definition: colour, tint evenly, Pl.Lg.769a, cf. Tim.Lex. s.v. —Pass., take a tone, Pl.R.586b; of fruit, colour, Arist.Col.796a24

ἀντικαίω.definition: Att. set on fire in turn, Pl.Ti.65e

ἅδρυνσις.definition: coming to maturity, Arist.Metaph.1065b20, Ph.201a19, Thphr.CP2.12.1:—written Simp.in Epict.p.32 D

ἀνιάομαι.definition: cure again, repair, dub. in Hdt.7.236

ἀσαπής.definition: not decayed, Hp.Epid.5.27, Arist.Pr.909b4, Thphr.HP3.12.3. Adv. = , Hp.Acut.16

ἀνορέα.definition: more common in Ion. form , Pi.O.8.67, al., Theoc.29.19

ἄπλωτος.definition: not navigated, not navigable, Arist.Mir.839b13; Ph.2.108; navigation was stopped, App.Mith.93

ἀρκτόχειρ.definition: with bear's paws for hands, Artem.5.49

ἀμίτρωτος.definition: not bound with a head-band, Nonn.D.35.220

ἀντιζυγία.definition: equivalence, Theol.Ar.57; diametrical opposition, Vett. Val.123.26

ἀντισήπω.definition: make to putrefy in turn, Gal.11.608

αὐτόχρονος.definition: being its own time, Simp.in Ph.785.2

ἀκροφύσιον.definition: snout or pipe of pair of; comet's tail, D.C.78.30

αὐλάρχης.definition: chief of the court, mayor of the palace, LXX2 Ki.8.18:—hence Subst. ib.3 Ki.3.1

ἀπογυμνάζω.definition: bring into hard exercise, ply one's tongue hard, A.Th.441; Arist.HA624a25

ἀπατήλιος.definition: poet. Adj. guileful, wily, skilled in wiles, Od.14.288; ib.127; of a person, Nonn.D.46.10, al

ἀπομερισμός.definition: = of water from an aqueduct; fragmentation, Procl.Inst.27

ἄλκιμος.definition: also S.Aj.401: :—stout; fortifying, Plu.2.669b s.v.l.; giving succour, PMag.Leid.W.14.10

ἄθαπτος.definition: unburied, Il.22.386, Moschio Trag.6.32; unworthy of burial, AP9.498

ἄργιλλα.definition: or underground dwelling, so called; = Gal.12.438, 19.90

ἀναγρύζω.definition: strengthd. for to mutter, grunt, Ar.Nu.945: c. neg., Crates Com.1 D., cf. X.Oec.2.11

ἀποσπουδάζω.definition: dissuade eagerly; slight, despise, ib.1.7; show lack of interest in, Id.VS1.17.2

ἀπαληθεύω.definition: speak the whole truth, X.Oec.3.12: c. acc., Ael.Fr.62

ἁπλήγιος.definition: clad in a single garment: generally, = Eup.222

ἀνισεπίπεδος.definition: having unequal plane faces, of certain solid numbers, e.g. , Iamb.in Nic.p.93P

ἀραῖος.definition: Pass., prayed to or entreated, = S.Ph.1182; prayed against, accursed, A.Ag.1565 ; Id.Th.898 ; you adjured me under a curse, S.OT276

ἀπάτερθε.definition: before a vowel Adv. apart; as Prep. c.gen., far away from, Il.5.445, cf. Thgn.1153; IG14.2123

ἀποπορπάω.definition: or fix in the safety-pin and excise, Hippiatr.12

αἰθαλόω.definition: to soil with soot or smoke, E.El.1140:—Pass., burn to soot, Dsc.1.66; poet., to be laid waste by fire, Lyc.141

ἁλουργία.definition: Ion. purple-dyeing, GDI5633; purple clothing, Philostr.VA4.21

ἀποσκοτίζω.definition: remove darkness, stand out of his light, Plu.2.605e; is f.l. in D.L.6.38

ἀποδειλιάω.definition: fut. to be very fearful, play; shrink from . ., X.Lac.10.7

ἀφηρωΐζω.definition: aor. canonize as a hero, IG12.864, al

ἀπονοσφίζω.definition: put asunder, exclude from; bereave or rob of, S.Ph.979:—Pass., to be robbed of, h.Merc.562

ἄπους.definition: gen. without foot or feet; without the use of one's feet, lame, S.Ph.632; bad of foot, X.Cyn.3.3; Arist.HA487b24, cf. Metaph.1022b35, de An.422a29

ἀκρότονος.definition: strained to the utmost, muscular, Metrod.Sceps.14

ἀποβλίττω.definition: cut out the comb from the hive: hence, steal away, carry off, Ar.Av.498: aor. Med. cj. Reisk. in AP7.34

ἀντικατάγω.definition: bring in instead:—Pass., come into the place of another, Ti.Locr.101d

ἀποτελειόω.definition: or bring to maturity, Aristid.Or.43.13:—Pass., come to maturity, Arist.HA576b7

ἀφηνιαστής.definition: refusing the reins, ib.114; rebellious, ib.337, al

ἀντεγγράφω.definition: insert one name instead of another, Arist.Ath.36.2, D.25.73

ἀνύπτιος.definition: not passive, of reciprocal Verbs, D.L.7.64

ἀγχιβαθής.definition: deep inshore, Od.5.413, cf; of persons, standing deep in water, Nonn.D.10.166

ἀγκύλος.definition: crooked, curved; of style, intricate, Luc.Bis Acc.21; catchy, Alciphr.3.64; in good sense, terse, D.H.Th.25 . Adv. ib.31; intricately, Procl.in Prm.p.525 S., Dam.Pr.187

ἀπορριπίζω.definition: blow away, Arist.Pr.947a20; blow out or back, v.l. in D.H.Comp.14; cf

ἀντιβίην.definition: Adv., against, face to face, Il.1.278; 21.226, cf.5.220, Orph.L.26

ἀποκλαδεύω.definition: lop off the branches, Ph.Bybl. ap. Eus.PE1.10

ἀργυροποιΐα.definition: production of silver, in Alchemy, Ps.-Democr.Alch.p.49B

ἀποχωρίζω.definition: separate, set apart, detach, Lys.16.16; separate and put into one class, Pl.Plt.262e; ib.289d

ἀνταυγάζω.definition: = Hld.1.2, cf. 9.14; trans., expose to the light, illuminate, Ph.2.260

αἱματάω.definition: to be bloodthirsty, dub. l. Alcm.68

ἀποσφακελίζω.definition: to have one's limbs frost-bitten and; fall into convulsions, Plu.Lyc.16

ἀπόθλιμμα.definition: expressed juice, Dsc.1.110; solid residue after expression of juice, Gal.11.845

ἀντιχαίρω.definition: rejoice in turn or answer, S.Ant.149

ἀπότροφος.definition: reared away from home, Hdt.2.63; of birds, Arist.HA536b16: c. gen., reared apart from, Plu.2.917c

ἀποχαλκίζω.definition: strip of brass, i.e. of money, pun on in AP11.283

ἀναψηλαφάω.definition: retry, in Law, Just.Nov.82.11.1:—Pass., ib.113.1 Intr

ἀπῳδέω.definition: v.l. for in Plu.2.1043b: metaph., go wrong, . . prob. in Phld.Po.994.4

ἀπόβλεψις.definition: of a place, look towards . ., Gp.2.3.7

ἀντεράω.definition: rival in love, Id.2.972d; rival one in love for . ., E.Rh.184: abs., jealous love, Plu.Lyc.18

ἀπαμπαίομαι.definition: Cret. for beat off, of dogs, GDI4998ii17

ἀσύγκτητος.definition: not capable of being acquired with other things, Secund.Sent.14

ἄχυλος.definition: without juice, insipid, Thphr.CP6.19.4, Xenocr.18, Diocl.Fr.138: Comp., Ath.Med. ap.Orib.1.2.14

αὐτοψυχή.definition: absolute soul, Herm.in Phdr.p.75 A., cf. Plot.5.9.13, Jul.Ep.89b

ἀντίτονος.definition: strained against, resisting; Subst. guy-ropes securing torsion- engines, Plu.Marc.15, Ph.Bel.99.47

ἄγγος.definition: vessel to hold liquids, e.g. wine; for dry substances, cradle, Hdt.1.113, E.Ion32,1337; casket, S.Tr.622; cinerary urn, Id.El.1118,1205; coffin, CIG3573

αἰθερολόγος.definition: talking of ether and the like, of Thales, Anaximen. ap.D.L.2.4: hence ib.2.5, cf. 8.50

ἀρχέβακχος.definition: leader of title of Dionysus, Wiener Denkschr.44.104

ἀνδρογύνης.definition: Adj., common to men and women, baths used by both at once, AP9.783

ἀτίμωσις.definition: dishonouring, c. gen; = capitis deminutio, J.AJ19.1.1

ἀμοχθεί.definition: or Adv. without toil, A.Pr.210, E.Ba.194

ἀμυστίζω.definition: drink at one draught, E.Cyc.565: pres., Plu.2.650c

ἀνείρομαι.definition: used by Hom. only in pres., whereas Att; c. acc. rei, ask about, Od.13.238: in Prose also Pl.Men.74c

ἀναφύω.definition: aor. Pass. LXX1 Ki.5.6, part; abs., produce vegetation, Arist.Fr.252

ἀνήνυστος.definition: of none effect, ineffectual; impossible of fulfilment, Emp.12

ἄκμηνος.definition: fasting from food, four times in Il.19.163, 207, 320, 346 ; also in Lyc.672; Nic.Th.116; Call.Fr.anon.4

ἀνάλιπος.definition: Dor. for barefoot, f.l. in Theoc.4.56

ἀτράχηλος.definition: without neck, of the crab, AP6.196; short-necked, bull-necked, Telesp.55 H., Gal.5.383

ἀνεχέγγυος.definition: unwarranted, because they had no sure confidence in themselves, Th.4.55

ἀρτάω.definition: fut. AP6.245 : aor. I; more freq. Pass., to be hung upon, hang upon, E.Hipp.857, Pl.Ion533e, etc.; E.Hipp.779

ἀπόκλεισις.definition: a shutting out, there would be a complete stoppage to their works, Id.6.99

ἁπάντῃ.definition: Adv., everywhere, all round about, Od.8.278; Il.7.183, cf. 186; Pl.Lg.752a

ἀξιόθεος.definition: worthy of God, Oenom. ap. Eus.PE5.34; worth seeing, Alciphr.3.55:—in poet. forms Epigr.Gr.981; ibid

ἀχειρία.definition: want of hands: hence, awkwardness, Hp.Morb.1.1, Apollon.Cit.1

ἀνταναβοάω.definition: cry out in answer or opposition, App.BC2.131

ἀλφιτηδόν.definition: Adv. like Dsc.Eup.2.51; of fractures, where bone is comminuted, Gal.10.424, Paul.Aeg.6.89

ἀνταποστροφή.definition: turning away from one another, of places which face opposite ways, Str.6.1.5

ἀπαίτημα.definition: demand, BGU1113.15; that which is demanded, Secund.Sent.7

αἰθυκτήρ.definition: rushing violently, of pigs, Opp.C.2.332; Id.H.1.368

ἀμφικαθίζομαι.definition: take a sitz-bath; causal, cause to be seated upon a ib.2.134

ἀναυδία.definition: speechlessness, Hp.Coac.353, Mul.2.126; lethargy, Antigen. ap. Cael.Aur.AP2.10

ἀργεώτας.definition: title of Apollo in Messenia, Paus.4.34.7

ἀλλοδοξέω.definition: mistake one thing for another, Pl.Tht.189d,190d

ἀνάπτωσις.definition: falling back: metaph., slackness; reclining at meals, Aristeas187,203; generally, lying down, in pl., Onos.10.11

ἁπλόθριξ.definition: gen. with plain hair, Ptol.Tetr.143, Alex.Aphr.Pr.1.2

ἀποφλοιόω.definition: peel, strip off, Nonn.D.14.380:— Med., AP6.263 :—also peel, Aët.1.129

ἄτριπτος.definition: metaph., unknown, strange, Artem.4.63; of a problem, Simp.in Ph.520.23

ἀρτότυρος.definition: bread and cheese, PMag.Lond.46.181; perh. an Adj

ἀντιφλέγω.definition: light up again or to meet one, Pi.O.3.20

ἀνάζευξις.definition: breaking up one's quarters, marching forth, Plu.Ages.22; return home, Id.Cor.31

ἀλογόομαι.definition: to be rendered irrational, Plot.5.3.10 ; non-rational, Procl.in Prm.p.617 S

ἀνοιμωκτί.definition: Adv. without need to wail, with impunity, S.Aj.1227; without wailing, Philostr.Jun.Im.10

ἀμφερυθαίνω.definition: redden, make red all over, Q.S.1.60

ἀνθολόγος.definition: flower-gathering, AP12.249 : c. gen., culling the flower of, ib.95

ἀνθρήνιον.definition: wasp's nest, Ar.V.1080, 1107; of Sophocles, Philostr.Jun.Im.13

ἀστυνομία.definition: at Rome, the city praetorship, D.C.42.22

ἀνακύκλωμα.definition: cycle, revolution, of the moon, Secund.Sent.6

ἀρτιζυγία.definition: recent union, i. e. newly married husbands, A.Pers.542

ἀνέμβατος.definition: inaccessible, Eratosth.Fr.16.14; not to be trodden, of a spot struck by a thunderbolt. Plu.Pyrrh.29

ἀνεκβάλλω.definition: draw out, of a plaster, Gal.14.242

ἀνηπλωμένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass. of at length, in detail, opp. Simp.in Ph.1215.20; Aps.p.243 H

αὐτοχειλής.definition: with the natural rim, i. e. in one piece, S.Fr.138

ἀναστρωπή.definition: word coined by Pl.Cra.409c, to explain

ἀδούλευτος.definition: one who has never been a slave, Is.Fr.138, Arr.Epict.2.10.1

ἀνθοκομέω.definition: produce flowers, of the earth, AP7.321

ἀντίδειπνος.definition: taking anothers place at dinner, Luc.Gall.9

ἀμνεῖος.definition: of lamb, lambskin cloak; or , inner membrane surrounding the foetus, Sor.1.58, Gal.UP15.4: also in neut. form Hippiatr.14; cf

ἀσύστατος.definition: unformed, Antyll. ap. Orib.6.31.5: metaph., incoherent, of Aeschylus, Ar.Nu.1367

ἀνακρίτως.definition: Adv. with a second relapse, Pall.in Hp.2.181 D

ἀναβιβασμός.definition: the throwing back the accent; Arith., sum total, HeroGeom.4.13

ἄφετος.definition: let loose, ranging at large, esp; of persons, dedicated, free from worldly business, E.Ion822, Plu.2.768b; Iamb.Myst.1.8; Max.Tyr.3.9

ἀμμοκονία.definition: sand mixed with lime, cement, Str.5.4.6, cf. Gp.2.27.4

ἄριστος.definition: best in birth and rank, noblest: hence, like a chief, Il.4.260, cf. 6.209; 2.580; 19.258; S.El.366; opp. Hdt.3.81, cf. Cic.Att.9.4.2

ἀποκαύλισις.definition: breaking off by the stalk: snapping, Luc.Merc.Cond.1

ἀντερανίζω.definition: contribute one's share in turn:—Pass., to be repaid, AP9.12

ἀπότμημα.definition: anything cut off, piece, Hp.Art.38, Gp.1.14.12

ἀγαρικόν.definition: name for various tree-fungi, Dsc.3.1, etc.: Boletus Agaricum; Agaricus dryinus; fly agaric, Amanita muscaria, l. c. Damocr. ap. Gal.14.96 : Androm. ap. Gal.14.39 .]

ἀπορραίνω.definition: spirt out, shed about; sprinkle, douche, Epict.Ench.4:—esp. in Med., sprinkle by way of lustration, IG1.121,al

αἱμωδέω.definition: to be set on edge, of the teeth, Hp.Hum.9, Cratin.3 D., cf. Orion617.30

ἀρτιλιθία.definition: exact superposition of joints, in masonry, IG7.4255.27

ἀντιπέρας.definition: Adv. over against, on the other side, c. gen., Th.2.66, etc.; X.Cyn.9.3: abs., Th.1.100, cf. 4.92

ἀντικατέχω.definition: hold fast on the other side, Hp.Art.74; Astrol., occupy incongruous position, Cat.Cod.Astr. 8.115

ἀνάγκυλος.definition: without thong , of a javelin, D.S.3.8

ἀναγκαστήρ.definition: one that constrains, the constraining spindles of Fate, IG12.447

ἀπακμάζω.definition: go out of bloom, fade away, v.l. in Pl.Ax.367b

ἀναχλίζω.definition: warm up: metaph., refurbish, cj. in Phlp.in de An.455.29

ἀνίερος.definition: unholy, unhallowed, A.Ag.220,769; receiving no victims, E.Fr.992

ἀποσωμάτωσις.definition: conversion from corporeal substance, Zos.Alch.p.107 B

ἄλλοφος.definition: Ep. for without a crest, Il.10.258, AP6.163

ἀναπεινάω.definition: to be hungry again, Lync. ap. Ath.3.109e

ἀνάθρεπτος.definition: foster-child, of a slave, Lat. verna, App.BC4.43

ἀσάλπικτος.definition: without sound of trumpet, the hour when no trumpet sounds, i.e. midnight, S.Fr.389

ἀστίτης.definition: townsman, citizen, S.Fr.92; spelt in CIG2134b23

ἄλυτος.definition: poet. Phanocl.2.1, AP6.30; of arguments or evidence, not to be confuted, irrefutable, Arist.Rh.1357b17, 1403a14; Arist.APr.70a29

ἀτέκμαρτος.definition: without distinctive mark, obscure; of persons, uncertain, inconsistent, Ar.Av.170

ἀνοκωχή.definition: redupl. form = , stay, cessation, Th.4.117; a stay in the spreading of the ulcer, Aret.SD2.9, cf. 1.8. 2. esp. cessation of arms, truce, to be at truce with one, Th.1.40; one party has a truce with another, Id.5.32. I…

ἀσφαραγέω.definition: resound, clang, of armed men, Theoc.17.94

ἀνέγρομαι.definition: late poet. form for formed from the aor. Opp.H.2.204, Q.S.5.610

ἀσύλληπτος.definition: not conceiving, Dsc.4.19; preventing conception, Aët.16.17

ἀποπροάγω.definition: only in pf. Pass., mostly part., in the second rank, of things neither good nor bad, opp. Zeno Stoic.1.48; the distn. was rejected by Aristo ib.1.83, but cf. Stoic.3.29, al.: inf. Aristo l.c

ἀμφίκομος.definition: with hair all round, AP9.516; thick-leafed, Il.17.677, cf. Archestr.Fr.9

ἀνείκαστος.definition: unattainable by conjecture, immense; incapable of artistic representation, D.Chr.12.59

ἀγκονίω.definition: v.l. for Ar.Lys.1311, as if from =

ἀσπονδία.definition: being without truce or treaty, IG22.28; implacability, Lib.Vit.1.22

ἀμέλεια.definition: indifference, negligence, Th.1.122, 5.38, etc.; towards the gods, Pl.Lg.905b, cf. ib.903a: also in pl., negligences, Id.R.443a, Arist.Rh.1370a15

ἀνακαμπή.definition: bend at the end of a rod, Bito50.10; of a tube, HeroSpir.1.8, 2.33

ἀντιδιάταξις.definition: comparison of arguments for and against a thesis, Iamb.Comm.Math.35

ἀπόφθεγμα.definition: terse pointed saying, apophthegm, of Theramenes, X.HG2.3.56; of Anaxagoras, Arist.Metaph.1009b26; of Pittacus, Id.Rh.1389a16; of the Spartans, ib.1394b34: in pl., title of work by Plu

ἀνακίνησις.definition: swinging to and fro of the arms; stirring up, excitement, S.OT727; Porph.Abst.1.41

ἀποθειόω.definition: clothe in mystical language, Philostr.Im.16.2; = in Pass., AP12.177

ἀνείλλω.definition: or = Pass., shrink up or back, Pl.Smp.206d

ἀποβελίζω.definition: take off the spit, f.l. in Sotad.Com.1.10

ἀνάσχεσις.definition: holding up, lifting up; holding in suspense, Id.Num.13

ἀειμνήμων.definition: gen. ever-remembering, of good memory, Arist.Phgn.808a37

ἀπουρόω.definition: to be driven by foul winds, Plb.16.15.4

ἀπλατής.definition: without breadth, Arist.APr.49b36; opp. Id.Top.143b14: metaph., Gal.7.410; without latitude, i.e. variation, Id.6.28. Adv. Iamb.in Nic.p.56P

ἀγλαόκωμος.definition: giving splendour to the feast, Pi.O.3.6

ἀκάκυντος.definition: = sq., Hierocl.in CA1 p.418M., cf. 3p.424M. Adv. Id.Prov.p.462B

ἀμαθία.definition: ignorance, stupidity, Heraclit.95, 109; boorishness, lack of culture, X.Ath.1.5, E.Cyc.173, Isoc.15.248

ἀκηδία.definition: Ion. = indifference; weariness, exhaustion, Luc.Herm.77, D.C.Fr.73; LXXIs.61.3

ἀνορθιάζω.definition: call out, shout aloud, And.1.29; prick up, Ph.2.188,al.:—Pass., 1.381

ἀντίφορτος.definition: return-freight, Arg.1 Ar.Ach; Subst. load which balances another, BGU248.27

αὐξιφωτέω.definition: increase in light, wax, of the moon, Vett.Val.196.16, Paul Al.M.4

ἀναπολεύω.definition: move upwards in an orbit, opp. PMag.Par.1.702

ἀμύητος.definition: uninitiated, profane, And.1.12, Lys.6.51; no true initiations, Ph.1.156

ἀπότασις.definition: lengthening, prolongation; stretching out, Sor.1.101; Plu.2.670d; Aret.SA1.6

αἰσυητήρ.definition: v.l. for , Il.24.347, expl. as or ; cf. pr. n. in Il

ἀντιδιαιρέω.definition: distinguish logically; Med., perh. distribute, Theo Gymn. ap. Gal.6.208

αἰολοδείκτης.definition: showing himself in various forms, of Phoebus; voc. cj. for Orph.H.8.12

ἀνθυπέρχομαι.definition: insinuate oneself into, creep upon in; Gramm., take the place of, A.D.Synt.95.9, 112.6

ἀντεφορμέω.definition: anchor over against the enemy, Plu.Alc.36

ἀδικία.definition: Ion. wrongdoing, injustice; wrongful act, offence, Hdt.6.136; And.1.3:—in pl., Pl.Phd.82a, etc

ἁμαρθρῖτις.definition: gout in all limbs at once, Cael.Aur. TP5.2

ἀμίαντος.definition: undefiled, pure, Thgn.447; not to be defiled, D.H.2.75

ἀμφιθνήσκω.definition: of flesh, mortify round a wound, v.l. in Hp.Fract.33; later, die around, Q.S.6.449

ἀπαλείφω.definition: pf. D.52.29:—wipe off, expunge; metaph., Plu.Alex.39

ἀλληλοφυής.definition: in pl., grown out of one another, f.l. for Placit.5.19.5

ἀποψαλίζω.definition: = cut off with shears, Dsc.1.99, Heliod. ap. Orib.48.50.1

ἀνηθοποίητος.definition: not giving exact delineation of; unprincipled, Cic.Att.10.10.5

ἀνάδομα.definition: product of digestion, cj. in Plu.2.384a

αὐτοτριάς.definition: the abstract number three, Alex.Aphr.in Metaph.836.24, Phlp.in de An.77.9

ἄχνη.definition: Dor. anything that comes off the; of liquids, foam, froth, in Hom. of the sea, Od.12.238, al.; 5.403, cf. Tim.Pers.95, A.R.2.570; of a river, D.P.693: Medic., exudation, Hp.Int.1; froth of wine, E.Or.115; dew of heave…

ἀναστεναχίζω.definition: groan oft and loudly, wail aloud, Il.10.9

ἀνευάζω.definition: fut. Nonn.D.1.20:—utter cries of; c. acc. pers., honour with such cries, Lyc.207, Arr.An.5.2.7

ἀποτροπή.definition: turning away, averting, A.Pers.217; diverting, of water, Pl.Lg.845d

ἁλμάω.definition: become mildewed, cj. in Thphr.HP7.5.4, 8.10.1, CP6.10.5

ἄμφωτος.definition: two-eared, two-handled, Od.22.10: neut. as Subst., jar, Hierocl.Facet.35

ἀπόλοιπος.definition: remaining over, left behind, LXXEz.41.15, al.; unpaid arrears, = Lat. residua, IG5.1434

αἱμαγμός.definition: bloodshed, in pl., Vett. Val.3.4, al

ἀνατυπόω.definition: describe, represent, Philostr.VA1.19, cf; remodel, transform, D.Chr.12.26, cf. Antim.81

ἀγορήνδε.definition: Adv. to the assembly or market, Il.1.54

ἀνοκώχησις.definition: glossed by Bacch. ap. Erot. s.v

ἀνακάθαρσις.definition: clearing away, of rubbish; Medic., cleansing, Gal.8.327

ἀνυπόλογος.definition: subject to no claim or charge; without deduction, CIG2693e

ἀφρογενής.definition: = foreg., Orph.Fr.183, cf. APl.4.211 ; the planet Venus, Doroth. ap. Heph.Astr.1.6

ἀπωτάτω.definition: Sup. Adv. of farthest from, D.23.166, cf. Trag.Adesp.130

ἀχάλκωτος.definition: lit. not brazened: without money, AP6.298

ἀφθόνητος.definition: unenvied, A.Ag.939; beyond the reach of; Act., bearing no grudge against, ib.13.25. Adv. Eust.823.8

ἀντιγένεσις.definition: Astrol., recasting of nativity in a later year, Vett.Val.213.20,al

ἀντεκτάσσω.definition: draw up troops in opposition, App.BC4.108

ἀνόστητος.definition: unreturning, Orph.A.1269; whence none return, AP7.467 , cf. Opp.H.3.586, etc

ἀπροσεξία.definition: want of attention, Arr.Epict.4.12.5, Sext.Sent.280a, etc

αἰγωλιός.definition: or a small kind of owl, perh. Strix flammea, Arist.HA592b11, 609a27, Ant.Lib.19.3; f.l. Arist.HA563a31

ἄναψις.definition: lighting up, kindling, D.H.2.66; of stars, Epicur.Ep.2p.39U

ἀντιμαχέω.definition: resist by force of arms, D.S.23.7; as law-term, resist, demur, AB184

ἁπαλφιτίζω.definition: mix wine with barley-meal or groats, in the Persian fashion, f.l. in Ath.10.432d

ἀριστάω.definition: inf. Ion. Hp.Vict.3.68: pf; eat a second meal, opp. Hp.V M10, Acut.30

αὐτόνεκρος.definition: verily dead, a mere corpse, Alciphr.3.7

ἀνάπλεος.definition: Att. masc. and neut. but; infected, with the body, Id.Phd.83d; Id.Smp.211e; Id.Tht.196e

ἀνάπλασις.definition: remodelling, new formation, Hp.Off.24; adjustment, ib.15; simply, modelling, shaping, Hp.Hebd. ap.Ph.1.29

ἄρριζος.definition: without roots, Arist.Resp.478b31; metaph., not rooted in . . , Them.Or.8.111b; Str.1.2.18

ἀμφασίη.definition: Ep. for speechlessness caused by fear, amazement, or rage, Il.17.695, Od.4.704, cf. A.R.3.284, BionFr.13.1

ἄκρις.definition: Ep. Noun, hill-top, mountain peak, Hom. only in Od., always in pl., windy mountain tops, Od.9.400, cf. h.Cer.382; through hill-country, Od.10.281:— sg., Epigr.Gr.1035.8

ἀποτοξεύω.definition: shoot off arrows, D.C.37.2; shoot a person, Id.Vit.Auct.24

ἀνθέλκω.definition: aor. inf. Herm.in Phdr.p.170A.:—draw or pull against, Th.4.14; pull against one another, Pl.Lg.644e; draw it in a contrary direction, Id.R.439b; D.S.30.8: metaph., of resistance of facts to suggested inference, Phld.S…

ἄκτητος.definition: not worth getting, Pl.Hp.Mi.374e; unobtainable, prob. in Phld.Herc.1251.4

αὐτουργία.definition: working on oneself, i. e. self-murder or; personal labour, opp. slave-labour, Plb.4.21.1, Plu.Cat.Ma.1, Porph.Marc.34

ἀναπαριάζω.definition: break treaties like the Parians, prov. in Ephor.107

ἀντέρεισις.definition: thrusting against, resistance; Rhet., buttressing, mutual support, of clauses in a period, Demetr.Eloc.12

ἄφυσος.definition: without flatulence, Hp.Hum.3; causing no flatulence, Diocl.Fr.128, Gal.6.540

ἀποπτίσσω.definition: strip the husk off, Dieuch. ap. Orib.4.6.4

ἀκεντρότης.definition: absence from a cardinal point, Demoph. ap. Jul.Laod.inCat.Cod.Astr.5.189

ἀπελεγκτής.definition: one who refutes, Oenom. ap. Eus.PE6.7

ἀτονία.definition: slackness, enervation, debility, Hp.Aër.20; not stretched, slack, relaxed, of the limbs, Hp.Aër.3 , 19; lacking in elasticity, of strands in torsion-engine, Ph.Bel.58.18; D.S.1.41; Aret.SD2.9; of fruit, insipid, Dsc.1…

ἀντιπρόσωπος.definition: with the face towards, facing; Subst. prow, Artem.2.23, 4.24

ἀδίοπος.definition: without commander, of a ship, A.Fr.269

αὐτοκινέω.definition: have the principle of motion in oneself, f.l. in Procl.Inst.20, Serv. ad Virg.Aen.10.304

ἀτόρυνητος.definition: not stirred with a ladle, Orib.4.9.1

ἀνάδοτος.definition: given up or to be given up, Th.3.52

ἀντιθλίβω.definition: press against, counteract, Archyt. ap. Stob.2.13.120:—Pass., crushing produces counter-crushing, Arist.GA768b20

ἄδμητος.definition: poet. for in Hom. only in; unwedded, of maidens, h.Ven.82, cf. 133, A.Supp.149; of Artemis, S.El.1239 ; of Atalanta, Id.OC1321

ἀδρανής.definition: impotent, feeble, AP9.359; deprived of its strength, useless, of iron, Plu.Lyc.9, Lys.17

ἀπορρέζω.definition: fut. sacrifice, v.l. in Theoc.Ep.4.15; offer part of, Is.Fr.105

ἀποπυρίς.definition: small fish like; fry, Telesp.41 H

ἀντιτυγχάνω.definition: aor. meet with in return; any chance person, GDI1918, al

ἀντιτυπία.definition: resistance of a hard body; of light, reflection, Plot.4.4.29

ἀγέμιστος.definition: not put on board ship, PAvrom.1b34

ἀγχίπορος.definition: passing near, always near, AP10.64 ; simply, neighbouring, Nonn.D.5.38,al

ἀντιπλέω.definition: sail against an enemy, v.l. in Th.1.50 and 54; Ps.-Phoc.113

ἀπάγνυμαι.definition: to be fractured at a joint, Gal. ap. Orib.46.6.3

ἀνάπαλιν.definition: Adv. back again, Pl.Plt.269d, cf; over again, = Pl.Tht.192d

ἀλλογνοέω.definition: take one for another; to be deranged, Hp. ap. Gal.19.75

ἀνάπαυμα.definition: poet. repose, rest; resting-place, APl.4.228 ; of a tomb, CIG4623, cf. Epigr.Gr.453.3

ἀωριλουστής.definition: an early bather, better written divisim in M.Ant.1.16.8

ἀδιάχυτος.definition: not softened by cooking; not diffuse or extravagant, of persons, Hp.Decent.3:—of style, Longin.34.3

ἀτυφία.definition: freedom from arrogance, Men.304, Plu.2.82b, Jul.Or.7.214b

ἀποδιαιτάω.definition: pronounce in one's favour in an arbitration, opp. , Test. ap. D.21.93:—Pass., ib.96: hence decide for one, Id.40.17; ib.43

ἄμπελος.definition: any climbing plant with tendrils, esp; wild vine, Vitis silvestris, Dsc.4.181, 5.2, Plin.HN23.19:—also = Thphr.9.14.1, 9.20.3, Gal.14.186

ἀπαυστί.definition: Adv. of sq., unceasing, incessant, D.C.37.46

ἀραχνιόω.definition: spin a cobweb, Arist.HA605b10:—Pass., to be; form a venous network over, Hp.Oss.18

ἀνέκτομος.definition: not castrated, entire, prob. in Philotim. ap. Orib.2.69.3

ἀνάστειος.definition: lacking in wit, Aristod. ap. Ath.13.585b

ἀργεμώνη.definition: Papaver Argemone, wind-rose, CrateuasFr.9; = II, Ps.-Dsc.2.178; written argemonia by Plin.HN25.102

ἀντιάνειρα.definition: fem. form of a masc. in; in Pi.O.12.16 faction wherein man is set against man

ἀκανθοβάτης.definition: walking among thorns, nickname of grammarians, AP11.322 : —fem. ib.7.198

ἀστύαρχος.definition: title of magistrate in Alexandria, BGU1024v8

ἀφθεγκτί.definition: Adv. of sq., without speech, ib.147

ἄχυμος.definition: without flavour, Arist.Metaph.989b10, Sens.443a11, Xenocr.45; tasteless, of water, Thphr.CP6.3.1

ἀθαύμαστος.definition: not wondering at anything; not wondered at or admired, Luc.Am.13

ἀστρωσία.definition: practice of sleeping without bedding, Pl.Lg.633c

ἀνασκάλλω.definition: dig up, in Pass., f.l. for foreg., Pl.Com.148

ἀτοπία.definition: being out of the way, hence; absurdity, Ar.Ra.1372; of persons, Id.Ach.349; singularity, Pl.Smp.215a; of sounds or words, uncouthness, D.H.Comp.12

ἀρχειώτης.definition: Lat. archeota, a municipal recorder, Dig.50.4.18.10:—hence courts of record, Lyd.Mag.2.15

ἀδιάσφαλτος.definition: free from error, HeroGeep.164. Adv. Ps.-Dioph.p.xxi H

ἀνυπέροχος.definition: without superiority on either side, Eust.832.3

ἀμφάγαμαι.definition: stand round and admire: aor. Q.S.7.722

ἀκρόλιθος.definition: with ends made of stone; statue with head, arms, and legs marble, rest wood, AP12.40; IG4.558

αὐτόστατος.definition: standing on its own base, IG2.698ii17

ἀνεμόομαι.definition: Pass., to be filled with wind, Pl.Ti.83d; to be inflated, swollen, Hp.Nat.Mul.64: metaph., to be eager for . ., Ael.NA11.7

ἀμφάδιος.definition: acc. fem. as Adv., = publicly, openly, Il.13.356, Thgn.90, etc

ἀντιπάσχω.definition: suffer in turn, suffer evil for; to be affected in a contrary manner, Sallust.8; opp. Alex.Aphr.in Top.437.16

ἄνασσα.definition: to a mortal, Od.6.149, etc.—Common in Poetry from Pi. downwds.; rare in Prose, as Isoc.9.72, Arist.Fr.526: c. dat., A.R.3.862

ἀλφηστής.definition: Hom. only in Od., in phrase; kind of fish that went in pairs, Labrus cinaedus, Epich.44, Numen. ap. Ath.7.320e: metaph., of lewd men, Sophr.63

ἀμφοδαρχία.definition: quarter under the direction of an CPR8.7

ἀντηρέτης.definition: properly, one who rows against another, cf. AB411: generally, opponent, adversary, A.Th.284, 595; ib.997

ἀπόστροφος.definition: turned away, averted; Astrol., not conjoined, Vett. Val.53.24, etc

ἀοιδή.definition: act of singing, song, 18.304; Hes.Sc.282; theme of song, person sung of, Od.8.580, cf. Thgn.252, Theoc.12.11; Od.24.200

ἀναφλύω.definition: bubble, boil up, Il.21.361: also in Prose, PHolm.25.26

ἄμαθος.definition: Ep. form of sand, Il.5.587, A.R.4.1239, etc.: pl., links, dunes by the sea, h.Ap.439; generally, sandy soil, Nic.Th.262. as dust from sea-sand, but prob. is for i. e. cf. sand.)

ἀϊκής.definition: poet. for Adv. Il.22.336:—in Trag. A.Pr.472; S.El.206. Adv. S.El.102, 216 , Pl.Com.225

ἀντικινέω.definition: move in opposition, Arist.Mem.453a26, cf; in Pass.also, make counter-movements, Plb.2.66.3; retaliate more ruthlessly, Chor.p.226B

αὐτοπήμων.definition: gen. for one's own woes, A.Th.917

ἀπαιθριάζω.definition: expose to the air, air; clear away the clouds, Ar.Av.1502

ἀγχιθυρέω.definition: to be at the door, be close at hand, Eust.1133.61

ἀνταγορεύω.definition: speak against, reply; gainsay, contradict, Ar.Ra.1072

ἀνακωμῳδέω.definition: to bring on the stage, satirize, dub. in Plu.2.10c

ἄναρκτος.definition: not governed or subject, Th.5.99; not submitting to be governed, A.Eu.526 , S.Fr.30

ἀμφαλλάξ.definition: Adv.strengthd.for alternately, reciprocally, Ath.Mech.22.1, Ps.-Hes. ap. Ath.3.116c, AP12.238

ἀντίφωνος.definition: sounding in answer, concordant; responsive to, c. gen., E.Supp.800

ἀντιζητέω.definition: seek one who is seeking us, X.Oec.8.23

ἀστροσκοπία.definition: the study of the stars, Herm.in Phdr.p.109A

ἄναπτος.definition: not to be touched; fastened on, Eust.1774.15

ἀνταγείρω.definition: rival as a collector, beggar, Celsus ap. Orig.Cels.6.42

ἀζήλωτος.definition: not to be envied, Pl.Grg.469b: neut.pl.as; not imitated, J.BJ7.8.1

ἀγεωμέτρητος.definition: of persons, ignorant of geometry; of problems, not geometrical, Arist.APo.77b17

ἀνεγκόπτως.definition: Adv. without hesitation, of speech, Aët.8.38

ἀναπηλέω.definition: aor. part. dub. sens. in h.Merc.41

ἀλλαχῆ.definition: Delph. GDI2085, Adv., elsewhere, in another place, one here, another there, X.An.7.3.47; now here, now there, Ar.Av.1020, cf. PLips.104

ἀναπότμητος.definition: not to be cut off or severed, Arr.Epict.1.1.24

ἀποδύρομαι.definition: lament bitterly; take one's fill of lamentation , IG1.463

ἄνθινος.definition: of or like flowers, blooming, fresh; flowered, bright-coloured, of women's dress, Str.3.3.7, Plu.2.304d; gay-coloured dresses worn by the at Athens, Phylarch.45; forbidden at religious festivals, IG11.1300 , ib.5.514.…

ἄφλεκτος.definition: unburnt, unconsumed by fire, E.Hel.1334; Epigr.Gr.241a1 ; uncooked by fire, A.R.1.1074

ἀνυπέρβλητος.definition: not to be surpassed or outdone; persistent, obstinate, of disease, Gal.13.61

ἀστραπηδόν.definition: Adv. like lightning, Aristobul. ap. Eus.PE8.10

ἀσύμπτωτος.definition: not falling in, full, of face or body; not touching, Plu.Lib.7

ἀνδρών.definition: men’s apartment in a house, banqueting-hall, Hdt. , etc.; similarly Ep. A.Ag.244, Ch.712, cf. E.HF954, X.Smp.1.4, etc. ; Ep

ἀποσπείρω.definition: scatter like seed, Luc.Somn.15, cf. Theol.Ar.6

ἀπονοσέω.definition: fall into a morbid state, Hp.Septim.6

ἀνείλημα.definition: rolling up: in pl., flatulent; scroll, Aristeas177

ἀνθρωπολόγος.definition: speaking of man, i.e. fond of personal conversation, Arist.EN1125a5

ἄλγησις.definition: sense of pain, S.Ph.792, Ar.Th.147 : in later Prose, Vett. Val.38.13

ἁρπαγή.definition: seizure, robbery, rape, first in Sol.4.13; thing seized, booty, prey, A.Pers.752; Id.Th.1019, E.El.896; to make booty of a thing. Th.8.62

ἀναπυρίζω.definition: in aor. part. kindle, of fire, Lyr.Alex.Adesp.31

ἀποσείω.definition: shake off, Men.61, Thphr.CP1.20.3:—Pass; Med., shake oneself, Arist.HA560b8

ἀρρυθμέω.definition: to be out of rhythm, Pl.Lg.802e

ἁλίκλυστος.definition: sea-washed, sea-beaten, of coast; high-surging, Orph.A.333

ἀάπλετος.definition: lengthd. Ep. for v.l. in Q.S.1.675

ἀντίκλησις.definition: calling upon, summoning in return, Jul.Ep.192

ἀφαυαίνω.definition: aor. part. Lyc. ap. Orib.8.25.8; grill, roast, Hld.2.19 , Porph.Abst.4.20

ἄτριχος.definition: = without hair, Call.Dian.77; Subst., serpent, Hes.Fr.96.91

ἀνθεστιάω.definition: entertain in return or mutually, Plu.Ant.27, cf. 32 , Luc.Am.9

ἀπότηξις.definition: melting away, discharging, Hp.Morb.Sacr.5; of snow, Str.4.1.12

ἀνθυβρίζω.definition: abuse one another, abuse inturn, E.Ph.620 , Plu.Per.26, Luc.DMeretr.33, etc

ἀπάραυξος.definition: not subject to increase, dub. in Gal.8.913

ἀρτίχυτος.definition: just poured or shed; Act., ib.13.431

ἀρχεῖτις.definition: acc. title of priestess at Thasos, IG12.526

ἀντίπλαστος.definition: lit. similarly formed; generally, like, S.Fr.284

ἀποκνέω.definition: shrink from, c. acc., Th.3.20; abs., shrink back, hesitate, Th.3.55, 6.18, Pl.Lg.780d, etc

ἄρθρωσις.definition: compact connexion, prob. in; articulation, of speech, Phld.D. 3.14, cf. Po.994.6

ἀγκυλόπους.definition: gen. with bent legs, = Lat. sella curulis, Plu.Mar.5

ἀντεκτρέφω.definition: to maintain in return:— in Pass; train as a rival, Lync. ap. Ath.14.654a

αὐτίτης.definition: by oneself, alone; as Subst., , home-made wine, Telecl.9, Polyzel.1, Hp.Morb.3.14

ἀμυστί.definition: Adv., without closing the mouth, i.e. at one draught, prob. in Hp.Int.12, cf. Pherecr.202, Anacreont.8, Luc.Lex.8

ἀνεκκόπως.definition: Adv. without excision , Heliod. ap. Orib.50.9.5

ἀντεπιφέρω.definition: lay, inflict in turn upon; Pass., rush upon in turn, Ti.Locr.102a

ἀπόσκληρος.definition: strengthd. for very hard; harsh to the taste, of water, MyiaEp.4

ἄντοικος.definition: living on the same side of the equator, but under the opposite meridian, Gem.16.1, Cleom.1.2

ἀργῆς.definition: Dor. , a kind of serpent, Achae.1, Trag.Adesp.199; Hp.Epid.5.86: also an obscure nickname of Demosthenes, Aeschin.2.99, Plu.Dem.4

ἀγχιστεύω.definition: to be next or near; to be next of kin, heir-at-law, Is.11.11: metaph., Hp.Praec.8

ἀναστέριστος.definition: not marked by stars, of positions in the heavens, Hipparch.1.7.21, 1.8.1

ἀνυπαρξία.definition: non-existence, nonentity, Phld.Mort.28; absence of predication, said to be Alex.Aphr.in Top.409.19

ἀνάρτησις.definition: suspension, Thphr.Lass.10; metaph., suspension, = withholding, Just.Nov.88 tit

ἀκάπνιστος.definition: unsmoked, honey taken without smoking the bees, Str.9.1.23

ἀκάττυτος.definition: not stitched, i.e. new, of shoes, Telesp.40 H

ἀφάλλομαι.definition: aor. inf. Ael.VH6.14; Ep. aor; jump, bound, of a quick pulse, Ruf.Syn.Puls.7.5

ἀνωτέρωθεν.definition: Adv. from above, from a higher place, Hp.Oss.5

ἀνισόω.definition: equalize, balance, Pl.Plt.289e; make smooth, level, J.BJ5.5.1:—Pass., ibid. B. make unequal, Phlp.in Ph.364.16 , Dam.Pr.401 , Eliasin Cat.200.22

ἀνωμοτί.definition: Adv. of sq, without oath, Hdt.2.118

ἀπονωτίζω.definition: turn one's back and flee, S.Fr.713; trans. in causal sense, E.Ba.763

ἀναπίνω.definition: drink up, suck in like a sponge, Hp.VM22; absorb again, of suppurations which do not come to a head, Id.Art.40; of extravasated blood, ib.50, cf. Gal.7.694

ἀνταλλαγή.definition: exchanging, exchange, barter, Gloss., Simp.in Ph.1350.32

ἀποστόλιον.definition: tax for escort of caravans, OGI674.4

ἀπλυσία.definition: filthiness, filth, AP7.377; a kind of sponge, so called because it cannot be cleaned, Arist.HA549a4, Plin.HN9.150, prob.l. in Thphr.HP4.6.10

ἀντίστρεπτος.definition: that can be turned about: machines that move on a pivot or swivel, D.S.20.91

ἀμεθόδευτος.definition: not to be cajoled, led astray; unscientific, Alex.Trall.Febr.5

ἀλογία.definition: Ion. want of respect or regard; Att., want of reason, absurdity, opp. Pl.Tht.207c, cf. 199d, Phd.67e, D.23.168; Th.5.111; concrete, the irrational part of the soul, Porph.Abst.1.42

ἁλίπεδον.definition: plain by the sea, sandy plain, Thphr.HP7.15.2, Aristid.Or.17.16; of a plain in Attica near Piraeus, X.HG2.4.30

ἀλλαθεάς.definition: at Delphi, funeral ceremony, in pl., GDI1796, cf. 1731, 1775

αὐτοτετράς.definition: abstract number four, Phlp.in de An.77.9

ἀποκομιστής.definition: one who leads away; messenger, bearer of a letter, Cat.Cod.Astr.2.193

ἀντίκτησις.definition: acquisition of one thing for another, Plu.2.481e

ἀποδιψάω.definition: cease from thirst, be relieved of it, Eust.871.5

ἀγχινεφής.definition: near the clouds, AP6.219.14 , Nonn.D.3.208, al.:—late Prose, Men.Prot.p.48D

ἀργυρόριζος.definition: with silver root, i.e. having silver in the soil, Stesich.5

ἀστεφάνωτος.definition: uncrowned, forbidden to be crowned; without the nuptial crown, unwedded, Epigr.Gr.314.27

ἀνάστασις.definition: Act., making to stand or rise up, raising up the dead, . . A.Eu.648; . . Ep.Heb.11.35

ἀσχέδωρος.definition: wild boar, in Magna Graecia, A.Fr.261, Sciras I

ἀναυξησία.definition: Gramm., omission of the augment, Greg.Cor.180

ἀναπιέζω.definition: aor. Pass. press back; force upwards, HeroSpir.1.10

ἀνοργίαστος.definition: not celebrated with orgies; of a god or person in whose honour no orgies are held, Pl.Epin.985d

ἄπλοκος.definition: = Opp.H.3.469: metaph., unconnected, cj. in Longin.19.1

ἀνάπτωτος.definition: flat, of style, v.l. in Eust. ad D.P.69

ἀκάτακτος.definition: not to be broken, Arist.Mete.385a14; unbroken, Phld.Mort.39

ἀπέχθεια.definition: felt towards another, D.18.36, Arist.Pol.1305a23; for it, ib.1274a40

ἀνομόϋλος.definition: differing in substance, Phlp.in de An.526.18

ἀμφιδέξιος.definition: ready to take with either hand, i.e. taking either of two things, indifferent, Trag.Adesp.355 ; so it is indifferent, A.Fr.266

ἀσόλοικος.definition: not barbarous, S.Fr.629; correct, without solecism, Zeno Stoic.1.23. Adv. AB452

ἀταφία.definition: want of burial, J.AJ13.15.5, Luc.Salt.43, Plu.Marc.30

ἀγόρασμα.definition: that which is bought or sold: mostly in pl., wares, merchandise, Aeschin.3.223, D.34.9, etc., cf. Alex.168

ἀναθηλάζω.definition: suck up water, of a tree, Ph.Byz.Mir.1.5; Aët.15.18

ἀντίπορπος.definition: seton for keeping incision open, Hippiatr.24, 26

ἀντιξενίζω.definition: entertain in return, Phld.Vit.p.30J., cf. Eust.1961.37

αὐτοεννεάς.definition: the ideal number nine, Alex.Aphr.in Metaph.836.25

ἄστοργος.definition: without natural affection; without attraction, Plu.2.926f:—also An.Ox.1.50

ἄγρυκτος.definition: not to be spoken of, Pherecr.157

ἀστροθετέω.definition: class or group the stars , Str.1.1.6

ἀνήφαιστος.definition: fire that is no fire, i.e. discord, E.Or.621

ἀσημωνία.definition: farming of trade in silver bullion, BGU1242

αὐξύνω.definition: aor. Pass. late form of Aesop.51

ἀσύναρθρος.definition: Gramm., without the article; inarticulate, prob. in Corp.Herm.1.4

ἄγχουσα.definition: alkanet, Anchusa tinctoria, Thphr.HP7.8.3, Dsc.4.23; cf

ἀντιμέλλω.definition: wait and watch against one, Th.3.12

ἀγκύλιον.definition: Dim. of loop in noose, Heracl; = Antyll. ap. Orib.45.15.1

ἀναγκαστέος.definition: to be compelled; one must compel, ib.378d, X.Hier.8.9, etc

ἀποκίκω.definition: 3pl. aor. dash to the ground, Ar.Ach.869

ἀφαρμόζω.definition: Att. not to suit, Oenom. ap. Eus.PE5.24

αὐτοαήρ.definition: air by itself, Herm. ap. Stob.3.11.31

ἀντεξαίρω.definition: raise to an equal height, Philostr.VS1.19.1

ἀναγεπόπτης.definition: perh. uplifting to full vision, PMag.Lond.121.355

ἀνηπύω.definition: sound, Mosch.2.98; c. acc., sing aloud, A.R.4.1197

ἀναγνωσείω.definition: Desiderat. of wish to read, Gloss

ἀπάρτησις.definition: hanging from, appendage; attachment, Hp.Art.8 : metaph., dependence, Plot.5.1.2

ἄφρουρος.definition: off one's guard, Pl.Phdr.256c; free from military duty, Arist.Pol.1270b4

ἀνδρομάχος.definition: fighting with men, AP7.241 : fem. ib.11.378

αὐτοϋγίεια.definition: health in the abstract, Alex.Aphr.in Metaph.79.12, Herm.in Phdr.p.151 A

ἀποσειρόω.definition: strain, filter off, Philum.Ven.23.3, Aët.1.113, PMag. Leid.V.6.19, PHolm.23.21, etc

ἀντισφαιρίζω.definition: play at ball against, parties about to play in a match, X.Lac.9.5

ἀνωμαλίζω.definition: to be subject to vicissitude, Vett. Val.57.4, 85.28

ἄνουλος.definition: in Comp. less wavy, cj. in Thphr.HP3.11.3

ἀκραχολέω.definition: to be passionate, only in pres. part., Pl.Lg.731d

ἀχραής.definition: gen. = sq., Nic.Th.846; pure cold water, AP9.314

ἀστραῖος.definition: starry, Orac. ap. Porph. ap. Eus.PE3.14, Nonn.D.1.191,al

ἀκατάμικτος.definition: not to be met with, rare, Gloss

ἀμφιβολή.definition: cast as of a net, fishing-net, Opp.H.4.149

ἀπεκβαίνω.definition: turn out, come to be, Eust.1062.61
