αὐτόροφος.definition: self-covered, roofed or vaulted by nature, Opp.H.1.22; D.H.1.79; a natural roof, Ael.NA16.17

ἀπεριμάχητος.definition: not worth contending for; free from need of contention, Max.Tyr.36.1

ἀντιπταίω.definition: obstruct, stand in the way, Onos.17

ἀποτυπόω.definition: impress, Luc.Alex.21; of stars; represent, Lib.Eth.11.3, cf. Porph. ap. Eus.PE3.7

ἀργυράγχη.definition: silver-quinsy, which Demosthenes was said to have, when he abstained from speaking on the plea of quinsy, but really because he was bribed, Demad.Fr.5 S., Plu.Dem.25

ἀφρηλόγος.definition: poet. for , gathering froth, skimming, AP6.101

ἀξιόχρεως.definition: abs., like noteworthy, considerable, Th.1.10; of a person, Hdt.5.111

ἀταλαίπωρος.definition: not painstaking; of persons, not given to hard work, Hp.Aër.1; lazy, Arr.Epict.1.29.55

ἀντιμίμησις.definition: close imitation of a person in a thing, c. dupl. gen., Th.7.67

ἀπρονοησία.definition: improvidence, Epicur.Fr.368, Alex.Aphr.de An.178.22, Procl.in Prm.p.746S

ἀντίπυγος.definition: rump to rump, Arist.HA540a14,542a16; c. gen., turned away from, Scyl.46, cf. 108

ἀρχίμαγος.definition: chief of the magi, Epigr.Gr. 903b7 , Rhetor.in Cat.Cod.Astr.8.147

ἁρμογή.definition: joining, junction, Luc.Zeux.6; joint in masonry, J.AJ15.11.3, Hdn.3.3.7

ἀστρονόμος.definition: astronomer, Pl.R.531a, etc.; the astronomer par excellence, i. e. Ptolemy, Olymp.in Mete.188.33:—as Adj., Nic. Dam.p.3D

ἀποθριάζω.definition: properly, strip of fig-leaves: metaph., circumcise, Ar.Ach.158; cf

ἀναδιδάσκω.definition: teach otherwise or better; produce play a second time, Vit.Aesch.Arg.1, Ar.Ra., Philostr.VA6.11

ἀκτίτης.definition: dweller on coast, AP6.304; stone from the Piraeus I.2), IG2.1054.16, al.; from the Argolid, S.Fr.68

ἀφλοισμός.definition: foaming at the mouth, of an angry man, Il.15.607, cf. Euph.51.4

ἀποδωσείω.definition: Desiderat., wish to give back, Procop.Goth.3.34

ἀνεμοσκεπής.definition: sheltering one from the wind, Il.16.224

ἀστιβής.definition: desert, pathless, S.Aj.657; of the sea, Arion1.16; Hymn.Is.149

ἀνδρογόνος.definition: begetting men, a day favourable for begetting male children, Hes.Op.783,788

ἁγίζω.definition: hallow, make sacred, esp. by burning a sacrifice, S.OC1495 ; Ar.Pl.681:—Pass., Pi.O.3.19; D.H.1.38:—Med., = Alcm.123

ἀνθρακεύω.definition: make charcoal, Thphr.HP9.3.1, cf; burn to a cinder, Ar.Lys.340

ἀκροκυματόω.definition: float on topmost waves, bombastic word ridiculed by Luc.Lex.15

ἀνδραχθής.definition: loading a man, as much as a man can carry, Od.10.121; A.R.3.1334; Eudox. ap. Ath.7.288c

ἀμπελόδεσμος.definition: Sicilian plant used for tying up vines, esparto, Lygeum Spartum, Plin.HN17.209

ἀπονυστάζω.definition: to be sleepy and sluggish: metaph., Plu.Cic.24, cf. Arr.Epict.4.9.16

ἀδείμαντος.definition: fearless, dauntless; where no fear is, Luc.Philops.31

ἄπαγμα.definition: fracture at a joint, Gal. ap. Orib.46.6.1, Gal.10.424

ἀμφίσβαινα.definition: kind of serpent, supposed to; veins connecting the breast and generative organs, Pall.in Hp.2.103D

ἀγκύλωσις.definition: as medic. term, tongue-tie, Antyll. ap. Orib.46.16.4; stiffening of joints, Paul. Aeg.4.55; adhesion of the eyelids, Gal.14.772

ἀλεξανέμας.definition: averting wind, applied to Empedocles, Porph.VP29

αἵρεσις.definition: taking, esp. of a town, Hdt.4.1, etc; choice, election of magistrates, Th.8.89, cf. Arist.Pol.1266a26, al.; opp. 1300a19, etc

ἀλλήναλλος.definition: this way and that, irregular, Theo Sm.p.151 H. Adv. Eustr.in APo149.29

ἀλκυόνειον.definition: bastard-sponge, a zoophite, so called because like the halcyon's nest, Hp.Mul.1.106, Antyll. ap. Orib.10.21.2

ἀποσμύχομαι.definition: Pass., to be consumed as by a slow fire, waste, pine away, Luc.DMort.6.3

ἀνάκρουσις.definition: pushing back, esp. pushing a ship; in Music, first beginning of a tune, Str.9.3.10

ἀραιότρητος.definition: with few pores, opp. Gal.UP8.6 codd

ἀπρασία.definition: want of purchasers, no sale, Eup.62, D.27.21, 34.8

ἀρνεύω.definition: frisk, tumble, Lyc.465; plunge, dive, Id.1103

ἀνασκοπέω.definition: c. fut. aor. (cf; look back at, reckon up, X.Vect.5.11

ἀκρόλοφος.definition: high-crested, peaked, Opp.C.1.418; AP12.185 :—Subst., mountain crest, Plu.Publ.22

ἀντίμορφος.definition: formed after, corresponding to a thing, Luc.Am.44. Adv. Plu.Crass.32

ἀγελάρχης.definition: leader of a flock or herd, Procl.in Cra.p.38 P.; Luc.Am.22: generally, leader, captain, Plu.Rom.6; Procl.in Prm.p.526S.:—also dub. l. in Ph.2.144

ἀδίδακτος.definition: untaught, ignorant, Ps.-Phoc.89: c; unpractised, untrained, of a chorus, D.21.17

ἀπολυμαντήρ.definition: destroyer: one who destroys one's pleasure at dinner, kill-joy , Od.17.220,377

ἀστέφανος.definition: without crown, ungarlanded, mostly in token of defeat, E.Hipp.1137 ; Id.Andr.1021

ἀπειρόκακος.definition: without experience of evil; unused to evil or misery, E.Alc.927

ἀκεσίμβροτος.definition: healing mortals, of Asclepius, Orph.L.8; Poet.de herb.146

ἀπήνεια.definition: rudeness, discourtesy; stiffness, Heliod. ap. Orib.44.23.56, Sor.1.44

ἀντίρροπος.definition: like counterpoising; like equivalent to, c. dat., X.Oec.3.15

ἀνήκουστος.definition: not to be heard, inaudible, Arist.de; of prayers, not to be granted, Antiph01.22

ἀντιστρέφω.definition: pf. turn to the opposite; intr., wheel about, face about, X.Ages.1.16

ἀμάντευτος.definition: not to be foretold or conjectured; lacking in oracles, Philostr.Im.1.4

ἀγονία.definition: sterility, Arist.GA746b20, Dsc.2.179, Plu.Rom.24; opp. Iamb.Comm. Math.15

ἀκράτιστος.definition: Theoc.1.51 codd. having made a dry breakfast, i.e. none at all; vv.ll. , dinnerless

ἀπαιώρημα.definition: holder for splints in surgical apparatus, Hp.Fract.30

ἀπημοσύνη.definition: freedom from harm, safety, Thgn.758; harmlessness, Opp.H.2.647

αὐτόχρημα.definition: Adv. in very deed, Ar.Eq.78; just, exactly, Ael.NA2.44, Aristid.2.228 J

ἀνάλγητος.definition: without pain, and so; of persons, insensible to pain or danger, Meliss. ap. Arist.Xen.974a19, cf. EN1115b26

αὐτόκυκλος.definition: the ideal circle, the Form of circle, Them.Or.13.165a, Procl.in Prm.p.773S

ἀποθρύπτω.definition: crush, crumble to pieces, J.BJ3.7.23: metaph., break in spirit, enervate, Pl.R.495e

ἁμόθεν.definition: Ion. Adv.: :—from some place or other, . . Od.1.10; from some quarter or other, Pl.Grg.492d, Lg.798b; alone, Opp.C.1.401

ἀνήνιος.definition: unbridled, EM107.20; = , without pain, Hp. ap. Gal.19.81

ἁλιγείτων.definition: gen. near the sea, Hom.Epigr.4.6, Nonn.D.42.17

ἀπομίμνω.definition: remain away from, c. gen., Nonn.D.42.439

ἄμωτον.definition: = Ageloch. ap. Ath.2.54d; prob. cj. for Dsc.1.106

ἀνορύσσω.definition: dig up, break open, destroy it, Hdt.1.68, Isoc.16.26

ἀνάγγελος.definition: from which no messenger returns; = Ps.-Dsc.4.144

ἀντεκπέμπω.definition: send out in turn, X.HG4.8.25; expel, discharge in turn, of respiration, Gal.5.710

ἀρχαιόγονος.definition: of ancient race, of old descent; original, primal, Arist.Mu.399a26

ἀσπονδεί.definition: of peace, without formal treaty, SIG168.9 , IPE2.1 , etc

ἀψόφητος.definition: noiseless, c. gen., without sound of . . , S.Aj.321

ἀπάρχομαι.definition: make a beginning, esp. in sacrifice; later c. gen., cut off part of a thing, offer it, Hdt.4.188; E.El.91; offer part of them, Hdt.4.61: hence

ἀπραγία.definition: inaction, Plb.3.103.2; want of energy, Plu.Fab.1 ; unemployment, Vett. Val.189.8

ἀρθμός.definition: a bond, league, friendship, h.Merc.524, cf. A.Pr.193 , Call.Fr.199

ἁμαξάρχης.definition: prob. official of the imperial transport service, BCH33.67

ἀτέρμων.definition: gen. without bound or end, Arist.Mu.401a16; Mosch.3.104; the mirror's countless rays, E.Hec.926; having no end or issue, inextricable, A.Eu.634

ἀποδυναμία.definition: lack of power, Olymp.in Grg.p.251 J

αἰπύνωτος.definition: on a high mountain-ridge, of Dodona, A.Pr.830

ἁλιεργής.definition: working in sea, fishing, Opp.H.4.635:—; = purple, EM63.45

ἀτύζομαι.definition: in Hom., Lyr., Trag. only pres. and aor; in later Ep. Act. strike with terror or amazement, A.R.1.465: aor. opt. Theoc.1.56; draws short breaths, Nic.Al.193 .—Ep. Verb, used by Trag. only in lyr

ἀναλικμάω.definition: winnow out, of grain, v.l. in Pl.Ti.52e

ἀνέκθυτος.definition: not to be removed by sacrifice, Corn.ND9

αἰσυμνήτης.definition: Dor. judge, umpire at; overseer, bailiff, Theoc.25.48

ἄμυξις.definition: tearing, rending, mangling, Orph.A.24, Ach.Tat.8.4; scarification, Antyll. ap. Orib.7.16.1; irritation, Cass.Pr.62

ἀκροφανής.definition: just showing at the edge or tip, Nonn.D.14.138, al.; of an island, Peripl.M.Rubr.42

ἄσπαρτος.definition: of land, unsown, untilled, Od.9.123; but; of plants, not sown, growing wild, Od.9.109, Numen. ap. Ath.9.371b

ἀποστατέω.definition: stand aloof from, A.Ch.826; of the soul, etc., fall away from the divine, Plot.5.1.5, 5.3.16

ἀνημερόω.definition: to clear of wild beasts, S.Fr.905

ἀγροιώτης.definition: = I, Hom. always in nom. pl; as Adj., rustic, AP6.22 , 7.411 ; wild, Numen. ap. Ath.371c

ἀνισήλικος.definition: unequal in age, Procl.in Prm.pp.945, 949 S

ἀποβρύκω.definition: bite off, eat greedily of, Eub.42: abs., bite in pieces, Archipp.35; is v.l. for in AP7.506

ἄλιμος.definition: banishing hunger, a food said to be prepared from asphodel and mallows, Herodor.1 J., Hermipp.Hist.1.8, cf. Plu.2.157d, Porph.Abst.4.20

ἀστράτευτος.definition: without service: hence; exempt therefrom, Lys.9.15

ἀνωϊστί.definition: Adv. of sq., unlooked for, Od.4.92

ἀναρριζόω.definition: root, implant in, dub. in Nonn.D.18.36

ἀμετάδοτος.definition: not imparting, sharing; Pass., not imparted, secret, Vett.Val.331.6, cf.PMag.Par.1.256

αὐτάγρετος.definition: poet. for self-; taken by one's own hands or exertions, A.R.4.231

ἀφυδραίνω.definition: wash clean:—Med., wash oneself, bathe, E.Ion97

ἀψήφιστος.definition: not having voted, Ar.V.752; not voted for, unwelcome, Secund.Sent.10

ἀγασθενής.definition: very strong, Opp.C.2.3, Epigr.Gr.1052 :—in Il. only as pr. n

ἄογκος.definition: not bulky, attenuated; immaterial, Syrian.in Metaph.143.22; without mass or bulk, Plot.6.1.26,6.4.5, Porph.Sent.27: Comp., Dam.Pr.372

ἀμφαΐσσομαι.definition: Pass., rush on from all sides, Il.11.417; float around, 6.510

ἀπογείσωμα.definition: projecting cornice: metaph. of eyebrows, Arist.PA58b16

ἀδικοδοξέω.definition: seek fame by unworthy means, D.S.31.6

ἀποδασμός.definition: division, part of a whole, Th.1.12; separation, by loss of territory, D.H.3.6

ἀγχικέλευθος.definition: whose way is hard by, Nonn.D.40.328; mostly = near, 5.476

ἀποπτερνίζω.definition: thrust off with the heel, Philostr.Her.6

ἀπεύλογον.definition: of irregular shape, dub. in HeroStereom.2.32

ἀμπωτίζω.definition: ebb and flow, of the sea, Ph.1.298:—Med., Eust.688.52

ἀντισυζυγία.definition: = of signs rising and setting at the same point of the horizon, Gem.2.1

ἀρέσκεια.definition: in pl., = of false superstitions, Ph.2.191; Demetr.Lac.Herc.1012.73

ἀνικμάω.definition: winnow, sift out, in Pass., Pl.Ti.53a ; cf

αὐτοπάθεια.definition: one's own experience; Gramm., of words that are reflexive, opp. transitive, A.D.Synt.147.21

ἀμφικείρω.definition: aor. 2 Pass. shear all round, AP9.56

ἁπλοΐς.definition: simple, single, Il.24.230, Od.24.276: as Subst., single garment, = AP5.293

ἀκλυδώνιστος.definition: not lashed by waves; generally, sheltered from, Plb.10.10.4

ἀμύδρωσις.definition: making indistinct or feeble, Anon.in Cat.26.9: metaph., Dam.Pr.423

ἀναγραφεύς.definition: recorder, esp. as title of; registrar of decrees, IG2.192c cf. 191

ἀρκτῷος.definition: arctic, northern, D.P.519, etc.; Lib.Or.59.128; the arctic regions, Luc.Cont.5

ἀνολολύζω.definition: cry aloud, shout aloud; c. acc., bewail loudly, S.El.750: but c. acc. cogn., E.Tr.1000

ἀπόλειψις.definition: intr., deficiency, of rivers, failing, Arist.Mete.351a21 ; of the moon, waning, Id.GA767a5; of the sun, departure to southern hemisphere, Jul.Or.4.137d

ἄρομα.definition: f.l. for , Luc.Lex.2, Ael.NA7.8, cf. AB450

ἀποκλύζω.definition: wash off, Erasistr. ap; in Med., D.S.4.51: metaph., Pl.Phdr.243d: hence, avert by purifications, Ar.Ra.1340

ἀπόλεμος.definition: a war that is no war, a hopeless struggle, Id.Pr.904 , E.HF1133

ἀκολλητί.definition: Adv. of sq., without adhering, Herm. ap. Stob.1.49.68

ἀντεπαφίημι.definition: let go, let slip against, Luc.Zeux.9

ἄρκος.definition: and = bear, LXX4 Ki.2.24; = III, Hp.Vict.2.48

ἀρηβώ.definition: a kind of cassia, Peripl.M.Rubr.12, Gal.14.72

ἁλοσάχνη.definition: lit. sea-foam, a zoophyte of the class Arist.HA616a20, Thphr.Od.35

ἀμφίμακρος.definition: long at both ends: - metrical foot amphimacer, –⏑– , also called creticus, Heph.3.2, Quint.Inst.9.4.81, etc

ἀσβολόω.definition: cover with soot, in pf. part. Pass. Macho ap. Ath.13.581e, cf. Plu.Cim.1, Arr.Epict.3.16.3

αὐονή.definition: dryness, withering, drought, Archil.125, A.Eu.333 , Herod.8.2

ἀκύβευτος.definition: risking nothing upon a die, cautious, M.Ant.1.8

ἀσυνταξία.definition: incapacity of entering into; disorder, indiscipline, App.BC2.20, Gall.15

ἀκοντοφόρος.definition: bearing darts, of persons or things, Nonn.D.20.148,al

ἀποσπεύδω.definition: fut. to be zealous in preventing, dissuade earnestly, the engagement, Hdt.6.109: c.acc. et inf., Id.7.17: abs., opp. ib.18, Th.6.29

ἀμβοειδής.definition: like an protuberant, Heliod. ap. Orib.49.8.7

ἀπομεριμνάω.definition: rest from labour: hence, die, Eust.821.36

ἀποτιμητής.definition: one who receives in pledge, AB437; official valuer of property, Lys.Fr.84S., Harp

ἀνακοπή.definition: resistance, check due to collision; recoil of the waves, Id.Pyrrh.15, cf. J.BJ1.21.6; in a tidal river, Str.3.5.9

ἀπαγορεύω.definition: mostly in pres. and impf. only being; dissuade, Hdt.9.66, cf. 3.124; Plu.Arat.35

ἀστόχαστος.definition: not aimed, D.H.14.10; not aimed at; hard to guess at, Thphr. ap. Stob.4.11.16

ἀφυΐα.definition: want of natural power or faculty, Arist.PA659a29; Str.14.2.28; Plu.2.104c; natural unfitness for . . , ib.1088b; in pl., opp. Porph.Abst.3.8, cf. Colot.in Euthd.2

ἀνάδετος.definition: binding up hair, E.Hec.923; in pass. sense, Him.Ecl.13.36

ἀσχήμων.definition: gen. misshapen, ugly; unseemly, shameful, E.Hel.299, Pl.Phlb.46a, Arist.Pol.1336b14, etc

ἁλίτυπος.definition: sea beaten, griefs for sea- tossed corpses, A.Pers.946 : as Subst., seaman, fisherman, E.Or.373

ἀνάπλευσις.definition: separation, splitting off; mounting, rising, of food in vomiting, Archig. ap. Orib.8.1.20

ἀναδέω.definition: poet. Att. contr. part. (infr; c. acc. pers., crown, Pi.P.2.6; Ar.Pl.589; crown him for good tidings, 764; Th.5.50:—metaph. in Pass., are well furnished with . . , Pl.R.465d

ἀντιπεριωθέω.definition: push or press back any surrounding body, ib.1005f:—hence Subst. ibid

ἀμίς.definition: chamber-pot, Hp.Loc.Hom.47, Ar.V.935, Th.633, etc., f.l. in A.Supp.842; prov., 'cast not pearls before swine', Plu.2.12f; 'to be suitably treated' , Luc.Merc.Cond.4

ἀνάκλιθρον.definition: gloss on fulcrum; of the back of Cassiepeia's chair, Ptol.Alm.7.5

ἀμφίλογος.definition: disputed, disputable; uncertain, wavering, neut. pl. as Adv., E.IT655 . Regul. Adv. A.Pers.904

ἀτρεής.definition: = acc. for Euph.125; also, not to be feared, pl., IG14.1389ii 18

ἀστερίας.definition: a fish, Squalus stellaris, Philyll.1.2, Arist.HA543a17; perh. bittern, Ardea stellaris, ib.609b22

ἀποχετεύω.definition: draw off water by a canal; metaph., Plu.2.485e

ἀστερίζω.definition: arrange in constellations, Hipparch.1.4.5 , al.; mark with stars, Ptol.Geog.1.23.3 ; cast a nativity, Vett.Val.187.15

ἀντεμπίπτω.definition: fall into the place of, Phlp.in Ph.547.19; attack in return, Agath.5.19

ἀμφανδόν.definition: Adv., poet. for prob. in Pi.P.9.41

αἴσθησις.definition: sense-perception, sensation; in object. sense, impressions of sense, Arist.Metaph.980a22; stage-effects, Po.1454b16; visible appearances of the gods, Pl.Phd.111b

ἀγρίζω.definition: inflame, irritate, in Pass., dub. l. in Hp.Mul.2.154; Act., Sm.Pr.15.18; cf

ἄσπορος.definition: = D.19.123, IG2.379.9; of plants, unsown, growing without cultivation, Luc.Rh.Pr.8, Nic.Fr.74.58

ἄστρον.definition: mostly in pl., the stars, Il.8.555; of something brilliant, admirable, AP7.297 , cf. 9.400 , APl.4.295; IG3.770a

ἀρτιόπλευρος.definition: having an even number of sides, of polygons, Archim.Sph.Cyl.1.21,al

ἀσίρακος.definition: locust without wings, = Dsc.2.52 codd.: Gal.12.366

ἀνδρόκλας.definition: weakening men, of the climacterical year, i.e. the 63rd, Firm.4.20.3:—also prob. in Critodem. ap. Vett.Val.237.7

ἀρηγών.definition: helper, Il.4.7, 5.511, in fem.; masc. in Batr.280, etc.; Opp.H.5.108

ἀβλάβεια.definition: freedom from harm, Plu.2.1090b; Act., harmlessness, Cic. Tusc.3.8.16

ἀπόνοια.definition: loss of all sense; of fear and hope, desperation, to make one desperate, Th.1.82,7.67, cf. Nicol.Com.1.43, Plb.2.35.2, D.H.6.23

ἀποπειράζω.definition: make trial of, prove; make an attempt upon, App.Pun.117

ἀμφίκολλος.definition: glued on both couch with two ends fixed on, Pl.Com.34

ἀνάπλασμα.definition: shape, form, model; representation, imagination, Str.11.14.12; S.E.M.8.354

ἀλλάσσω.definition: later Att. Pl.Prm.139a: impf; give in exchange, barter one thing for another, . . A.Pr.967; E.Alc.661:— Med., . . Th.8.82

αὐλῳδία.definition: song to the flute, Pl.Lg.700d, Plu.2.1132f

ἀριστεῖος.definition: Adj. belonging to the bravest, bestowed as the prize of valour, D.H.6.94, 9.13; Plu.Thes.26; Id.Pyrrh.22

ἀντίτοιχος.definition: striking full on the bulwarks, Tim.Pers.12

ἀντίδουλος.definition: instead of a slave, neut. pl. as Adv; of persons, being as a slave, treated as a slave, Id.Ch.135

ἀέκητι.definition: Ep. Adv. against one's will, c. gen., Od.3.213, 16.94; Il.12.8, Od.4.504

ἄελπτος.definition: unhoped for, unexpected, h.Cer.219; beyond hope, despaired of, Archil.74, Hp.Art.42

ἀμίστυλλος.definition: not cut into small pieces, Call.Aet.Fr.7.35 P

ἀμφίβλημα.definition: something thrown round, enclosure; garment, cloak, ib.423; coats of panoply, Id.Ph.779; coverlet, Aret.SD2.6

ἀμαύρωσις.definition: darkening, becoming dull; dulling, as of mind in old age, Arist.de An.408b20, cf. Diog.Oen.Fr.70

ἀκραής.definition: blowing strongly, of winds, Od.2.421, 14.253, Hes.Op.594; si erit if a brisk breeze spring up, Cic.Att. 10.17.9. Adv. sail with fresh breeze, Arr.Ind.24.1

ἀνακνισόω.definition: perfume thoroughly, fill with vapour, Tryph.349

ἀνθρωπίζω.definition: act like a man, play the man, Archyt. ap; Pass., become man, Alex.Aphr.in Top.137.27, Simp.inPh.1138.28:—so in Act., AP1.105

ἀνασηκόω.definition: make up what is wanting by adding weight, compensate for, Hp.Acut.29, cf. Ar.Fr.743; Arist. ap. Stob.1.34.2

ἀβουλία.definition: ill-advisedness, thoughtlessness; irresolution, Th.5.75; indecision, Democr.119

ἀντεκπλέω.definition: sail out against, Th.4.13: abs., Plu.Lys.10

ἀπάνθισμα.definition: inflorescence, Olymp.in Alc.p.226C.; flower plucked or culled, Eust.782.21; rhetorical description of the emperor Constant. Porphyrog., Gp.Prooem.11

ἀποτόρνωσις.definition: rounding off as by the lathe, Heliod. ap. Orib.49.7.4

αὐτοχερί.definition: Adv. of poet. for Call.Epigr.22: c. gen., Man.3.200

ἀχρήμων.definition: gen. poor, needy, Sol.13.41, Pi.Fr.218; once in Trag., E.Med.461

ἀνομβρέω.definition: gush out with water, Ph.2.91: metaph., 1.575: c. acc., Pour forth, 2.115: metaph., LXXSi.18.29,al., Ph.1.477

ἀλεξίκηπος.definition: title of work on gardening by Nestor, Gp.12.16.1, 12.17.16

ἀπόχυσις.definition: pouring out or forth, S.E.P.3.51, cf. Gal.UP6.2,al.; of corn, coming into ear, Thphr.HP8.10.4: generally, inflorescence, ib.8.3.4

ἀναγορεύω.definition: Aeschin.3.3: impf. ib.122: fut; designate, call after their demes, Arist.Ath.21.4:—Pass., X. l. c

ἀπροσπαθής.definition: without affection or passion, Hierocl.in CA11p.438M

ἀντεισφέρω.definition: contribute in return; substitute a new law for an old one, D.20.97; D.C.52.36

ἄκεσις.definition: healing, cure, Hdt.4.90, 109; mending, repair, IG4.1484 ; GDI2502.62

ἀρτηρία.definition: artery, as distinct from a vein, Hp.Art.45, cf. 69; . . Arist.Spir.484a1; Gal.UP8.1, al.; pulmonary vein, ib.6.10; believed to contain by Erasistr., ib.17, and derived fr. by Bacch. ap. Erot. s.v

ἀντίφασις.definition: in Logic, contradiction; contradictory proposition, Arist.Int.22a39, APr.34b29, al

ἀοιδός.definition: singer, minstrel, bard; fem., songstress, Id.15.97; of the nightingale, Hes.Op.208; of the Sphinx, S.OT36, E.Ph.1507 ; Id.Rh.386

ἀνεμέω.definition: vomit up, Hp.Prorrh.1.31, Arist.HA594a29, al.: metaph., Chrysipp.Stoic.2.243

ἀνακρέκομαι.definition: begin to play, each bird tunes its voice for thee, AP9.562

ἀποσυκάζω.definition: gather figs, Amips.33; squeeze figs, to try whether they are ripe: metaph. of informers, with a play on Ar.Eq.259

ἄνοδμος.definition: without smell, having no smell, Hp.Acut.63 , Arist.Pr.873a2

ἀτεκνόω.definition: make childless:— Pass., of the earth, to be barren, LXX4 Ki.2.19

ἀντιφεύγω.definition: flee or go into exile in turn, E.El.1091

ἀντολίηθε.definition: Adv. for from the east, Opp.C.2.123; ib.1.43, Man.2.11,3.49

ἀμφινοέω.definition: think both ways, be in doubt, S.Ant.376

ἄκουρος.definition: childless, without male heir; unshaven, Ar.V.476, Lyc.976, Str.10.3.6

ἀντιψάλλω.definition: play a stringed instrument in accompaniment of song, Ar.Av.218

ἀποσοβέω.definition: scare away, as one does birds; intr., to be off in a hurry, i.e. be off! Ar.Av.1032, 1258, cf. Luc.Nav.4; let's be off, Men.997

ἀντεκτείνω.definition: stretch out in rivalry, match oneself with another, Ar.Ra.1042; Philostr.VS1.21.4

ἀρτιοταγής.definition: occupying the even places in a; even in number, Id.Ar.2.24

ἄνδρισμα.definition: genuine, straightforward dealing, in pl. , Max.Tyr.38.4

ἀπήχησις.definition: echo: metaph. of posthumous fame; sounding, resonance, D.T.629.26, Gal.19.380, cf. Phlp.in Ph.47.1

ἀποδάσμιος.definition: parted off, parted from the rest, Hdt.1.146; a share apportioned, Opp.H.5.444

ἀντιστάτης.definition: opponent, adversary; vertical beam in plinth of torsion-engine, HeroBel.91.11

ἁβρύνω.definition: make delicate, treat delicately, A.Ag.919: deck out, AP6.281 :—Med. or Pass., live delicately; hence, wax wanton, give oneself airs, A.Ag.1205, cf. S.OC1339; Pl.Ap.20c: c. dat. rei, pride, plume oneself on a thing, E.…

ἀρρενωνυμέω.definition: use in masculine gender, change into it, of a feminine noun, Eust.560.15

ἀποψοφέω.definition: break wind, Hp.Epid.6.3.14, Arist.HA633b7; sound loudly, Thphr.Sign.40

ἀνασῴζω.definition: fut. pf. IG12.1061.9; preserve in mind, remember, Hdt.6.65

ἀμφίεργος.definition: worked or prepared in two ways, Thphr.CP3.23.1

ἀμφικάθημαι.definition: Pass., sit all round, Orac. ap. Eus.PE4.23

ἀβαρής.definition: without weight, Arist.Cael.277b19; not offensive, Aret.CA2.3; of persons, not burdensome, 2 Ep.Cor.11.9, CIG5361.15 . Adv. without giving offence, Simp.in Epict.p.85D.; without taking offence, ib.p.88D

ἀναφροδισία.definition: want of power to inspire love, lack; insensibility to love, Gell. 19.9.9

ἀνατριπλόω.definition: repeat a third time, Syr.in Metaph.61.8

ἀκριβολογία.definition: exactness, precision in speech; niggardliness, Arist.EN1122b8

ἀνώδυνος.definition: causing no pain, harmless, S.Aj.554b; definition of Arist.Po.1449a35. Adv. Plu.Cleom.10

ἀσκεύαστος.definition: not made by art, natural, Philostr.Im.2.9

ἄφλοιος.definition: without integument or bark, Thphr.HP7.9.4, Carm.Pop.33, Epigr. ap. Plu.Flam.9, Ath.Med. ap. Orib.1.11.1

ἀήθεια.definition: Ion. metri gr.], unaccustomedness, novelty of a situation, Batr.72,Pl.Ti.18c; inexperience of a thing, Th.4.55; from inexperience, Pl.Tht.175d; Aen.Tact.38.3

ἀντανισόω.definition: make equal adjust, compensate, Lib.Or.59.161:—Pass., Them.in Ph.137.21

ἀλκίμαχος.definition: bravely fighting, or defender in fight, of Athena, AP6.124

ἀμφιδρυφής.definition: torn on both sides, a wife who has torn both cheeks, in grief, Il.2.700, Orac. ap. Hdt.6.77

ἀθυρόγλωττος.definition: one that cannot keep his mouth shut, ceaseless babbler, E.Or.903

ἀναδέρω.definition: poet. strip a scab off; metaph., lay bare, expose, Ar.Ra.1106 , cf. Luc.Pseudol.20:—Med., Philostr.VS1.25.3

ἀλεξίμορος.definition: warding off death, i. e. Apollo, Artemis, Athena, S.OT164

ἀφήγημα.definition: Ion. tale, narrative; guiding, leading, LXX4 Ma.14.6

ἀκοντιστήρ.definition: as Adj., darting, hurtling, Opp.H.5.535: metaph., Nonn.D.7.264:—also in pass. sense, 24.134, 30.230; prob. bullets, Keil-Premerstein Dritter Bericht p.89

ἀκίβδηλος.definition: unadulterated, genuine, Pl.Lg.916d; metaph., of men, guileless, honest, Adv. Isoc.1.7

ἀρσίπους.definition: gen. contr. for raising the foot, active, h.Ven.211, AP7.717

ἄρρητος.definition: also E.Hec.201:—unspoken; that cannot be spoken or expressed, Pl.Sph.238c: hence, unspeakable, immense, App.BC3.4; Phld.Ir.p.50 W.; Id.Lib.p.51 O

ἄροτρον.definition: in boxing, right-handed blow, Paus.6.10.2, Philostr.Gym.20; in pl., metaph. of the organs of generation, Nonn.D.12.46, al

ἀντιπήγνυμι.definition: in pf. to be fixed opposite, of crocodile's teeth, Tim.Gaz. in An.Ox.4.264

ἀνάκλαστος.definition: bent back, reflected: metaph., of participles derived from Nouns or Adjectives, Plu.2.1011d

ἀτύρωτος.definition: not curdled or coagulated, Dsc.3.34, Orib.Fr.137

ἀτιμαστέος.definition: to be despised, Hp.Fract.31; one must dishonour, X.Smp.4.17, Hippiatr.Praef

ἀρχέτας.definition: Dor. for leader, prince, E.El.1149: as Adj., princely throne, Id.Heracl.753

ἀωρόλειος.definition: unnaturally smooth, esp. men who by pulling out their beards tried to make themselves look young, Cratin.10; of a youth, beardless, Ael.NA13.27

ἀγνώμων.definition: gen. ill-judging; headstrong, reckless, Hdt.9.41: Sup., X.Mem.1.2.26

ἀρνεώς.definition: ram, IG2.844.5: gen. pl. read by Zenod. in Il.3.273

αἰνόλεκτρος.definition: fatally wedded, ib.713; with a frightful bed, of the cave of Echidna, Id.1354

ἀντίταξις.definition: a setting in array against; generally, opposition, D.H.10.57, Plu.2.663b, Andronic.Rhod.p.572M

ἀνθέμιον.definition: honeysuckle pattern on Ionic columns, IG1.322; so tattooed with a similar pattern, of the Mossynoeci, X.An.5.4.32: pl.,artificial flowers, IG11.161B50

ἀναφορέω.definition: = I, but used in a frequentat. sense, Hdt.3.102,111, Th.4.115

ἀπόσπασμα.definition: that which is torn off, a piece; avulsion, tearing apart of bones, Hp.Off.23, cf. Gal.18.887

ἀρχέλαος.definition: leading the people, chief, A.Pers.297 ; contr. Ar.Eq.164

αὐχέω.definition: chiefly pres. and impf. fut; c. acc. et inf., boast or declare loudly that . . , Hdt.2.160; Th.2.39; E.Andr.311, cf. Ba.310: c. acc. only, boast , IG14.2001, cf. 3.172

ἀμαλακιστία.definition: incapability of being softened, hardness, etym. of D.S.4.35

ἀνορεξία.definition: want of desire or appetite, Ti.Locr.102e, Aret.CA2.3

ἀποτρυγάω.definition: pluck grapes or fruit, Philostr.VA3.5; ib.3.4: metaph., LXXAm.6.1

ἀναδέσμη.definition: band for women's hair, snood, Il.22.469, cf. AP5.275 , E.Med.978 Porson

ἀκεσφόρος.definition: bringing cure, healing, c. gen. rei, E.Ion1005, Astyd.Trag.6

ἀκόνη.definition: whetstone, hone, Chilo1; metaph., I feel the shrill note of a whetstone on my tongue, i.e. am roused to song, Pi.O.6.82; of persons, e.g. a trainer, Pi.I.6.73; of AP12.18 , cf. Plu.2.838e

ἀνόργανος.definition: without instruments, Plu.Per.16; Porph.Abst.1.6; monement without limbs for the purpose, of serpents, Plu.2.381b

ἀπεκδέχομαι.definition: expect anxiously, await eagerly; misunderstand, misinterpret, Hipparch.1.6.11, al

ἀποικίς.definition: pecul. fem. of a colony, Hdt.7.167, Plu.Cor.28; and without Str.10.4.17

ἀμφινωμάω.definition: distribute, turn over or peer round, h.Cer.373

ἀποκακέω.definition: sink under a weight of misery, LXXJe.15.9

ἀνθρωποπαθής.definition: with human feelings, ib.182, al. Adv. of the gods, Hermog.Id.2.10

ἀδιώμοτος.definition: not feeling bound by an oath, Procop.Arc.5

ἀκέντητος.definition: needing no spur, Pi.O.1.21, AP5.202; metaph., unpricked, by love, Chor.Zach.5

ἀλλαντοειδής.definition: sausage-shaped, the allantoid membrane of the foetus, Gal.UP15.5, Aët.16.2

ἄοσμος.definition: having no smell, v.l. in Hp.Acut.63, Arist.Sens.443a10: Comp., ib.19; opp. Thphr.CP6.16.5; cf

ἀντιψωμίζω.definition: feed with dainty morsels in rivalry, Arg.1 Ar. Eq

ἀνακλάω.definition: bend back, Hp.Fract.13; break short off, or more prob., fend off, Th.2.76; prob. in D.C.66.4

ἀνάρρηξις.definition: breaking up, Plu.Ant.66 : haemorrhage from lungs, Hp.Prorrh.2.7

ἀπήρινος.definition: without scrotum, restored by Coraeës in Archestr.8.9

ἀδαίτρευτος.definition: for which nothing has been slain, Nonn.D.17.51, 40.419

ἀκρισία.definition: want of distinctness and order; want of judgement, bad judgement or choice, Plb.2.35.3, AP7.629 ; Luc.Tim.8

ἀναθλάω.definition: crush in pieces, in aor. v.l. in Q.S.8.94

ἀποσαλεύω.definition: lie in the roadstead, ride at anchor; trans., shake, cause to move, Gal.6.141:—Pass. , to be loosened, shaken away, Ruf.Ren.Ves.12.3; be shaken from one's opinion, Arr.Epict.3.26.16

ἁψιδόομαι.definition: Pass., to be tied in a circle or curve, AP6.90

ἀφιλόλογος.definition: without love for learning literature, Plu.2.673a

ἀμετάπτωτος.definition: unchanging, unchangeable; not losing its power, of medicine, Gal.12.422

ἀπρόρρητος.definition: not foretold, Pl.Lg.968e, as Ast for

ἄβρωτος.definition: uneatable, not good for food; not eaten, Nic.Fr.74.44; Porph.Abst.2.27:—of wood, not eaten by worms, Thphr.HP5.1.2

ἀδρανέω.definition: to be weak, of starlight, Arat.471, cf. Opp.H.1.296, Nonn.D.32.280

ἀπόκλασμα.definition: fracture near a joint, Hp.Off.23; morsel of bread, Alex.Trall.7.9

ἀναχράομαι.definition: use up, and so, make away with, destroy; use, IG5.1390.60

ἀσχημάτιστος.definition: without form or figure; that cannot be represented by a figure, Theol. Ar.11

ἀδύναμος.definition: weak, of wine, Dsc.5.6: —without potency, Procl.Inst.80,149: absence of potency, Olymp.in Phd.p.40N.:—Astrol., of planets, Ptol.Tetr.53

ἀντικύρω.definition: aor. hit upon, encounter, meet, Pi.O.12.12, S.OC99, etc.: abs., Id.Ph.545

ἄπλευρος.definition: without sides or ribs, narrow chest, Arist.Phgn.810a3, cf. 809b7 ; of persons, narrow-chested, opp. ib.810b13, Telesp.55.3 H., Mnesith. ap. Orib.21.7.6

ἀρτυσίλαος.definition: or a public servant at Delos, Ath.4.173a :—also , ibid

ἀπόφανσις.definition: declaration, statement; in Logic, predication, or affirmative or negative, Arist.Int.17a25, cf. Chrysipp.Stoic.2.59

ἀτέραμνος.definition: unsoftened, hard, ib.1; metaph., stubborn, unfeeling, merciless, Od.23.167; A.Pr.192; ib.1062

ἀνθαιρέομαι.definition: choose one person or thing instead of; dispute, lay claim to, Id.Hec.660

ἀμήν.definition: Hebr. Adv. verily, of a truth, so be it, LXX1 Ch.16.36; at beginning of sentence, Ev.Matt.5.18, al.; doubled, Ev.Jo.1.51, al.; 1 Ep.Cor.14.16

ἀείδασμος.definition: subject to a perpetual charge, GDI5661 ; 20.169

ἀναδεύω.definition: soak, steep, Thphr.HP9.13.3: metaph; mix into a paste, Phylarch.26, cf. Plu.2.997a

ἀποκοτταβίζω.definition: dash out the last drops of wine, as in; metaph., vomit, Herod. Med. ap. Orib.10.8.12

ἀμβλύνω.definition: fut. A.Th.715: aor; Pass., become blunt or dull, lose edge, of the teeth, Arist.PA661b22, cf. GA789a9; of eyesight, LXXGe.27.1

ἀντιτυπής.definition: resisting, repellent, Hdn.6.7.7; metaph., hard, Alex.Aphr.de An.125.9; Ph.2.162

ἄβρωμος.definition: free from smell, Diph.Siph. ap. Ath.8.355b, Xenocr.9, Dsc.1.16, Aët.9.1

αἱμωδία.definition: sensation of having the teeth set on edge, caused by acid food or vomit, Hp.Morb.2.16, Arist.Pr.863b11, Dsc.Eup.1.72 , Archig. ap. Gal.8.86

ἀγλαόφημος.definition: of splendid fame, Orph.H.31.4; Dor. pr. n. of Thracian mystic, Iamb.VP28.146, etc

ἀναθαρσύνω.definition: Att. fill with fresh courage; intr., = foreg., Plu.Luc.14

ἀπόξυρος.definition: cut sharp off, abrupt, sheer, Luc.Rh.Pr.7, Prom.1, cf. Peripl.M.Rubr.40

ἀνδροτυχής.definition: getting a man or husband, wedded life, A.Eu.959

αἴγιθος.definition: also an unknown bird, possibly linnet, Arist.HA609a31, 616b10, Call.Fr.321, Ael.NA5.48, etc

ἀντιδρομέω.definition: run in a contrary direction, Luc.Astr.12

ἀκράσπεδος.definition: without fringes: metaph., of words, without the article, Plu.2.1010d

ἄριγος.definition: or insensible to cold, Arist.Pr.959b17, Aret.SD1.14

ἁλίζωος.definition: living on or in the sea, AP7.654 , Pancrat. ap. Ath.7.321f

ἀμφίδετος.definition: bound or set all round, AP6.103

ἀσυμβίβαστος.definition: not to be brought into union, not to be reconciled or harmonized, Eust.1658.40

αἴθων.definition: of animals or birds, Il.2.839; 15.690; Od.18.372; Pi.O.11 .20; of a boar, B.5.124; prob. of colour, red- brown, tawny, since sleek, shining, or fiery, fierce do not suit all cases ; pr. n. of horse, Il.8.185

ἀντεξάγω.definition: export in return, X.Vect.3.2; evict in return, BGU1273.34

ἀνθρωπόομαι.definition: to have the concept or idea of a man, Plu.2.1120d

ἄξιφος.definition: without sword, Lyc.50, A.D.Synt.187.10. Adv. Hdn.Epim.257

ἀξίωμα.definition: that of which one is thought worthy; honour, reputation, E.Supp.424, Th.2.65, etc.; Id.6.15; D.59.113: c. gen. objecti, claim on ground of merit, Arist.Pol.1281b25

ἀπαρουσιάστως.definition: Adv., without bodily presence, Olymp.in Alc.p.13C

ἀοχλησία.definition: freedom from disturbance, Epicur.Ep.3p.62U.; S.E.P.1.10, cf. Posidon.Stoic.3.5

ἀνυπόδητος.definition: unshod, barefoot, as the philosophers; having the feet unprotected, Pl.Prt.321c

ἀκρατής.definition: powerless, impotent; in Law, invalid, GDI5653 , cf. IG12.267.12

ἀνοιδέω.definition: Ep. Nic.Th.855: fut. aor; metaph., Hdt.7.39; . . Phld.Ir.p.63 W.; of anger, Philostr.VA7.33 ; Philostr.VA4.4

ἀντίβιος.definition: also : :—opposing force; Subst., enemy, Jul.Caes.319b , Nonn.D.2.508, al., Opp.H.5.114

ἀναισίμωμα.definition: = Att. that which is used up, the war- expenses, Hdt.5.31

αὐταρκέω.definition: supply with necessaries; to be sufficient, Arist.EE1242a8, PLips.29.11

ἀσβέστινον.definition: a non-combustible material, dub. l. in Plin.HN19.20

ἄψυχος.definition: lifeless, inanimate, Archil.84; non-animal food, E.Hipp.952

ἀναζητέω.definition: search out, discover, OGI267 ; search for, Ph.1.40

ἄτιμος.definition: unhonoured, dishonoured; c.gen., without the honour of . . , not deemed worthy of . . , A.Ch.409 ; ib.295; Id.Th.1029; no unworthy return for . . , Id.Ag.354; S.OT789

ἄρκτιον.definition: bearwort, Inula candida, Dsc.4.105, Nic.Th.840, Plin. HN27.33

ἀντίλογος.definition: contradictory, reverse, E.Hel.1142 ; love of contradiction, Simp.in Ph.1135.28, cf. Epicur.Nat.28Fr.8

ἀνακλισμός.definition: back of a chair or couch, Hp.Art.7, Erot. s.v

ἀναγραφή.definition: inscribing, registering, of properties; codification, Lys.30.25

ἀμφιτινάσσω.definition: shake around, . . swung round the door in my face, AP5.255

ἀραιόω.definition: make porous, rarefy; Pass., to be rarefied, Hp.Vict.1.13, Arist.Mu.394a36; Ph.Bel.71.43

ἁμματίζω.definition: tie, bind, in Pass., Orib.49.21.4 , Heliod. ib.48.28.4, Apollod.Poliorc.180.13

ἀποστέργω.definition: get rid of love, love no more, Theoc.14.50; empty of love, harden, LXXDe.15.7

ἀποπήγνυμι.definition: make to freeze, freeze; of blood, congeal, Hp.Morb.Sacr.9:—Pass., X.An.5.8.15

ἀκόντισμα.definition: distance thrown with javelin; dart, javelin, Str.4.6.7 , Plu.Alex.43, Arr.Tact.9.1

ἀθάλασσος.definition: Att. without sea, far; = Max.Tyr.1.3; Secund.Sent.16

ἀρητός.definition: Ion. for as pr.n., Od.7.54, etc

ἀνάγραπτος.definition: rendered famous, immortalized, Him.Or.15.5; marked with, c. dat., Hld.4.8, 8.11; painted, in a picture, Chor.inPhilol.54.111

ἀγλαόκαρπος.definition: bearing beautiful or; with fair wrists, of Thetis, Pi.N.3.56

ἀνορταλίζω.definition: clap the wings and crow, like a cock, Ar.Eq.1344

ἀπαξία.definition: opp. disvalue, Zeno Stoic.1.48, cf. Antip. ib.3.251, Arr.Epict.1.2.10, S.E.M.11.62

ἄφαλσις.definition: jumping exercise, Aret.CD1.3, Philum. ap. Orib.45.29.37, Antyll.ib.6.31.1

ἀμφιδέμω.definition: build round about, in aor. 1 Med. J.BJ5.5.1

ἀποσφαλμάω.definition: fall headlong, of a horse, Plb.Fr.18

ἀναχωρητής.definition: one who has retired from the world, anchoret, Just.Nov.5.3 , Rev.Épigr.1.159

ἀποξυλίζω.definition: deprive of its woody fibre, Arist.Pr.873b4

ἀπολιγαίνω.definition: speak with a shrill voice, bluster; make shrill music, Plu.2.713a

ἀπολακτίζω.definition: kick off or away, shake off; spurn, A.Pr.651; Plu.Ant.36

ἄροσις.definition: arable land, corn-land, Il.9.580; ploughing, Arat.1055, Arist.Mu.399b17, Ael.NA13.1

αἰθροβάτης.definition: walking through ether, of Abaris; rope-dancer, Man.4.278

ἀλεύκαντος.definition: not growing white, Cat. Cod.Astr.8.157, cf. Gloss

ἄπαστος.definition: not having eaten, abstaining; c. gen., without having tasted meat or drink, Od.4.788, cf. 6.250, h.Cer.200: a meal which feeds not, Opp.H.2.250

ἀμφιδονέω.definition: whirl round, agitate violently, AP9.668 , cf. 5.121

ἀφάρτερος.definition: Comp. Adj. more fleet, Il.23.311; cf. Dionys.Epic. ap. St.Byz. s.v

ἀκοή.definition: Ep. :—hearing, sound; thing heard, tidings, Od.2.308, 4.701; according to Solon's story, Pl.Ti.21a; report, Pi.P.1.84,90; thing for wise men to listen to, ib.9.78; by hearsay, Hdt.2.29,148; Antipho5.67, Th.4.126; Pl.P…

ἀποκλέπτω.definition: fut. to steal away, run away with, h.Merc.522: —Pass., aor. 2 to be robbed of, interpol. in Artem.2.59

ἀπόχρησις.definition: getting rid of, dub; consumption, using up, Ep.Col.2.22

ἀμφώδων.definition: with incisor-teeth in; Subst., ass, Lyc.1401

ἀμβολίη.definition: poet. for delay, A.R.3.144: c. gen., 4.396, Nonn.D.38.12, al

ἁψίς.definition: Ep. and Ion. loop, mesh; felloe of a wheel, Hes.Op.426, Lyr.in PLG3.740; the wheel itself, Hdt.4.72, E.Hipp.1233; the potter's wheel, APl.4.191

ἀνάπωσις.definition: a drinking up, Erot. s.v. s.v.l. cf

ἀφυπνόω.definition: awake from sleep, AP9.517; fall asleep, Ev.Luc.8.23, Paul.Aeg.1.98:—Med., Hld.9.12

ἀρίθμιος.definition: = numerical, Iamb.Comm.Math.9; by; Astrol., determining number, Vett.Val.145.23; Id.278.30

ἀποστάτης.definition: deserter, rebel; runaway slave, Plu.Rom.0; runaway dog, Id.2.821d

ἀνταγοράζω.definition: buy with money received in payment for something else, X.An.1.5.5; D.35.24

ἀνδρομανής.definition: mad after men, lustful, Plu.Comp.Lyc.Num.3, AB394

ἀσύννευστος.definition: non-convergent; of curve and asymptote, Procl.in Euc.p.177F

ἄλυχνος.definition: without lamp or light, E.Fr.411, D.L.1.81

ἁλιπτοίητος.definition: driven by fear across the sea, Nonn.D.8.58, cf. 13.119; perh. Act. in meaning, 39.85

ἀνεπερώτητος.definition: not asked for or arranged for, Just.Nov.136.4

ἀπόμισθος.definition: away from pay, unpaid; paid off, discharged, D.23.154, cf. Aen.Tact.5.2 and 11.4; Com.Adesp.226

ἄσπλαγχνος.definition: without bowels, or rather, without; not eating Pl.Com.113

ἀνθυποβάλλω.definition: bring objections in turn, retort; substitute fraudulently, Ph.2.630

ἀρύβαλλος.definition: bagor purse, made so as to draw; globular oil-flask, Ar.Eq.1094, Ath.11.783f

ἀποικοδομέω.definition: cut off by building, wall up, barricade; rebuild , Jul.Or.2.66a

ἀφώρατος.definition: not detected, Oenom. ap. Eus.PE5.20. Adv. Ph.2.521

ἀλλότριος.definition: Aeol. EM529.24, of; opp. foreign, strange

ἀμαίευτος.definition: not yet delivered, Nonn.D.1.5; without aid of midwife, Opp.C.1.40

ἀποχειμάζω.definition: blow over, when the wind drops, Arist.Pr.943b31

ἀκόλλητος.definition: not cemented or glued, BCH35.43; incapable of being compacted, D.H.Comp.22

ἀλείπτης.definition: anointer: hence; metaph., Ph.2.409; teacher, Plu.Per.4; S.E.M.1.298

ἀργιβόειος.definition: with white kine, of Euboea, Poet. ap. Ael.NA12.36

ἄφλεβος.definition: without veins, Thphr.HP1.5.3; without visible veins, Gal.18.598:—Eust.54.16 has

ἀρτίστομος.definition: speaking in good idiom, or with; with a good mouth or opening, Str.5.4.5; Id.17.1.6

ἀνανοέω.definition: call to mind, v.l. in X.Eph.1.11

ἀπόπλοος.definition: contr. sailing away; voyage home or back, X.An.5.6.20; of the Greeks at Troy, Arist.Po.1457b7

ἀλοιητήρ.definition: thresher, grinder, as Adj., Nonn.D.17.237; grinders, AP11.379 : metaph., Orac. ap. Jul.Mis.370a

ἀγραυλία.definition: service in the field, D.H.6.44 , D.S.16.15, etc

ἀνούτατος.definition: unwounded by stroke of sword; invulnerable, Nonn.D.16.157,al

ἀνηβητήριος.definition: making young again, the returning strength of youth, E.Andr.552

ἀποδρομή.definition: harbour of refuge, dub. in Peripl.M.Rubr.3

ἀμφιθάλπω.definition: warm on both sides, cherish, Luc.Trag.28

ἀντιπαράγω.definition: shift in order to meet attacks; Pass., to be produced correspondingly, Plot.2.4.11

ἀσφοδέλινος.definition: of asphodel, a ship built of asphodel stalks, Luc.VH2.26

ἀμετάπειστος.definition: not to be moved by persuasion; of things, unchangeable, steadfast, D.S.37.20

ἀμφισβήτημα.definition: point in dispute, question; point maintained in argument, Pl.Phlb.11b

ἄχνοος.definition: contr. without down, AP6.259 , cf. 242 , Q.S.4.431, Nonn.D.10.180: metaplast. acc. pl. Man.1.126

ἀπάρθενος.definition: no more a maid, Theoc.2.41; 'virgin wife and widowed maid', E.Hec.612

ἀπεριόριστος.definition: unlimited, infinite; of poems in uniform metre, indefinite in length, Heph.Poëm.6.2

ἀκρομανής.definition: on the verge of madness, somewhat mad , Hdt.5.42

ἀντίληξις.definition: motion for a new trial, D.39.38; cf

ἀρτιτρεφής.definition: just nursed, wailings of young children, A.Th.350 cod. Med

αὐθαίμων.definition: gen. of the same blood, brother, sister, kinsman, S.Tr.1041 :—also Id.OC1078, AP7.707

ἀθέρμαντος.definition: not heated; A.Ch.629, either a cold hearth, or a household not heated by strife or passion

ἁλοσάνθινος.definition: prepared with efflorescence of salt, Dsc.5.76 tit

ἀμάλακτος.definition: that cannot be softened; unmitigated, Plu.2.953e: metaph. of expression, harsh, Longin.15.5

ἀγαθοτυχέω.definition: Astrol., occupy the house of Vett.Val.83.20; . . Cat.Cod.Astr.1.118

ἀναπυρέττω.definition: suffer from recurrence of fever, Gal.16.649

ἀποσκότωσις.definition: darkening, loss of sight, Nech. ap. Vett.Val.279.33

ἀϋλία.definition: immateriality, Hierocl.in CA26p.479M., Syrian.in Metaph.27.30, Nicom.Ar.1.3

ἀναδαίω.definition: poet. light up, A.Ag.305: —Pass., metaph., A.R.4.1726

ἀντίδωρον.definition: return-gift, Men.Prot.p.20D., Just.Nov.120.11, v.l. for in A.Fr.194

ἄτρεπτος.definition: unchangeable, opp; Medic., of food, undigested, Aret.SD1.16, Gal.16.800

ἀνόλεθρος.definition: not ruined, having escaped ruin, Il.13.761

ἀσπιδαποβλής.definition: one that throws away his shield, runaway, Ar.V.592

ἀναποδόω.definition: = II, Plu.2.876f; grow fresh feet, of scorpions, Lyd.Mag.1.42

ἀποπίνω.definition: drink up, drink off, Hdt.4.70; Critias33: abs., Philostr.Ep.60

ἀνέκφαντος.definition: not to be revealed or uttered, i.e. mystical, obscure, Procl.in Prm.p.549S., in Ti.3.169D. Adv. Id.in Prm.p.589 S., cf. Eust.382.9

ἀγάλακτος.definition: getting no milk, A.Ag.718; pastures bad for milch cattle, Gal.6.346

ἀγέλοιος.definition: not laughable, no bad joke, Henioch.4.6. Adv. Arg.1Ar.Ra

ἁλιρραγής.definition: against which the tide breaks, AP7.383

ἀεσίφρων.definition: gen. = damaged in mind, witless, silly, Il.20.183, Od.21.302, Hes.Op.335

ἄνατος.definition: unharmed, B.Fr.19; Act., not harming, harmless, A.Supp.356,359, 410

ἀποπράσσω.definition: demand the return of, IG12.42 :— Pass., ib.4.752.9 :—Med., exact to the uttermost, Them.Or.21.260b

ἀκήρυκτος.definition: unannounced, unproclaimed; without flag of truce, App.Mith.104. Adv. Th.1.146; cf. foreg

ἀντιμέτειμι.definition: compete with others: rival competitors, Plu.Comp.Arist.Cat.2

ἀθήλυντος.definition: not womanish, Ptol.Tetr.69; Pythag., of odd numbers, Theol.Ar.53.20

ἀντιζηλόω.definition: in Pass., to be emulous of, rival, Vett. Val.47.15

ἀκάρπιστος.definition: where nothing is to be reaped, unfruitful, of the sea, E.Ph.210

ἀποδηλόω.definition: make manifest, A.Fr.304.2, Hp.Int.23; intr., become manifest, Arist.Mir.834b33

ἀπέρατος.definition: not to be crossed or passed, Plu.2.326e, Luc.VH2.30: metaph., A.Supp.1049

αὐτόπειρος.definition: learnt by one's own experience, Dam.Isid.121

ἀσκίον.definition: Dim. of Hp.Liqu.6, Aff.21, Plu.Art.12: prov. of empty threats, Crates Com.8

αἰνόδρυπτος.definition: terribly scarred, term of abuse for a slave, Theoc.15.27

ἀποδημητής.definition: one who goes abroad, is not tied to his home, opp. Th.1.70

ἀποτερματίζω.definition: bound, limit, define; Med., look towards, prob. for in Hp.Decent.3

ἀνταμφοδέω.definition: miss a person in the street going to meet him, BGU1030.5

ἀπόνιψις.definition: washing off or away, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.Fr.106, prob. l. for in Callix.2

ἀγυμνασία.definition: want of exercise or training, Ar.Ra.1088, Arist.EN1114a24 = foreg., Porph.Abst.1.35

ἀγριοβάλανος.definition: evergreen oak, Quercus pseudo- coccifera, Aq.Thd.Is.44.14

ἀντιτείνω.definition: fut. Pl.R.604a :—stretch, strain; stretch out or offer in return, E.Med.891

ἀλογίζομαι.definition: Dep., to be irrational, Eust.1656.43, etc.:—Act. only as f.l. for Procop.Goth.4.20

ἀσυμπώρωτος.definition: not become callous; of fractured bones that have not united, Dsc.1.112

ἀναγνώρισμα.definition: = foreg., Hp.Flat.14:—pl. tokens of recognition, Lat. crepundia, Charis.p.550 K

ἀνορμίζω.definition: take [ships] from their moorings, D.C.48.48:—Med., put to sea, Id.42.7:—Pass., anchor above, Id.71.2

ἄνεφθος.definition: unboiled, Antyll. ap. Orib.9.24.3; unbaked, Agath.2.16

ἀπόρρησις.definition: forbidding, prohibition; giving up, Pl.R.357a; refusalto give testimony, Plu.Mar.5; renunciation of a truce, Plb.14.2.14

ἀμφιφαής.definition: everywhere visible, Arist.Mu.395b14; visible from all sides, Dam.Pr.122, cf. Orac.Chald.62

ἀγλαόπαις.definition: rich in fair children, Opp.H.2.41, Epigr.Gr.896

ἀηδόνιος.definition: of a nightingale; of sleep, light, Nicoch.4 D., cf. Nonn.D.5.411

ἀποστροφή.definition: turning back, X.Eq.9.6; Max; twisting, Trag.Oxy. 1083.10

ἀπόκοπος.definition: castrated, Str.13.4.14, Vett.Val.113.28; abrupt, precipitous, Peripl.M.Rubr.32

ἀπόθεσις.definition: laying up in store; the final movement in setting a dislocated or fractured limb, Gal.18.332, al., Pall.in Hp.Fract.12.273C.; f.l. in Hp.Off.19

ἀπόμοργμα.definition: that which is wiped off, Eust.218.12

ἀμφινεικής.definition: contested on all sides, eagerly wooed, of Helen, A.Ag.686; of Deïanira, S.Tr.104

ἀπονεύρωσις.definition: end of the muscle, where it becomes tendinous, Gal.4.368, 13.603

ἁρπάξανδρος.definition: snatching away men, A.Th.776, restored by Herm. for

ἀνάδαστος.definition: divided anew, redistributed; later, undo, rescind, OGI669.20 , Luc.Abd.11

ἀναπέσσω.definition: Att. digest again, f.l. in Arist.HA565b23

ἀρχίθρονος.definition: occupying the chief seat, presiding, Choerob. in An.Ox.2.182

ἀστύτριψ.definition: always living in the city, Critias72 D., Philostr.Im.2.26

ἀποταυρόομαι.definition: Pass., to be like a bull; of Io, to be changed into a heifer, Erot. s.v

ἀσκίαστος.definition: unshaded, Onos.10.5, Eust.1550.63; not clouded by rust, etc., Maria ap.Zos.Alch.p.152 B., cf. ib.182

ἀπρόθεσμος.definition: not fixed to any definite time, opp. Sor.1.33

ἀμέριμνος.definition: free from care, unconcerned, Men.1083; Pass., uncared for, S.Aj.1207

ἄνευρος.definition: without sinews, Hp.Mochl.41; nerveless, slack, S.Ichn.143, Theopomp.Com.71, Arist.HA538b7 , al.; Phld.Ir.p.69 W

ἀρχαιολογέω.definition: discuss antiquities or things out of; use an old-fashioned style, Luc.Lex.15

ἀπαγριόομαι.definition: become wild or savage; of plants, revert to wild state, Thphr.HP2.2.9, 3.2.2

ἁδρόβωλος.definition: in large pieces or masses, of bdellium, Dsc.1.67

ἀδιεξίτητος.definition: that cannot be exhausted; with no outlet, Orib.9.20.3

αὐτομολέω.definition: metaph., keep changing sides, rat, Aeschin.3.75; D.S.2.26; come of one's own accord, Lyd.Ost.39

ἀξίωσις.definition: gen. Ion. thinking worthy; being thought worthy, one's reputation, character, Th.1.138, cf. 6.54; Id.2.61; excellence, D.H.Comp.4

ἄδεκτος.definition: not receptive, Thphr.Metaph.9; Pass., incomprehensible, dub. l. in Ph.1.486

ἀποσκιασμός.definition: the casting a shadow, measures of time by the shadow on the sun-dial, Plu.Per.6

ἀνθρακίζω.definition: make charcoal of, roast or toast, Ar.Pax1136; carbonize, PHolm.6.4

ἀπόλογος.definition: story, tale, of long; fable, apologue, allegory, Cic.Orat.2.66.264, Quint. Inst.6.3.44, Gell.2.29.20

ἀκάπηλος.definition: free from tricks of trade, Str.11.8.7

ἀργῖτις.definition: vine with white grapes, Virg.G.2.99, Plin.HN14.35, Isid.Etym.17.5.23

ἀνέλιγμα.definition: anything rolled up, a ringlet, AP6.210 , cf. 7.485

αὐτοσταδίη.definition: stand-up fight, close fight, Ep. word, used only in dat., Il.13.325

ἀπόπροθε.definition: before vowels Adv., prop. from; c. gen., far away from, Archil.25; Q.S.1.414

ἀσύμβαμα.definition: not a or full predicate, Priscian.Inst. 18.1.4

ἀφειδία.definition: generosity, liberality, Pl.Def.412c; unsparing treatment, Ep.Col.2.23

ἀνθοφυής.definition: parti-coloured, of a parrot; producing flowers, IG12.954.13

ἀνάχωμα.definition: dike, dam, Aristeas301, Harp. s.v. cf

ἀδράνεια.definition: or listlessness, weakness; non-efficiency, Simp.in Cael.136.30

ἀπόστασις.definition: causing to revolt; slackness, of bandages, Gal.18.806

ἀήσυρος.definition: light as air, A.Pr.452; Call.Fr.anon.3; Orph.Fr.18; springing lightly, Tryph.360; blowing softly, A.R.2.1101

ἀφιλανθρωπία.definition: lack of human feeling, Arist.VV1251b3, Phld.Oec.p.68J

ἀερομαντεία.definition: divination by air, Varr. ap. Serv.ad Virg.Aen.3.359
