ἀντίχρησις.definition: substitution of usufruct for interest, Dig.20.1.11.1

ἀποπλανάω.definition: fut. lead astray, make to digress; distribute, in Pass., Hp.Alim.33

ἀωρότοκος.definition: laid prematurely, of soft-shelled eggs, Hippiatr.22

ἀνακολπόω.definition: = foreg., EM410.20:—Pass., form a bay, Anon.Geog.Comp.40

ἀφαίρεμα.definition: that which is taken away as the; tribute, LXX1 Ma.15.5

ἄφθονος.definition: without envy: hence; Act., free from envy, Pi.O.6.7; Hdt.3.80, cf. Pl.R.500a. Adv. Id.Lg.731a

ἀλλοκοτία.definition: absurdity, Simp.in Ph.1142.31, in Epict.p.72 D

ἀρχέτυπος.definition: first-moulded as a pattern or model; Astrol., = SerapioinCat.Cod.Astr.8.226, Vett. Val.67.3

ἀβολέω.definition: later Ep. for meet, A.R.3.1145; Ep. aor. Id.2.770, Call.Fr.455

ἁλίστονος.definition: sea-resounding, A.Pr.712; groaning on the sea, of fishers, Opp.H.4.149

ἀγροβότης.definition: Dor. feeding in the field, dwelling in the country, S.Ph.214 , E.Cyc.54

ἀντιστοιχία.definition: standing opposite in pairs; of letters, correspondence, of the relation of tenuis, media, and aspirate to each other, Ascl.Myrl. ap. Ath.11.501b

ἀνέκβατος.definition: without outlet, Th.3.98; not 'coming off', opp. Cat.Cod. Astr.5.89.31

ἀντίσπαστος.definition: drawn in the contrary direction; spasmodic, convulsive, S.Tr.770

ἀπείραστος.definition: incapable of being tempted; without experience, Alciphr.3.37

ἀτεκνία.definition: childlessness, barrenness, Arist.Pol.1265b10, Ph.1.201, etc.: pl., Arist.Pol.1265a41

ἄλκασμα.definition: in pl., deeds of prowess, S.Ichn.247

αὐτόρριζος.definition: together with the roots, D.S.4.12; self-rooted, self-founded, E.Rh.288

αἰχμητήρ.definition: = Opp.C.3.211, Q.S.8.85, Nonn.D.28.122; as Adj., prize of the spear, ib.42.501

ἀνόητος.definition: not thought on, unheard of; not within the province of thought, Pl.Prm.132c; not the object of thought, unthinkable, Plot.5.3.6 and 10. Adv. without discursive thought, of vision, Id.6.7.16

αὐτοδιήγητος.definition: narrated in the first person, opp. dialogue, D.L.9.111

ἀφόρμικτος.definition: without the lyre, of melancholy music, A.Eu.332

ἀρτιοδύναμος.definition: of even power, of numbers the halves of which are even, Nicom.Ar.1.8

ἀθεραπεία.definition: = sq., neglect of medical care, Antipho4.3.5

ἀρρυθμία.definition: want of rhythm or proportion, Pl.R.401a

ἀντοχή.definition: adhesion, Orib.45.2.6, Gal.19.440; attachment, c. gen., of rings, Alex.Aphr.Pr.2.67: metaph., Procl.in Ti.1.75 D

ἀκαλλής.definition: without charms, Hp.Ep.15; Luc.Hist. Conscr.48; Id.Prom.14; Procl.in Alc.p.326 C.: Comp., Olymp.in Grg.p.243J

ἀρτόκρεας.definition: bread and meat, prob. = Lat. visceratio, IGRom.4.1348 , Pers.6.50, Gloss.; artocria CIL9.5309

ἀνολισθάνω.definition: aor. slip or glide back, return, Call.Fr.96

ἀνυπάκουστος.definition: not suited for hearing, i.e. for declamation, Phld.Rh.1.198 S

ἀποκαθίζω.definition: sit apart, of a judge; sit down, Plu.2.649c; of the uterus, slip down, Sor.2.85

ἀμβλυχειλής.definition: with rounded rim, of cupping-glass, Antyll. ap. Orib.7.16.15

ἀσυμφωνέω.definition: to be out of harmony with, Plot.1.1.12

ἀνεμόσυρις.definition: a kind of fan: hence, fan-shaped whirlwind, Olymp.in Mete.200.19

ἀόρατος.definition: unseen, invisible, Pl.Phd.85e, etc; Act., not having seen, without experience of, Plb.2.21.2, 3.108.6: abs., Luc.Halc.3

ἀνδροληψία.definition: seizure of foreigners in reprisal for the murder of a citizen abroad, Lex ap.D.23.82, 51.13, Ath.Mitt.32.245

ἀνόθευτος.definition: pure, genuine, Ps.-Plu.Fluv.7.4; free from adultery, Arist.Mir.846a30, Ps.-Plu.Fluv.5.2

ἀπολιβάζω.definition: cause to drop off, throw away, Pherecr.42; intr., drop off, vanish, Eup.206, cf. Ar.Av.1467

ἀλλόχροος.definition: contr. changed in colour, E.Hipp.174:—also looking strange or foreign, Id.Ph.138, Andr.879

ἄσκυλτος.definition: not pulled about, Heliod. ap; Act., without causing laceration, Herod.Med. ap.Orib.10.7.1: Comp. Sor.1.3

ἀναγκοτροφέω.definition: eat perforce: hence, eat by regimen, not after one's own appetite, like athletes, Epict.Ench.29.2

ἀπόθρισμα.definition: that which is cut off, Orph.A.1000

ἀσημείωτος.definition: unnoticed, Ph.1.121; without sign posts, of a road, Demetr.Eloc.202

ἀνάρροια.definition: back flow, reflux, Arist.Mir.843a27, Plu.2.929e ; Thphr.Metaph.29

αὐτοματίζω.definition: act of oneself, act offhand or; introduce the agency of chance, of Anaxagoras, Simp.in Ph.327.27

ἀγγαρεία.definition: impressment for the public service, OGI665.21 , cf. Arr.Epict.4.1.79; in pl. = cursus publicus, SIG880.53

ἄστρεπτος.definition: without turning the back, Theoc.24.96; unbending, rigid, ib.103 , cf. 6.71 ; Max.Tyr.11.3

ἄχολος.definition: lacking gall, Hp.Prorrh.1.98; lacking a; metaph., Alc.37A, cf. Plu.Daed.2

ἀνταφαιρέω.definition: take away in return, in Med; subtract from the opposite side, and subtraction from the opposite side, Nicom.Ar.1.13

ἄθυρος.definition: without door, IG11.287; metaph., open, unchecked, Adam.2.60; Nic.Al.132; Ph.1.678

αἱμοβότος.definition: feeding on blood, Orac. ap. Porph.Plot.22

ἀποφράση.definition: Cretan word for Seleuc. ap. Ath.6.267c:— Eust.1090.57 writes

ἀναφρύγω.definition: aor. 2 inf. Pass. dry up, Lyd.Ost.14

ἀστή.definition: fem. of Hdt.1.173, al., Ar.Th.541, BGU1104.4 , etc

ἀπερυγγάνω.definition: aor. belch forth, disgorge; abs., eructate, Arist.Pr.962a8

ἀμφίστροφος.definition: turning to and fro, quick-turning; at Delos, possibly a domed building, IG11.142.38 , al

ἄνθραξ.definition: charcoal, Sotad.Com.1.12: mostly in; coal, Thphr.Lap.16, PHolm.2.33; on a slow fire, Xenocr.16

ἀναπηνίζομαι.definition: unwind, reel off, of the thread of a silk worm's cocoon, Arist.HA551b14; ib.568a24

ἁρπαγμός.definition: robbery, rape, Plu.2.12a; concrete, prize to be grasped, Ep.Phil.2.6; cf. 2

ἀταγία.definition: absence of a in Thessaly, IG9.257

ἀφάνταστος.definition: without dreams, Gal.16.221,525; not sensibly presented, of pure form, Syrian.in Metaph.92.5

ἀντίμολπος.definition: sounding instead of, a shriek of far other note than the cry of joy, E.Med.1176; . . song, sleep's substitute, A.Ag.17

ἁγιολόγος.definition: speaking holy things, dub. in 1 Enoch1.2

ἀναλεαίνω.definition: bruise, crush, pound fine, v.l. in Dsc.5.74

ἀθανατίζω.definition: make immortal, Arist.Fr.645; regard as immortal, J.AJ18.1.5

ἀμφιθαλεύς.definition: = hence, in religious ceremonies, acolyte, BCH10.415 :— hence ib.11.98

ἀντιπαίω.definition: strike against, resist, Hp.VM22, cf. Arist.Pr.902b13: metaph., Plb.18.46.15; Iamb.in Nic.p.22 P.: —Pass., ib.p.24 P

ἀναδικέω.definition: appeal for rehearing of a case, PLille29.4

ἀντίμορος.definition: corresponding, of stones in a building, IG1.322

ἀπόκεντρος.definition: away from a cardinal point, Man.3.269

ἀδιάτμητος.definition: not cut in pieces, Aen. Tact.32.1

ἀπόνιμμα.definition: = Plu.Sull.36: esp. water for purifying the dead or the unclean, Clidem.ap. Ath.9.409f, cf. 410a

ἀπόψιος.definition: far seen, conspicuous, prob.l. in Dicaearch.1.1

ἀσπάσιος.definition: well-pleased, glad, 23.238; they released him to his joy, 5.397. Adv. gladly, Hom. with a Verb, to be glad to . . , as Il.7.118, cf. 18.232, Od.4.523, etc.—Ep., exc. in Adv. with glad welcome, A.Ag.1555 ; gladly, Hdt.…

ἀποχή.definition: distance, Phld.Rh.1.168S; abstinence, Phld.Ind.Sto.67, cf. Piet.36, Arr.Epict.2.15.5; Plu.Demetr.38; Porph.Abst.tit

ἀμφίμηλον.definition: probe with two ends, Antyll. ap. Orib.7.14.5

ἀμετάπλαστος.definition: not to be remoulded or altered, Diog. ap. Stob.App.p.42G

ἀρτιάζω.definition: play at odd and even, Ar.Pl.816; count, AP12.145

ἀνάπλαστος.definition: that may be moulded, plastic, Gal.18.670

ἄπιος.definition: pear-tree, Pyrus communis; = pear, Ar.Fr.569.3; Hermipp.63.17, Alex.33, Gal.6.603

ἀπότιτθος.definition: put from the breast, weaned, Ph.2.83,332

ἀνακάμπτω.definition: bend convexly, Arist.Mete.385b33; make to return, Antiph.12

ἀγωνοθέτης.definition: judge of the contests, president of; generally, judge, X.An.3.1.21; Aeschin.3.180

ἀφεστήξω.definition: Att. intr. fut. from I shall be absent, away from, Pl.R.587b; I shall desert, X.An.2.4.5

ἄπλοος.definition: Act., of ships, unseaworthy, And.3.5; Th.7.34; ibid.: of persons, . . Crito Com.3: Comp., less fit for sea, Th.7.60

ἀντιπλέκω.definition: intertwine, in Pass., Gal.18.748; of crossed or reversed bandaging, Sor.Fasc.12.513C

ἀράχνη.definition: spider's web, Hp.Cord.10, S.Fr.286, AP11.106; thin lines, Gal.UP10.12

ἀγονέω.definition: to be unfruitful, Thphr.HP9.18.3, Ph.2.402: metaph., ib.435

ἀρρενογονία.definition: begetting or bearing of male children, Arist.HA585b11

ἀνδίκτης.definition: for , catch of a mousetrap, Call.Fr.233

ἀποβολιμαῖος.definition: apt to throw away, c.gen; Pass., usually thrown away, worthless, Gloss

ἀκόρητος.definition: insatiate, unsated, c. gen; undisturbed by bugs, Ar.Nu.44

ἀπαγχονίζω.definition: hang by a noose, strangle, Ant.Lib.13.7; release from a noose, Luc.Lex.11

ἀρυτήσιμος.definition: that can be drawn: drinkable, AP9.575

ἀνάθεμα.definition: anything devoted to evil, an accursed thing, LXXLe.27.28, De.7.26, 13.17, al.; of persons. Ep.Rom.9.3, 1 Ep.Cor.12.3, etc

ἀσυνεσία.definition: Att. want of understanding, stupidity, E.Ph.1727 , Th.1.122; opp. Arist.EN1142b34 codd

ἀμητήρ.definition: but metri gr.], reaper, Il.11.67, Theoc.7.29: Adj., in form like a sickle, Nonn.D.26.302:—fem. EM83.2

ἀσύστροφος.definition: not forming a solid mass, Hp.Gland.13; of style, not condensed, D.H.Din.8

ἀραχνοϋφής.definition: spun as by spiders, i.e. fine- spun, Ph.1.666, cf. 2.479,637

αὐτοκαλλονή.definition: ideal, absolute beauty, Procl.Theol.Plat.1.24; also ib.5.14, Herm.in Phdr.p.157 A., Procl.in Prm.p.667 S

ἀντιζεύγνυμι.definition: annex, e.g. a word in the corresponding clause of a sentence, D.H.Amm.2.11

αἱμυλία.definition: wheedling, Plu.Num.8, prob. in Phld.Rh.2.77 S

ἀμαλλεύω.definition: bind into sheaves or bundles, EM76.6

ἀντίφερνος.definition: instead of a dower; = donatio propter nuptias, Cod.Just.5.3.20

ἀποσκυλεύω.definition: carry off as spoil from, Theoc.24.5

ἀναλογέω.definition: to be analogous; Math., to be proportionate, Cleom.1.7

ἀπταισία.definition: smoothness of rhythm in music, Pl.Lg.669e

ἀχύλωτος.definition: not converted into chyle, Gal.7.446, cf. 6.575

ἀμηχανέω.definition: fut. Th.7.48: impf; c. inf., not to know how to do, Neophr.1; . . know not how to escape, Antiph.254

ἀθαλασσία.definition: ignorance of the sea, v.l. for sq. in Secund.Sent.16

ἀποσφηνόω.definition: sens. obsc., Mim.Oxy.413.17; plug a tooth, Paul.Aeg.6.28

ἀρίμηλον.definition: a kind of apple, Antig.Car. ap. Ath.3.82b

ἀργυρίτης.definition: of or for money, a contest in which the prize was money , Plu.2.820d, Lync. ap.Ath.13.584c

ἀσύναπτος.definition: not joined, Arist.HA516a30; not connected, Id.APr.42a21

ἀνευόδωτος.definition: that does not prosper, Aq., Sm.Je.22.30

ἀναπωμάζω.definition: lift up the cover, HeroSpir.1Praef., Crito ap. Gal.12.732

ἀναντλέω.definition: draw up or out, Str.3.2.9: metaph., exhaust, go patiently through, D.H.8.51; D.Chr.12.51

ἀερομετρέω.definition: measure the air; hence, lose oneself in vague speculation, X.Oec.11.3

αὐλομανέω.definition: play the flute in mystic orgies, D.S.36.4

αὐστηρία.definition: metaph. of men, austerity, Plb.4.21.1, Cat.Cod.Astr. 2.160.6, etc.; as a virtue, Stoic.3.66

ἀποινέω.definition: cease to ferment, v.l. in Alex.45.4

ἀνάβρασις.definition: boiling up, bubbling up, e.g. of water, v.l. in Str.3.1.9

ἀκατάτακτος.definition: not reduced to order, Procl.in; unclassified, of sources of income, BCH6.14

ἅλις.definition: Adv. in crowds, in plenty, hence, in a; Hom. mostly with Verbs, Il.2.90; 3.384; Od.17.298; Il.14.122:—sts. just enough, in moderation, E.Med.630; Id.Alc.907

ἄκερχνος.definition: without hoarseness, Aret.CA1.10; Act., curing hoarseness, Id.CD1.8

ἁλιαστάς.definition: member of the at Tegea, IG5.6.24

ἀπόληγμα.definition: skirt, hem of a robe, Aq.Ex.28.33

ἀλιτήμερος.definition: missing the right day, untimely born, like cj. Guyet in Hes.Sc.91 , cf. EM428.10

ἀπλήθυντος.definition: not multiplied, without plurality, Porph.Sent.33, Procl.in Prm.p.535 S. Adv. Porph.Sent.l.c., Procl.Inst.62

ἀνομαλίζω.definition: restore to equality, equalize, Pass., pf. inf. Arist.Rh.1412a16: fut., cj. in Pol.1265a40; cf. sq

ἀφορμίζομαι.definition: Med., loose one's ships from harbour, E.IT18

ἀρχαιρεσιάζω.definition: hold an assembly for the election of; canvass for a magistracy, Plb.26.1.5

ἀεροβαθής.definition: in neut. pl. depths of air, 1 Enoch17.3

ἀπόδειξις.definition: setting forth, publication, . . Hdt.Prooem.; an exposition, sketch of it, Th.1.97; Pl.Plt.277a; R.358b

ἀφηνιασμός.definition: refusal to obey the reins, Ph.1.311 : metaph., rebellion, ib.171, al

ἀράτειος.definition: kind of fig, Thphr. ap. Ath.3.77a

ἀπροσκορής.definition: not satiating or disgusting; insatiate, Cat.Cod.Astr.8.178.19

ἀποσφαίρισις.definition: throwing off, flinging as a ball, ibid

ἀναθόλωσις.definition: making turbid, thick mixture of the juices of herbs, Pl.Lg.824; a stirring up, Stoic. 3.56

ἀποκομπάζω.definition: of lyre strings, break with a snap, AP6.54 ; declare blatantly, Simp.in Ph.1143.8

αὐτογέννητος.definition: = : a mother's intercourse with her own child, S.Ant.864

ἀνάγκη.definition: Ion. and Ep. force, constraint; necessity in the philosophical sense, Arist.APo.94b37, Metaph.1026b28, Ph.199b34; logical necessity, Metaph.1064b33: in pl., laws of nature, X.Mem.1.1.11, cf. Hp.Aër.21

ἁλιμυρής.definition: = foreg., Orph.A.344; salt-surging, Epigr.Gr.256 ; of the flowing sea, APl.4.180

αἱμάτινος.definition: of blood, bloody; red, of glass, Plin.HN36.198

ἀνταξιόω.definition: demand as an equivalent or in turn, Th.6.16: c. dupl. acc., Macho ap.Ath.13.570a

ἀνταποπαίζω.definition: lose what one has won at play, Menecr.1D

ἄπυστος.definition: not heard of, Od.1.242; of words, inaudible, S.OC489

ἀδώρητος.definition: = h.Merc.168; E.Hec.42; of the philosopher's stone, Zos.Alch.p.114 B.: c. gen., not endowed with, Epicur.Fr.364

ἀδακρυτί.definition: Adv.tearlessly, without tears, Isoc.14.47, Ph.2.67, Plu.Caes.7, etc

ἁπλῶς.definition: Adv. of singly, in one way; simply, plainly, A.Supp.464; Id.Ch.121; Isoc.4.154; Anaxil.22.23

ἀντεισάγω.definition: introduce, import instead, D.9.39; bring in to office, etc., in turn, Plu.Caes.14

ἀντιχωρέω.definition: move in opposite direction, dub. l. in Porph.Sent.11

ἀτενής.definition: stretched, strained, S.Ant.826; intense, excessive, A.Ag.71 ; Call.Fr.1.7 P

αὐτοπαθής.definition: speaking from one's own feeling or; Gramm., of pronouns, reflexive, opp. A.D.Pron.44.11; of verbs, opp. Synt.281.15

ἀναπόστατος.definition: unable to escape from; from whom there is no escape, Plu.2.166e

ἀλλοτριότης.definition: derivativeness, opp; unattractiveness, of style, Phld.Po.994.6,37

ἀποσημείωσις.definition: record, note, abstract, second title of Hippocrates' Steph.in Hp.1.54 D., cf.Herm.in Phdr.p.96A

ἀοιδοπόλος.definition: one busied with song, poet, like; ode-devoted, of lyric poetry, Aus.Ep.14

ἀδαημονία.definition: Ep. ignorance, unskilfulness in doing, c.inf., Od.24.244

ἀστερίσκιον.definition: Dim. of sq., little star, boss, knob on a helmet, Apollon.Lex

ἀμεταμέλητος.definition: not to be repented of or regretted; having no opportunity of repentance, Just.Nov.129.3

ἀφοδεύω.definition: go to stool, discharge excrement, Hp.Fist.9, Pl.Com.5, Arist.HA627a10, al

ἀλόγημα.definition: miscalculation, error, Plb.12.20.2: in pl., 9.16.5, al

ἀκλινής.definition: lending to neither side, unswerving; metaph., steadfast, steady, ib.12.158 ; Ep.Heb.10.23; Luc.Dem.Enc.33; unmoved, tranquil, Nonn.D.35.11, al

ἀκρονυγῶς.definition: Adv., touching at the edge, Gal.14.701

ἀντικελεύω.definition: bid, command in turn, Th.1.128: Pass., to be bidden to do a thing in turn, ib.139

ἀποκηδής.definition: = negligent: Adv., Comp. Hp. ap. Gal.19.84

ἀρτίτοκος.definition: new-born, AP6.154; parox. having just given birth, ib.3.119, AP7.729 , 9.2

ἀντιφαίνω.definition: reflect light, Thphr.Sens.26:—Pass., aor. appear face to face, Hes.Cat.Oxy.1359 i 5

ἀπόλλω.definition: late form of LXX4 Ma.6.14, v.l. in Eust.712.55, etc

ἀνέντατος.definition: without tension or force, Theopomp.Com.71; without over-exertion, Antyll. ap. Orib.6.21.5

αἴκισμα.definition: outrage, torture, A.Pr.989, Lys.6.26:— in pl. mutilated corpses, E.Ph.1529

ἀναγωγία.definition: want of discipline; lack of breeding, vulgarity, Plu.2.1065c, Demetr.Eloc.171; unpleasantness, E.Ep.5.2

ἀναποδισμός.definition: going back, opp; calling back, recall, LXXWi.2.5

ἀπογνωστικῶς.definition: Adv. in a desperate way, as in a hopeless case,Arr.Epict.3.1.24

ἄχροια.definition: absence of colour, Plot.2.4.10; loss of colour, paleness, Hp.Prorrh.2.24, Arist.Pr.967a8; opp. Thphr.Sud.39

ἀπελίσσω.definition: unroll, unwind, Aen.Tact.18.15:—Pass; roll up, aor. 1 D.C.46.36

ἀλφιτόχρως.definition: of the colour of barley-meal, powdered, i.e. mangy head, Ar.Fr.533

ἀποκαθεύδω.definition: sleep away from home; fall asleep over a thing, Them.Or.1.13d

ἀμπέτιξ.definition: Adv., round, dub. l. in CIG2554

αἰνικτήριος.definition: known from the Adv. in riddles, A.Pr.949

ἀναϋτέω.definition: shout aloud, Opp.C.4.301: c. acc., Nonn.D.10.288, cf. Coluth.85

ἀναγωγεύς.definition: one that brings up from below; strap for holding a shield, Eust.995.26: in pl., straps which keep up the sandal round the foot, Ael.VH9.11, Ath.12.543f

ἀνέτοιμος.definition: unready, not ready, Plb.12.20.6; out of reach, unattainable, Hes.Fr.219

ἄμπωτις.definition: retiring of a stream, Call.Del.130; metaph., Plu.2.502d

ἀερόομαι.definition: turn into air, Heraclit.All.22; evaporate, Gal.5.523

αὐτοζῷον.definition: animal in the abstract; self-existent, Herm.in Phdr.p.118A., but usu. having life in itself, Plot.3.8.8; Procl.Inst.189, cf. Dam.Pr.80

ἀχυρός.definition: or chaff-heap, Eup.299, Ar.Fr.10D., Pl.Com.6, and in the best Mss. of Ar.V.1310: but should be read

αὐτομέλαθρος.definition: united with her abode, of a Hamadryad, Nonn.D.48.519

ἀνύσιμος.definition: Pass., capable of accomplishment, J.BJ5.5.1, cf. Porph.VP27, SerapioninCat.Cod. Astr.1.100

ἀγορηγός.definition: sc. ship which conveys provisions, EM13.52

ἀλόη.definition: bitter aloes, Aloe vera, Dsc.3.22, Plu.2.141f; = LXXCa.4.15 , Ev.Jo.19.39

ἀποτείχισις.definition: walling off of a town; razing of fortifications, Polyaen.2.22.3

ἀσφάραγος.definition: stone sperage, Asparagus; the shoots of other plants, Nic.Th.883, etc.; Diph.Siph. ap. Ath.2.62f; of Dsc.4.182

ἀσπιστής.definition: one armed with a shield, warrior, Hom. always in gen. pl. Il.4.90, al.:—as Adj., i.e. the shield of Achilles, E.El.444

ἀναπόλυτος.definition: not able to get loose, sessile, Arist.HA599a15. Adv. Gal.12.8

ἀπόξυσις.definition: sharp point, Gp.10.75.11; making smooth, of stone, IG4.481

ἀνατρίβω.definition: rub, chafe, Hp.Art.9:—Med; rub clean, X.Cyn.6.26

ἀρτοφαγέω.definition: eat bread, Hdt.2.77, Hp.Aff.61; esp. eat wheaten bread, Id.Acut.37

ἀδούλωτος.definition: unenslaved, unsubdued, Pers.Stoic.1.99, D.S.1.53; Procl.in Alc.p.95 C.; Crates Theb.5

ἀοιδοκῆρυξ.definition: Dor. herald who announces singers, IG5.1314.15

ἀδηλέω.definition: to be in the dark about a thing, understand not, S.OC35: —Pass., to be obscure, Ph.2.42,al., S.E.M.11.233, cf. 7.393; fail to appear, Hp.Mul.1.2

ἀκρόφυλλος.definition: with leaves in a terminal crown, Thphr.HP1.14.2

ἀπογεφυρόω.definition: bank off, fence with dykes, Hdt.2.99

ἀποσήπομαι.definition: Pass., aor. Hp.Aph.6.58: fut; of water, throw off impurities by boiling, joined with Hp.Aë.r.8

ἀνηκοΐα.definition: not hearing, Plu.2.38b, Hierocl.in; ignorance, Plu.2.676f

ἀμφίλεκτος.definition: spoken both ways: hence, doubtful; double, Id.Ag.881

ἀνάξιος.definition: also freq. in Att; of persons, unworthy, not deemed or held worthy; too good for thee, S.Ph.1009: also c. inf., undeserving in the eyes of all to suffer, S.OC1446; Pl.Prt.356a

ἀπάνθρωπος.definition: far from man: hence; desert, desolate, of Caucasus, A.Pr.20; Luc.Prom.11

ἀκοντίας.definition: quick-darting serpent (cf; meteor, in pl., Plin. HN2.89

ἀπόληξις.definition: cessation, M.Ant.9.21; close of a sentence or period, Demetr.Eloc.182, al

ἀνασάξιμον.definition: a mine that is reopened and worked, after having been closed, IG2.780, 1078b

ἀπόπτωσις.definition: falling off or away; deposition, Ath.12.530a

ἀνδρόπαις.definition: man-boy, i. e. boy with a man's mind, of Parthenopaeus, A.Th.533; of Troilus, S.Fr.619, cf. Ar.Fr.53D

ἀναύδητος.definition: Dor. not to be spoken; unspoken, impossible, S.Aj.715

ἀτόρητος.definition: not to be pierced, invulnerable, Nonn.D.14.380

ἀντιστοιχέω.definition: stand opposite in rows or pairs; of letters, correspond, EM443.17

ἀρχεδέατρος.definition: chief seneschal at the Ptolemaic court, OGI169.4 , 181.4

αὐθέντρια.definition: fem. of = Keil- Premerstein Zweiter Bericht142

ἀπαυδάω.definition: forbid, abs., S.Ph.1293; decline, refuse, E.Supp.342; renounce, Theoc.22.129; say no, APl.4.299

ἄνοιγμα.definition: opening, door, LXX3 Ki.14.6 (cod; used of the diameter of a sphere, IGRom.4.503.12

αἰάζω.definition: fut. E.HF1053 : aor. part; groan, Arist.HA536b22, cf. GA788a22

ἀρχαῖος.definition: from the beginning or origin; mostly of things, ancient, S.OC106; Hdt.5.88; A.Ag.579 codd.; S.OC1382; faith firm for ever, ib.1632 codd

ἀξία.definition: Ion. worth, value; of persons, reputation, dignity, Th.6.68, D.13.18, cf. 18.63; Pl.Lg.945b; ib.744b; persons of dignity, official personages, Luc.Nigr.24; with great dignity, pomp, Plb.38.8.6; D.S.5.40

ἀνέκφραστος.definition: inexpressible, unutterable, Procl.in; not visiting, Syrian.in Metaph.109.25

ἀναφροντίζω.definition: think over, c. inf., meditate how to get, Pi.O.1.69

ἀπαλλαξείω.definition: Desiderat. of wish to be delivered from or get rid of, Th.1.95,3.84, Procop.Arc.4

ἄστριον.definition: Dim. of an architectural ornament; = Plin.HN37.132, Isid.Etym.16.13.7

ἀκέρδεια.definition: want of gain, loss, Pi.O.1.53:—also Procop.Arc.13

ἀποκλάζω.definition: aor. ring or shout forth, A.Ag.156 , AP7.191; bend one's knees: hence, rest, Ar.Fr.109

αὐχμός.definition: drought, Emp.111.6, Hdt.2.13,4.198; effects of drought, squalor, Pl.R.614d

ἄχροος.definition: contr. colourless, Arist.de; ill-complexioned, pallid, opp. Hp.Aër.6, VC19, Arist.Pr.966b35, al.: Comp. Hp.Prorrh.2.4, Arist.HA584a14: also Hp.Vict.2.63

ἄναστρος.definition: carrying no planet, Theophr.Fr.31,32, cf. Eratosth.Cat.22; without Jul.Or.4.148a; starless, ib.153c

αὐτοσίδηρος.definition: Dor. of sheer iron, 'with cold steel', E.Hel.356

ἀκαχμένος.definition: Epic part. , sharp-edged; armed, c. dat., Opp.C.1.476, cf. 3.252

ἀμμοχωσία.definition: sand-bath, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.10.8 tit., Antyll. ap. Aët.3.9

ἀβασκάνιστος.definition: free from malice, perh. to be read for Plu.2.755d

ἀπαμφιάζω.definition: take off a garment, doff it, Plu.2.406d; strip off, AP7.76 :— hence Subst. putting off, dub. in J.AJ19.2.5

ἄμφω.definition: also gen. S.Ph.25, etc., dat. Aj.1264, etc.:—both, of individuals, Il.1.363; of armies or nations, 2.124:—Hom. uses only nom. and acc.: from Hom. downwards freq. with pl. Noun or Verb, Il.2.767, 7.255, etc.; = S.OC142…

ἀκροφυής.definition: grown high up on a tree, Thphr.HP9.5.1

ἀελλόθριξ.definition: with hair floating in the wind, S.Fr.292

ἄεπτος.definition: v.l. for in A.Ag.141; = v.l. for q.v

ἀποχέω.definition: imper. Dsc.1.53: aor. Ep; pour off, Hp.Ulc.12; Dsc.1.53

ἄμφωτις.definition: covering for the ears, A.Fr.102; worn by boxers, Plu.2.38b, 706c, cf. Paus.Gr.Fr.52

ἀδιαληπτεύω.definition: to be lacking in comprehension, confused in mind, Phld.Rh.2.184S

ἀρθροπέδη.definition: band for the limbs, fetter, AP6.297

ἀντεξορμάω.definition: sail or march out against, D.C.48.47,63.24

αὐτόδαιτος.definition: of a guest, bringing his own share to a feast, Lyc.480

ἀπομορφόομαι.definition: Pass., receive their form; late in Act., change one into the form of . ., Eust.1598.64

ἀντικρίνω.definition: judge in turn, Aristid.Or.34.50).40; compare, match, Ael.NA5.56, al.:—Pass., 2.43, al.:—Med., contend against, LXXJb.9.32, 11.3

αἱμοφόβος.definition: afraid of blood, i.e. of bleeding, Gal.10.627

ἀλλοιόω.definition: change, alter, Hp.Praec.9; represent as , Plot.3.6.3

ἀντιγώνιος.definition: marking opposite angles, of stars in a quadrilateral, Hipparch.3.4.3, Ptol.Alm.7.1

ἀκρωνυχία.definition: tip of the nail; hence, ridge or top of a mountain, = X.An.3.4.37, HG4.6.7, Plu.Eum.11

ἀφιστορέω.definition: observe from a place, Philostr.Im.2.18; explore, visit for information, Id.VA1.27

ἀγοήτευτος.definition: not to be bewitched or beguiled; Act., without guile. Adv. Cic.Att.12.3.1

ἀναρρύω.definition: draw the victim's head back so as; Med., aor. draw back, rescue, from . . , Hp.Ep.23; Iamb.VP7.33; repair a defeat, D.H.5.46 codd.:—Pass., Just.Nov.115.3.13

ἀρότρευμα.definition: ploughing: metaph., generation, Poet. ap. Stob.1.49.46

ἀνάλκεια.definition: want of strength, feebleness, cowardice, Il.6.74, 17.320:—also in sg., Thgn.891

ἀποθριγκόω.definition: furnish with coping, IG11.144; wall off, Procop.Aed.5.7, al

ἀνταναφέρω.definition: bring back in turn; abs., make compensation, Them.Or.7.99c

ἀπόμοιρος.definition: forming a branch or portion of a nation, etc., Zos.3.6

ἄση.definition: Aeol. surfeit, loathing, nausea; distress, vexation, Hdt.1.136, Andronic.Rhod.p.570 M.; E.Med.245: pl., Sapph.1.3, cf. Alc.Supp.14.11; Pl.Ti.71c, cf. Stoic.3.100

ἀπεργασία.definition: finishing off, completing, of painters; causing, producing, Pl.Grg.4.62c; Euthphr.13d, 13e; Iamb.Comm.Math.9

ἀποκινδυνεύω.definition: make a desperate venture, try a forlorn; shrink from the dangers of another, abandon him in danger, Philostr.V A7.15

ἀρτεμία.definition: soundness, health, AP9.644 , Procl.H.1.42: pl., recovery, Max.184

ἀπάντλησις.definition: drawing off, of moisture, Arist.Pr.869b38; of blood, with menses, Sor.1.29

αἱμαλωπιάω.definition: have the appearance of clotted blood, Dsc.2.77

ἀφρᾶτον.definition: Lat. aphratum, soufflé, mousse, Isid.Etym.20.2.29, Alex.Trall.Febr.3, Steph.in Hp.1.87 D

ἀνιδρύω.definition: set up, e.g. a statue, D.C.37.34

ἄλφιτον.definition: barley-groats, sg. in Hom. only in phrase; generally, meal, groats, Hp.Acut.53; Id.Int.23; even Orph.L.212

ἄδηλος.definition: unseen, invisible, of a fish; mostly of things, death by an unknown hand, S.OT496; secret enmity, Th.8.108; melts all to nothing, S.Tr.698; inscrutable, E.Or.1318

ἀμφίλαλος.definition: talking in two languages, in broken Greek, Ar.Ra.979

ἀνάδεσμος.definition: = foreg., APl.4.134; bandage for female breast, Heliod. ap. Orib.48.50 tit

αὐτοόν.definition: self-existence, Dam.Pr.28, Them.in Ph.9.29: pl., Procl.Inst.128

ἀνέλικτος.definition: without turns or twists, Aret.CD1.4, Gal.UP5.3

ἀμπελῖτις.definition: of or for vines, vine-land; a bituminous earth used to cure in vines, Posidon.64; as a cosmetic, Dsc.5.160

ἀτρίβων.definition: gen. poet. for unskilled in, E.Fr.473

ἄκριτος.definition: undistinguishable, confused; continual, unceasing, Il.2.796; 3.412: neut. as Adv., Od.18.174, 19.120; h.Merc.126; continuous chain of mountains, AP6.225

ἀσπράτουρα.definition: rough, i.e. unworn, coin, OGI484.25 ; cf. aspratura, Gloss

ἀμφίχυτος.definition: poured around; thrown up around, i.e. an earthen wall, Il.20.145, cf. Hellanic.26 J

ἀθάνατος.definition: also (so regularly in sense I.1; of immortal fame, Tyrt.12.322

αὐτοειδής.definition: true to its own M. Ant.11.12; of ideal, abstract nature, Dam.Pr.340

ἀντιθνῄσκω.definition: die in turn or for another, EM114.14

ἀνάλεκτος.definition: select, choice, Socr.Ep.9. -lectris, -idos, dub. in Ov.AA3.273

ἀπόρρευσις.definition: flowing from, to be; Astrol., = 3, Vett.Val.146.32; Junc. ap. Stob.4.50.27. shd. perh. be read in these passages.)

ἀφιλοστοργία.definition: absence of natural affection, implied in punning phrase of Timagenes, Plu.2.634f

ἀμφιέζω.definition: freq. as v.l. for cf. An. Ox.2.338

ἀγαθοδοσία.definition: the giving of good, Alex.Aphr.in Metaph.707.19

ἀνακυπόω.definition: overturn, turn upside down, Lyc.137, Nic.Th.705

ἀναφλάω.definition: masturbari, Luc.Peregr.17: pf. part. Pass. Ar.Lys.1099

ἀμεμφής.definition: mostly in pass. sense, = I; Act., = II, Plu.2.610e; Id.Aem.3. Adv. Ion. Orph.H.43.11

ἀτακτέω.definition: of a soldier, to be undisciplined, opp; generally, lead a disorderly life, Lys.14.18, X.Oec.7.31: c. gen., to desert it, Plu.2.235b

ἄφυλλος.definition: leafless, Il.2.425, Thphr.HP1.14.3; Act., stripping off the leaves, blighting, A.Eu.785

ἀναπήγνυμι.definition: transfix, fix on a spit; impale, crucify, Alex.222; Plu.Art.17

ἁλίξαντος.definition: worn by sea, AP6.89 ; IG9.878 ; death by being dashed on the beach, AP7.404

ἀέδνωτος.definition: not accompanied by bridal gifts, Lyc.549

ἀνέμφαντος.definition: not expressive or indicative, Plu.2.45c; Procl.in Prm.p.639S

ἀσπουδί.definition: or Adv. without effort or trouble, Il.8.512, 15.476; without a struggle, ignobly, . . 22.304, cf. Arr.An.6.9.5; carelessly, D.C.54.18

ἀνεπάλλακτος.definition: not alternating, animals in which the upper and lower teeth do not lock into one another, but meet flat, opp. Arist.HA501a17

ἀφανίζω.definition: do away with, remove, S.OC1712 ; carry one off from the city, E.Ph.1041 ; Ar.Nu.972; disappear into the temple, Id.Pl.741

ἀμφίεκτον.definition: measure between and dub. in Them.Or.8.113d

ἀποστολή.definition: sending off or away, E.IA688; shooting, discharge, Ph.Bel.68.33

ἀπειλή.definition: mostly in pl., boastful promises, boasts; of threatening conditions, Alex.Aphr.Pr.2.60; Heras ap.Gal.13.815; of storms, J.BJ1.21.5, Ael.NA7.7

ἀποβηματίζω.definition: degrade from one's rank or station, Plu.Nob.21

ἀφόρητος.definition: unendurable, Hdt.4.28; not worn, new, censured by Luc.Lex.9, Ath.3.98a

ἀντίβοιος.definition: worth an ox or in place of an ox, of offerings, S.Fr.405

ἅλιος.definition: —mostly of things, fruitless, idle, Il.18.324, 5.715; 4.26; 5.18; 4.158; in Od. only with 2.273, 318; of a person, Il.10.324: neut. as Adv., in vain, 13.505, cf. 4.179, S.OC1469: reg. Adv. Id.Ph.840.—Ep. word, used by…

ἀπόσχολος.definition: shunning the schools, f.l. in Timo50

ἀπαμφίζω.definition: Att. fut. = strip from one, Men.339:-also Ph.2.319

ἀρτιστομέω.definition: to speak in good idiom, accurately, Str.14.2.28

ἀμφιτροχόω.definition: run round, encompass, Apollod.1.9.12, prob. from a poet

ἀποσιμόω.definition: make flat-nosed:—Pass; cause to swerve, Th.4.25, cf. Gal.18.347

ἀντοφείλω.definition: owe a good turn, to be indebted, Th.2.40

ἁλίβαπτος.definition: dipped in sea, drowned therein; a purple bird, Alcm.126, Alc.122

αὐτοσχεδόν.definition: Adv. near at hand, hand to hand, in Hom; c. gen., near, close to, Arat.901

ἀπηρεμέω.definition: take a thorough rest, Sor.1.80, Orib.Fr.74

ἁλινήκτειρα.definition: fem. as if fr. swimming in the sea, AP6.190 . metri gr.]

ἀνθέρικος.definition: flowering stem of asphodel; flower-head of asphodel, Dsc.2.169

ἀθεσμόβιος.definition: living a lawless life, lawless, Hp.Ep.17

ἀπαγκυλόω.definition: make crooked, v.l. in Ath.15.667c; make a loop in a rope, HeroAut.27.4

ἀντεκρέω.definition: flow out in turn, ib.1.13, UP6.11

ἀμφιλέγω.definition: Dor. dispute about; foll. by . . , dispute, question that a thing is, X.Ap.12: abs., dispute, GDI2561 A42

ἄνορθος.definition: perh. sloping, IG22.463.60; prob. corrupt in Herophil. ap. Gal.2.571

ἀλεξίχορος.definition: helping or favouring the chorus, IG3.171c17

ἄημα.definition: blast, wind, A.Ag.1418, Eu.905, S.Aj.674, Call.Aet.3.1.36

ἀφρόσκορδον.definition: African i.e. Cyprian garlic, Allium sativum, Colum.11.3.20

ἄκικυς.definition: powerless, feeble, Od.9.515; weakening, Orph.L.22.—Ep. word, also in A.Pr.548 , and Ion. Prose, cf. Hp.Morb.4.43

ἀποστομόω.definition: stop the mouth of, Cerc.11.7: hence, block; = I, D.H.6.14, cf. Luc.Tim.10

ἄπνοια.definition: freedom from wind, Hp.Epid.3.2; windlessness, calm, Arist.Pr.944b12, Plb.34.11.19 ; want of wind, Thphr.CP2.7.5; shelter from wind, Arist.GA785a29

ἀπαξιόω.definition: disclaim as unworthy, disown, or; Arist.Mu.391a6; but deem a thing unworthy of one, Luc.Dom.2:—Med., deemed them unworthy of . ., banished them from . ., A.Eu.367

ἀπαντλέω.definition: c. acc. only, lighten, lessen, E.Alc.354; having shed some of his faults, Phld.Lib.p.35 O.:—in Pass., Ph.1.266, Plu.Alex.57

ἀπνεύματος.definition: without wind or current of air, Arist.Pr.911b2, ct. Thphr.CP1.8.3

ἄργυρος.definition: white metal, i.e. silver; quicksilver, Id.de An.406b19, Mete.385b4, Thphr.Lap.60

ἀθλιότης.definition: suffering, wretchedness, Pl.R.545a; degradation, Phld.Rh.1.206 S

ἀσχολέω.definition: engage, occupy, Luc.Zeux.7:—Med., impf; Act. intr., in same sense as Med., Arist.Pol.1333a41, 1338a4, Philem.220; to be engaged in one's own business, Arist.Pol.1299b33.—Not used in the best Att. business, engagement,…

ἀποπίμπλημι.definition: later poet. also; satisfy, fulfil, in Pass., Id.8.96

ἄνυσις.definition: accomplishment, Il.2.347; we find no end, accomplish nothing, Od.4.544; Thgn.462; there is no respite, Theoc.25.93.—Poet. and late Prose, as Plu.2.77b

ἀναπισσόω.definition: cover over again with pitch, Gp.6.8.3

αὐλῳδός.definition: one who sings to the flute, SIG457.19 , Plu.2.150a, Ath.14.621b; cf

ἀδιάφορος.definition: not different, Arist.Rh.1373a33; in Logic, individual objects, as having no logical differentia, Arist.Metaph.1016a18; Top.121b15; ib.103a11

ἀνύπουλος.definition: without disguise, Ph.2.435; without arrière-pensée, Chor.Milt.50

ἀειγενεσία.definition: perpetual generation, Jul.Or.6.185c, al., Iamb. ap. Stob.1.49.38, Procl.in Cra.p.24 P., etc

ἄσηστος.definition: unsifted, Diph Siph. ap. Ath.3.115d, Sor.1.50

αἰώνιος.definition: also Pl.Ti.37d, Ep.Heb.9.12:—lasting; holding an office or title for life, perpetual, CPHerm.62

ἀνάλειπτος.definition: unanointed, Antyll. ap. Aët.3.9:—also Them.Or.20.235d, Archig. ap. Aët.3.194

ἀλοιφή.definition: anything with which one can smear; paint, varnish, etc., Pl.Criti.116b, cf. IG22.463.85, LXXMi.7.11, etc.; Polyaen.5.34

ἀπεριέργαστος.definition: not wrought carefully, simple, in Adv. Hierocl.Prov.p.464B

ἀνυπόπαστος.definition: of a stone, with nothing spread below it, IG7.3073.164

ἀπορρώξ.definition: broken off, abrupt; Subst., cliff, precipice, Plb.7.6.3, etc.; AP7.693 ; abyss, J.BJ1.21.3

ἀβακχίωτος.definition: having no part in Bacchus, undrinkable, i.e. salt spray, Tim.Pers.72

ἀρτέομαι.definition: Ion. Verb, Pass., to be prepared, make ready; Med., c. acc., Id.7.143

ἀκάνθιον.definition: Dim. of Arist.HA516b19; cotton-thistle, Onopordum illyricum, Dsc.3.16

ἀπόφασις.definition: denial, negation, opp; negative particle, e.g. A.D.Adv.124.8, al.; sign of negation, Stoic.2.52

ἀνόημα.definition: a foolish act, f.l. for Stoic.3.136

ἄεισμα.definition: poet. and Ion. for Hdt.2.79, Eup.139, Call.Epigr.29.1

ἀφιδρόω.definition: sweat off, get rid of a thing by sweating, Hp.Epid.7.58, Arist.Pr.868a37, Com.Adesp.3D.:—Pass., exude, Dsc.5.1

ἀμέγαρτος.definition: undesirable, AP11.60 ; of fish which follow a wreck, Opp.H.4.412

αὐτοάνισον.definition: inequality in the abstract, Alex.Aphr.in Metaph.809.14

ἀπόφλησις.definition: discharge of a debt, Anon.in Rh.206.3

ἀμμόχρυσος.definition: gem resembling sand veined with gold, Plin.HN37.188

ἀναγυμνόω.definition: strip naked, unveil, metaph. in Pass., Dam.Pr.404

ἀναθυμιάω.definition: vaporize, Thphr.Ign.38:—Pass., steam up; Med., draw up vapour, Arist.Pr.934b36

ἀνθυπάρχω.definition: to be set over against, of Stoic. ap. Plu.2.960b

ἀναδιπλασιάζω.definition: reduplicate, Choerob.in Theod.p.75 H.: Rhet., repeat, Anon.Fig.p.160S

ἀμφικομέω.definition: tend on all sides or carefully, AP7.141

ἀνανθέω.definition: blossom again, continue blossoming, Thphr.CP3.24.3, Lib.Or.18.90, IGRom.4.1540.25

ἀντηρίδιον.definition: Dim. of stanchion supporting; support, base, Milet.7p.60 , Haussoullier Cinquantenaire de l' école des hautes études p.89

ἀδιάβατος.definition: not to be passed; Act., not striding, closed, AB343

ἀκρίστιος.definition: on top of the mast, Id

ἄναλτος.definition: not to be filled, insatiate, Od.17.228, 18.364, cf. Cratin.382

ἀπόρρηξις.definition: bursting, e.g. of an abscess; breaking away from, J.AJ19.3.1

ἀποληρέω.definition: chatter at random, D.19.182, Longus1.17; outdo in foolish talk, Plb.34.6.15

ἀντικαταδύνω.definition: set over against, of stars setting at sunrise, Hipparch.2.2.11, al., Theo Sm.p.137H

ἅλως.definition: gen. Hp.VM13, X.Oec.18.8; disk of sun or moon, or shield, A. l.c.: later, halo, Arist.Mete.344b2, Epicur.Ep.2p.51U., Gal.5.640, etc

ἀρτιεπής.definition: ready of speech, glib of tongue, Il.22.281: in good sense, answered clearly, Pi.O.6.61; Id.I.5.46

ἀπύργωτος.definition: = foreg., not girt with towers, Od.11.264

ἀνάποινος.definition: without ransom, only once in neut. Il.1.99

ἄανθα.definition: a kind of ear-ring, Alcm.120, Ar.Fr.926

ἀνομοιομερής.definition: consisting of unlike parts, not; in Metric, Heph.Poëm.4

ἀσυνέργητος.definition: not affording help, Phld.Oec.p.67; unassisted, Antyll. ap. Orib.10.30.8

ἀφέψω.definition: boil off, Arist.Mete.359a30:—Pass., Id.Pr.933b15; Plb.34.10.12; cf

ἄφορος.definition: not bearing, barren, Hdt.2.156; causing barrenness, A.Eu.784 ; Hp.Mul.1.38; ib.6

ἄλυς.definition: agitation, Hp.Ep.1, Gal.9.613; ennui, boredom, Zeno Stoic.1.58, Plu.Eum.11, Diog.Oen.Fr.24; Plu.Pyrrh.13

ἀπακονάω.definition: sharpen, Porph.Chr.31:—Pass., to be sharpened to a point, J.AJ6.6.2

ἀποτεμαχίζω.definition: cut a portion off, sever, Herm.in Phdr.p.92 A.:—Pass., ib.p.166A., cf. Syrian.in Metaph.40.35

ἀβάπτιστος.definition: not to be dipped, that will; not drenched with liquor, Plu.2.686b

ἄμβων.definition: Att. for Ion. acc. to; rim or edge of a cup , Eup.52, Ephipp.3.16, Critias34D., Plu.Lyc.9

ἀπαργυρίζω.definition: appraise at cash value, Them.Or.23.292d:— Med., buy off, Lyd.Mag.3.45

ἀκάκιστος.definition: not violent, gentle, of remedies, Cass.Fel.76

ἀνθοπλίτης.definition: one armed in like manner, Lyc.64

ἀνδρίζω.definition: make a man of, make manly; mostly in Pass. or Med., come to manhood, Ar.Fr.744, Hyp.Fr.228, Luc.Anach.15

ἄλειψις.definition: anointing, Hp.Hum.10, Arist.GA785a30; method or custom of anointing, Hdt.3.22

ἀπόβλησις.definition: outpouring; of exclamations uttered in liquor, Eust.1767.59

ἄχρωμος.definition: = foreg. 2, Hp.Epid.7.122, Artem.4.44: Comp., Hierocl.Facet.203:—hence Subst. Gloss

αἴτιος.definition: more rarely Ar.Pl.547: (v; Subst., the accused, the culprit, A.Ch.70, etc.; they who have sinned against my father, ib.273:—c. gen. rei, ib.117, cf. S.Ph.590, Hdt.4.200

ἀπονυχίζω.definition: pare the nails, Men.996:—Med; metaph., scratch out, Ar.Eq.709

ἀκραίπαλος.definition: relieved of drunken nausea; of wines, not producing nausea, Ath.1.32d

ἁρπάγδην.definition: Adv. hurriedly, violently, A.R.1.1017; greedily, Opp.H.3.219, Aret.SA2.12

ἀντιρροπία.definition: in pl., vicissitudes of fortune, Agath.Praef.p.134 D

ἀλύπητος.definition: not pained or grieved, S.Tr.168; Act., not causing pain, S.OC1662 : so Adv. Pl.Lg.958e

αἰνόπαρις.definition: like direful Paris, Paris the author of ill, Alcm.40, E.Hec.945

ἀκροχερσίτης.definition: nickname of wrestler who broke his opponent's fingers, Paus.6.4.1

αὐτοδεής.definition: insufficient in itself, dub. in Corp.Herm.10.10

ἀλαλάζω.definition: generally, cry, shout aloud, Pi.l.c., E.El.855; esp. in orgiastic rites, A.Fr.57; of Bacchus and Bacchae, E.Ba.593 , 1133, etc.; Hld.3.5

ἁμαρτία.definition: a failure, fault; in Philos. and Religion, guilt, sin, Pl.Lg.660c, al., Arist.EN1148a3, al., LXXGe.18.20, al., Ev.Jo.8.46,al

ἀτράγῳδος.definition: untragical, unsuitable to tragedy, cf. Plu.2.519a. Adv. without noise or fuss, M.Ant.1.16.3

ἄφεσις.definition: letting go, release; of persons, dismissal: in ritual, Apul.Met.11.17; release, Plb.1.79.12, IG2.314.21, Ev.Luc.4.18

ἀναψηφίζω.definition: put to the vote again, Th.6.14; propose to; reckon backwards, Porph.Plot.2

ἀπέρεισις.definition: leaning upon, pressure, resistance; infliction, Plu.2.1130d

ἀποσμάω.definition: wipe off, Dsc.5.91, Diocl.Fr.141; wipe clean, Id.Pisc.14

ἀγαθοφόρος.definition: bearing good tidings, PMag.Par.1.3166; Cat.Cod. Astr.2.170

ἀπεναρίζω.definition: strip of arms, c. dupl. acc., Il.12.195, 15.343

ἀφιλοδοξέω.definition: to be free from ambition, prob.in Phld.Vit.p.7J

ἀντιτιμάω.definition: honour in return, X.HG3.1.13; Med. as law-term, make a counter-estimate of damages, c. gen. pretii, Pl.Ap.36b, D.24.138

ἀμφορίτης.definition: race run by bearers of; kept in PSI5.535.31

ἀποσφαιρόω.definition: round off, make into balls, Ath.2.42f

ἀπομάρανσις.definition: wasting or dying away, disappearance, opp. Thphr.Vent.36

ἀμφίθλασμα.definition: Ion. bruise of the flesh round a spot, Hp.Art.50

ἀθλοθετέω.definition: offer a prize, offer rewards, LXX4; preside over, direct, metaph., Eun.Hist.p.264 D., cf. Hld.7.12

ἀνώφοιτος.definition: mounting upwards, of air and fire, Zeno Stoic.1.27, cf. Ph.2.513, etc

ἀναθρέω.definition: look up at, view narrowly, E.Hec.808; Pl.Cra.399c:—Pass., compared with . . , Th.4.87

ἀλέξανδρος.definition: defending men, Epigr. ap; freq. as pr. n., esp. of Paris in Il., cf. A.Ag.61, 363

ἀλήθεια.definition: truth, opp. lie or mere appearance; in Hom. only opp. a lie, freq. in phrase Il.24.407,al.; 23.361; to tell whole truth about the lad, Od.11.507; Pi.N.5.17, cf. B. l.c.; prov., `in vino veritas', Alc.l.c., etc.; A.Fr.…

ἀντίτασις.definition: stretching the contrary; opposition, resistance, Pl.Lg.781c

ἀνέντευκτος.definition: unsociable, Plu.2.10a; inaccessible to persuasion or influence, ib.355a, etc

ἀντιπαρέχω.definition: furnish or supply in turn, Th.6.21:—also; cause in return, D.21.123

ἀμφικρύπτω.definition: cover or hide on every side, E.Hec.907

ἀμνηστέω.definition: Dor. = only pres., to be unmindful, forget, S.El.482 , Arat.847:—Pass., to be forgotten, Th.1.20

ἀντείσειμι.definition: enter in turn or in return, Simp.in Ph.573.4

ἀντικρατέω.definition: hold, have instead of something else, AP11.298

ἀργυρίς.definition: silver cup or vessel, Pi.O.9.90; plate in general, Anaxil.40

ἀστράρχη.definition: queen of stars, of the moon, Orph.H.9.10:—also Hdn.5.6.4

ἁλίρρυτος.definition: washed by the sea, AP12.55; surging sea's domain, A.Supp.868

ἀμβλύτης.definition: bluntness of teeth, Arist.GA789a11; obtuseness, Them.in Ph.173.7

ἀσπασμός.definition: greeting, embrace, Thgn.860; affection, opp. Pl.Lg.919e

ἀμέρεια.definition: being without parts, Porph.Sent.34, Procl.Inst.86,al., Dam.Pr.60; HeroDef.136.25

ἄγρα.definition: Ion. hunting, the chase; title of Artemis at Athens, Pl.Phdr.229c; Paus.Gr.Fr.13; IG2.315; ib.273:—also the precinct of Artemis Agra, Paus.1.19.6, St. Byz., AB334, etc

αὐτοχόωνος.definition: Ep. for rudely cast, massive, of a lump of iron used as a quoit, Il.23.826

ἀμφιβόητος.definition: sounding round, resounding; noised abroad, far-famed, AP9.241 , cf. Nonn.D.26.141

ἀναξύω.definition: scrape up or off, Antipho5.45:—Pass., being scraped up by fishermen dredging, Arist.HA569b7, cf. 603a23; having the surface scraped off, Plu.Publ.15; to be scraped down, Orib.Fr.99

ἀγέλαστος.definition: not laughing, grave, gloomy; Pass., not to be laughed at, not trifling, A.Ch.30, v.l. Od.8.307

ἀριδείκετος.definition: famous, glorious: in Hom. mostly c; clear, distinct, Emp.20.1

ἀμβλίσκω.definition: of the woman, bring on miscarriage, Muson.Fr.15 A p.77H., Plu.Lyc.3, Ael.VH13.6

ἀφεστήρ.definition: at Cnidus, president of the GDI3505.19, Plu.2.292a

ἄωρος.definition: untimely, unseasonable; unripe, of fruit, Dsc.1.126, LXXWi.4.5; of fish, out of season, opp. Nicom.Com.1.21: metaph., Plu.Lyc.15; Id. Comp. Thes.Rom.6

αὐτογλώχιν.definition: in one piece with the point, Hld.9.19

ἀγόνατος.definition: without a knee, Arist.IA709a3; of plants, without knots or joints, Id.Fr.195, Thphr.HP4.8.7

ἀμφικλινής.definition: unsteady, uncertain, Ph.2.548. Adv. to be in doubt, 2.171

ἀφάκη.definition: tare, Vicia angustifolia, Pherecr.188, Arist.HA596a25, Thphr.HP8.8.3, Dsc.2.148, etc

ἀναπάντητος.definition: where one meets no one, Cic.Att.9.1.3

ἀφησυχάζω.definition: settle down, be quiet, Hp.Ep.12; c. acc., pass over in silence, Ph.2.3

ἄλυσις.definition: distress, anguish, Dsc.5.2; gloss on Gal.19.75

αὐτοεντεί.definition: Adv. with one's own hand, D.C.58.24

ἀπορχέομαι.definition: dance away, lose by dancing, Hdt.6.129

ἀνάσπασις.definition: drawing back, Hp.Art.48; tearing up, Thphr.CP5.4.7; breaking open, Cat.Cod.Astr.1.97

ἀρχιέρεια.definition: chief-priestess, SIG846 , 882 , etc.: misspelt IG5.313 : = Lat. virgo Vestalis maxima, D.C.79.9

ἀποδέρω.definition: Ion. :-flay, skin completely, Hdt.2.40, cf. 2.42, 4.60; scalp, 4.64:-Pass., X.An.3.5.9; become excoriated, Philum. ap. Orib.45.29.61. 2. flay by flogging, fetch the skin off one’s back, Ar.Lys.739. 3. sens. obsc., ib.…

ἀλφός.definition: dull-white leprosy, esp. on the face, Hes.Fr.29, Thphr.Char.19.2, LXXLe.13.39, etc.: pl. in Hp.Aph.3.20, Pl.Ti.85a

ἄμητος.definition: reaping, harvesting; harvest, harvest-time, Hes.Op.384,575, Hdt.2.14, 4.42, Hp.Epid.6.8.19, Thphr.HP3.4.4, A.R.3.418, etc

ἀνθυφαιρέω.definition: take away again or in turn, Iamb.in; deduct on account of wages, IG4.1508A8

ἀλίασσις.definition: either assembly , or for = withdrawal , IG4.554

ἄβιος.definition: not to be survived, Pl.Lg.873c; without a living, starving, Luc.DMort.15.3, Man.4.113, Vett.Val.46.12; an imprecatory form in CIG3915.46

αὐτονοέω.definition: think for oneself, prob. in Menolatr.20.24

ἀπόλεκτος.definition: chosen, picked, Th.6.68; choice cut off the , Xenocr.70

ἀμισής.definition: not hateful, agreeable, Ph.2.70, Plu.2.10a: Comp. less troublesome, X.Eq.8.9. Adv. Ph.2.57

ἀφυστερέω.definition: come too late, be behindhand, Plb.1.52.8; withhold, LXXNe.9.20

ἀρρενοπίπης.definition: one who looks lewdly on males, Eust.827.30

ἄγε.definition: imper. of used as Adv., come on! freq. in Hom., who mostly strengthens it, in Att. freq. Ar.Eq.1011, etc.; before 1 and 2 pers. pl., Il.3.441; 11.348; Od.3.332; A.Pers.140; Id.Eu.307; rarely before 1sg., . . Od.13.215…

ἀπότιμος.definition: put away from honour, stronger than Hdt.2.167 , S.OT215

ἁλιτενής.definition: projecting into the sea; of ships, of light draught, Callix.1, Plu.Them.14

ἀποπροΐημι.definition: send away forward, send on; send forth, shoot forth, Od.22.82; let fall, ib.327

ἀνδροφθόρος.definition: man-destroying, murderous; proparox., the blood of a slain man, Id.Ant.1022

ἀνθράκινος.definition: of the nature of, or made of, a; blue dye , PHolm.18.35

ἀγρώτης.definition: of the field, wild, E.Ba.564 , Rh.266

αἱμοδαιτέω.definition: to revel in blood, Thphr. ap. Porph.Abst.2.8

ἀγρεύω.definition: fut. Call.Dian.85: aor; metaph., hunt after, thirst for, E.Ba.138; Arist.Fr.675.11; AP7.196 , cf. 12.125 ; but to catch by his words, Ev.Marc.12.13

ἀντέραμαι.definition: aor. to be a rival in love, Luc.Musc. Enc.10

ἀπόμαχος.definition: unfit for service, disabled; absent from the fight, of Achilles, AP9.467 tit., cf. Agath.2.7

ἀπόνιπτρον.definition: water used for washing, dirty water, Ar.Ach.616

ἀσυνέγκλιτος.definition: Gramm., not undergoing enclisis at the same time, TryphoFr.5 V

ἀποδιορισμός.definition: division, separation, v.l. for Herm.in Phdr.p.166A

ἀναθυμίαμα.definition: result of exhalation, Chrysipp.Stoic.2.196, cj. in Zeno ib.1.35

ἀπότριμμα.definition: that which is rubbed off, emery powder, Dsc.5.149, Crito ap.Gal.12.447

ἀπόξενος.definition: alien to guests, inhospitable, stronger; c. gen. loci, far from a country, A.Ag.1282, Ch.1042; banished from . ., Id.Eu.884

ἀστροθέτης.definition: one who classes the stars, Orph.H.64.2

ἀκρόψιλος.definition: bare or smooth at top, Hp.Epid.4.31

ἀντεξίσταμαι.definition: Pass., with aor. 2 Act., yield to an attack, retire from the contest, Plu.2.946d

ἀθεώρητος.definition: not seen, not to be seen, Antipho; not scientifically considered, Aristox.Harm.p.35 M.; M.Ant.1.9 ; not without considered meaning, J.BJ5.5.4

ἀντιαχάτης.definition: a stone like an agate, dub. in Orph.L.637

ἀσείρωτος.definition: not drawn by a trace , E.Ion1150

ἀναλείφω.definition: smear on, apply a drug, Orib.Fr.117

ἀποκομιδή.definition: carrying away, Plb.24.6.3; getting away or back, return, Th.1.137

αὐτοεπίπεδον.definition: ideal surface, plane in itself, Alex. Aphr.in Metaph.128.3

ἄναυδος.definition: preventing speech, silencing, A.Ag.238; unspeakable, horrible, S.Aj.947

ἀπαράλογος.definition: not without reason or method, Iamb.VP30.182

ἅρμα.definition: chariot, esp. war-chariot, Il.5.231; chariot and horses, yoked chariot, Il.2.384, etc.; Pi.I.1.14; Id.P.10.65, E.Alc.483: metaph., of three goddesses, E.Andr.277

ἀκτινοφόρος.definition: bearing rays, Gloss.:—as Subst., rayed shellfish, Xenocr.85

ἀρτίκολλος.definition: close-glued, clinging close; metaph., fitting well together, turn out exactly right, A.Ch.580; in the nick of time, Id.Th.373

ἀστροφεγγής.definition: shining with the light of heavenly bodies, PMag. Par.1.2071

ἀμέριστος.definition: undivided, indivisible, Pl.Tht.205c; Astrol., in act. sense, not imparting, Vett.Val.64.3

ἀκροβολής.definition: skilful in hitting, dub.l. in APl.4.213

ἀλλοιόστροφος.definition: of irregular strophes, i.e. not consisting of alternate strophe and antistrophe, Heph.Poeëm.5

ἀχέω.definition: poet. form for utter, h.Cer.479, prob.l. in h.Hom.19.18; Hes.Sc.93 codd.; Ion Trag.39: fut. Trag.Adesp.237

ἀδιέκδυτος.definition: not to be escaped, Apollon.Lex. s.v

ἀντεκκαίω.definition: kindle in turn, metaph. of passion, J.AJ15.7.3

ἀπαιόλη.definition: fraud, cj. Herm.in E.Hel.1056; personified in Ar.Nu.1150

ἀποκρανίζω.definition: strike off from the head, AP6.255; cut off the head, Eust.1850.30

ἀλέκτωρ.definition: yellow rattle, Rhinanthus major, Plin.HN27.40; husband, consort, Tz.ad Lyc.1094, and so perh. in B.4.8, S.Fr.851

ἀνθομιλέω.definition: associate, deal with one another, Hp.Ep.17

ἄφωκτος.definition: not roasted, Dieuch. ap. Orib.4.7.21, Gal.12.619

ἀναγώγιος.definition: raising the mind to heavenly things; reward for restoration of a fugitive slave, Milet.3 No.150.97

ἄπταιστος.definition: intact, Plu.2.691d; not causing to stumble, giving a good footing, Max.Tyr.5.2

ἄμισθος.definition: without hire or pay, opp; Pass., unpaid, unhired, A.Ag.979, cf. S.Fr.829, etc.; A.Ch.733. Adv. Cret. GDI5125

ἀντίπετρος.definition: like stone, rocky, S.OC192 codd; in Theoc.Syrinx2 , exchanged for a stone, of Zeus in his infancy

ἀνάσταλσις.definition: reduction of diet, prob. for in Herod.Med. ap. Aët.5.129

ἀθειρής.definition: Ep. for prob. in Thgn.733; also, = EM24.58. Adv. ibid

ἀϋτέω.definition: used by Hom. only in 3 pers. impf., and in; c. acc. pers., call to, Il.11.258; E.Hipp.167 ; why call on Zeus? Ar.Lys.717: c. acc. pers. et inf., E.Rh.668

ἀιστόω.definition: fut. Hdt.3.69 : aor. ib.127, contr. :—Med., aor. Orph.A.473:—poet. Verb, not in Il., used by Hdt., and once in Pl., make unseen, make away with, destroy, Od.20.79; . . Pi.P.3.37; A.Pr.234, cf. Pl.Prt.321a; S.Aj.515; I…

ἀίω.definition: Ep. and Lyr. word, freq. used by Trag. in; c. gen., listen to, give ear to, Hes.Op.213 ; obey, A.Pers.874, Ar.Nu.1166. [Hom. uses always in pres., so A.Pers.633, S.Ph.1410; but A.Supp.59 , S.OC181, 304: impf. Il.10.53…

ἀπομιμνήσκομαι.definition: fut. aor. recognize: hence, repay, Il.24.428; for benefits, Hes.Th.503; . . Th.1.137, cf. E.Alc.299

ἄν.definition: particella modale: col congiuntivo = eventualità (ἐάν, ὅταν); con l'ottativo = possibilità; con indicativo di tempo storico = irrealtà

ἀπό.definition: + gen.: da, lontano da (allontanamento, provenienza, origine)

ἄρα.definition: dunque, allora, come risulta (conclusiva/inferenziale; ἆρα interrogativa è parola diversa)

ἅτε.definition: + participio: in quanto, poiché (causa oggettiva, dal punto di vista di chi scrive)

ἀπεῖπον.definition: vietai, rinunciai (+ dat./inf.), rifiutai: aor. II di ἀπαγορεύω; anche: venni meno per stanchezza

ἄνωγα.definition: comando, esorto: pf. con valore di presente (tema ἀνωγ-); ppf. ἠνώγεα con valore d'imperfetto; imv. ἄνωχθι [epico]

ἀτύζω.definition: sbigottire [epico]; di norma pass. ἀτύζομαι: essere sbigottito, fuggire atterrito (ptc. aor. ἀτυχθείς)

ἀνέρομαι.definition: domandare, interrogare [epico/ionico] (att. ἀνερωτάω): aor. II ἀνηρόμην, inf. ἀνερέσθαι

ἄλαλκε.definition: respinse, tenne lontano (+ dat. della persona difesa) [epico]: aor. II a raddoppiamento del tema ἀλκ- (cfr. ἀλέξω, ἀλκή)
